title: Head of Survival
description:
Head of Survival

Health and Nutrition with integrated WASH

TEAM AND PROGRAMME

Programme Quality and Impact (PQI)

LOCATION

Juba, South Sudan Country Office, with frequent travel to field locations
GRADE: 2

CONTRACT LENGTH: Fixed term, 12 months.

Open to national and international applicants.

CHILD SAFEGUARDING

Level 3: The post holder will have contact with children and/or young people frequently (for example, once a week or more) or intensively (for example, four days in one month or more, or overnight) because they work in country programmes.

ROLE PURPOSE

The Head of Survival provides strategic and technical leadership for Save the Children's Health and Nutrition portfolio in South Sudan, including complementary Water, Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH) interventions. The post holder’s primary accountability is to ensure that Health and Nutrition programmes are technically sound, safe, evidence-based and responsive to the needs of children, women, adolescents and communities, while providing strategic leadership for the development and sustainability of the Survival portfolio.

Based in the Programme Quality and Impact (PQI) team, the role leads thematic strategy, programme design, technical quality assurance, resource mobilisation, learning and sector representation across humanitarian and development programmes.

Working closely with Operations, technical specialists, government and partners, the role strengthens the quality and resilience of health and nutrition systems and ensures WASH is effectively integrated to support infection prevention, safe service delivery and better health and nutrition outcomes.
The Head of Survival provides technical direction and oversight, working through appropriately qualified technical specialists where specialist expertise is required. The role leads through supportive supervision, collaboration and influence across the country programme, while Operations and project teams retain responsibility for day-to-day implementation and grant management. In a humanitarian emergency, the post holder may be required to work outside the normal role profile and vary working hours to support the response.

SCOPE OF ROLE

Reports to: Director of Programme Quality and Impact (DoPQI).
Staff reporting to this post: Provides technical leadership for Health and Nutrition and strategic oversight of WASH integration within Survival programming; specialist WASH technical design and engineering assurance remain with appropriately qualified WASH technical staff.
Role dimensions: Countrywide thematic leadership across the Survival portfolio and contribution to the Extended Senior Leadership Team (ESLT).
Key internal stakeholders: Country leadership; Operations and field teams; Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning (MEAL); Business Development; Awards; Finance; Supply Chain; Advocacy; Safeguarding; other thematic leads; and Save the Children member, regional and global technical colleagues.
External representation: Ministry of Health and relevant WASH authorities; state and county authorities; civil society and national partners; donors; the World Health Organization (WHO), United Nations Children's Fund (UNICEF) and World Food Programme (WFP); and relevant clusters and technical working groups.
Budget responsibilities: No routine programme budget holding. Provides technical input to budgets, resourcing and value-for-money reviews; exercises financial authority only where formally delegated.

KEY AREAS OF ACCOUNTABILITY Thematic Strategy and Thought Leadership

Lead the implementation and review of the country Survival strategy and technical priorities, aligning Health and Nutrition programming and relevant WASH components with the Country Strategic Plan, national priorities and Save the Children's thematic approaches.
Use needs assessments, service coverage, programme evidence and community perspectives to identify priorities for children and women, including people affected by displacement, disability, poverty and limited access to services.
Guide teams in applying and contextualising relevant organisational approaches, technical standards and guidance, ensuring emergency interventions support recovery, resilient service delivery and, where appropriate, longer-term systems strengthening.
Convene technical learning across the portfolio and draw on regional, global and member expertise to translate emerging evidence into practical improvements in programme design and delivery.

Programme Quality and Technical Leadership

Set and monitor technical quality benchmarks for the Survival portfolio. Conduct regular field support visits and joint reviews with Operations, MEAL and partners; agree corrective actions, follow up delivery and escalate unresolved quality or safety risks.
Health: Provide technical direction for integrated primary and community health services, including maternal, newborn, child and adolescent health, reproductive health, immunisation, prevention and management of common childhood illnesses, and functioning referral pathways.
Nutrition: Lead technical quality across prevention and treatment of malnutrition, including community screening and referral, management of acute malnutrition, infant and young child feeding, and maternal and adolescent nutrition, in accordance with applicable national protocols.
WASH: Oversee the quality and integration of WASH components that support Health and Nutrition outcomes, particularly safe water, sanitation, hand hygiene, infection prevention and control, and healthcare waste management in supported facilities and communities. Engage WASH specialists for technical design and engineering assurance.
Provide strategic oversight of clinical governance and patient safety, working through appropriately qualified clinical technical leads, and ensure systems are in place for supportive supervision, adherence to clinical standards, incident reporting and learning, quality improvement and escalation of significant patient-safety risks.
Work with pharmacy, nutrition, Supply Chain and Operations colleagues on technical specifications, forecasting, storage, appropriate use and availability of medicines, vaccines, nutrition supplies and other essential commodities; identify and escalate stock-out and quality risks.
Promote integrated programming with Child Protection, Mental Health and Psychosocial Support (MHPSS), Education, and food security and livelihoods teams, using coordinated referrals and community engagement to address barriers to survival and wellbeing.

Programme Evidence and Impact

Work with MEAL and programme teams to establish sound theories of change, results frameworks, indicators, baselines, targets and quality benchmarks for Health, Nutrition and relevant WASH interventions.
Provide technical oversight of Survival indicators and work with MEAL and programme teams to ensure IPTTs and other performance monitoring systems are accurate, timely and appropriately disaggregated.
Lead technical interpretation of programme performance, service quality and community feedback; use regular portfolio reviews to identify gaps, adapt interventions and track whether agreed improvements are achieved.
Shape assessments, evaluations and operational research with MEAL and technical partners, ensuring appropriate ethical processes. Capture learning and review technical content in donor reports, impact products and policy briefs so findings inform programming and advocacy.

External Representation Policy and Advocacy

Build and maintain strong relationships with the Ministry of Health, relevant WASH authorities, donors, United Nations agencies, civil society, academic institutions and other health and nutrition actors.
Represent Save the Children in Health and Nutrition clusters, sector forums and technical working groups, and in relevant WASH coordination through designated colleagues. Contribute technical evidence to joint analysis, planning and national policy discussions.
Work with Advocacy colleagues and partners to advance equitable access to quality health and nutrition services, sustainable financing, an effective health workforce and removal of barriers faced by marginalised children and women.
Translate programme evidence and community priorities into clear policy positions and engagement plans, and contribute to Save the Children's relevant national, regional and global advocacy initiatives.

Programme Development and Resource Mobilisation

Lead technical contribution to positioning and development of the Survival funding pipeline with Business Development, Operations, Awards and member offices; identify opportunities that fit strategic priorities and demonstrated needs.
Lead the technical design and review of concept notes and proposals, ensuring coherent intervention logic, achievable results, sound staffing and supply requirements, appropriate partnerships and realistic costed implementation arrangements.
Cultivate technical relationships with donors and prospective partners, contribute to consortium design and engage in donor discussions, briefings and visits to demonstrate programme quality and impact.
Provide technical input to budgets, revisions and grant reviews, linking resource requirements to quality standards, coverage and outcomes, and addressing technical gaps that could affect delivery or donor commitments.

Humanitarian Preparedness and Response

Lead the technical Health and Nutrition contribution to contingency planning, anticipatory action and emergency preparedness, including relevant WASH measures for floods, disease outbreaks, displacement and acute food and nutrition crises.
Support rapid assessments, response design and technical surge arrangements with Operations and emergency teams; prioritise continuity of essential services, safe referrals and appropriate integrated assistance for affected populations.
Coordinate technical engagement with government and humanitarian mechanisms during emergencies. Support readiness of staff, partners, supplies and referral systems, and use response reviews to strengthen future preparedness.

Partnerships Localisation and Systems Strengthening

Build equitable partnerships with national and local organisations and government counterparts, involving them in strategy, programme design, technical decisions, learning and representation.
Support partner assessments and jointly agreed capacity strengthening plans, with practical mentoring, supportive supervision and follow-up on technical quality, safeguarding and accountability commitments.
Strengthen local service systems, workforce capacity, referral networks and community ownership. Build sustainability and responsible transition arrangements into programme design and support greater national leadership of the Survival portfolio.

Management and Capacity Building

As a member of the ESLT, contribute to country office leadership, strategic planning, cross-sector collaboration and decisions that strengthen programme quality and impact.
Lead, coach and manage direct reports through clear objectives, regular feedback, performance reviews and development plans; build an inclusive working environment and address performance or conduct concerns promptly.
Assess technical capacity needs across staff and partners and coordinate practical training, mentoring and supportive supervision with Operations and technical specialists, including development of national staff and succession planning.
Contribute to technical recruitment and performance reviews, and manage consultants and short-term technical assignments with clear deliverables and quality checks. Mobilise specialist support when needs exceed the expertise available in-country.

Safeguarding Accountability and Inclusion

Embed child safeguarding, prevention of sexual exploitation and abuse, gender equality, disability inclusion and conflict sensitivity throughout programme design, delivery, monitoring and partnerships.
Work with MEAL and Safeguarding colleagues to ensure safe, accessible feedback and complaints channels for children and communities, including confidential referral of sensitive concerns and timely action through established procedures.
Promote meaningful participation of children, adolescents, women and affected communities in programme decisions, and ensure services protect dignity, privacy and equitable access.

BEHAVIOURS

Values in practice

Accountability

Holds self accountable for decisions, efficient use of resources, delivery of results and role modelling Save the Children values.
Holds teams and partners accountable, gives them space to deliver, supports their development and takes appropriate action when agreed responsibilities are not met.

Ambition

Sets ambitious goals for self and team, takes responsibility for personal development and encourages others to do the same.
Shares a clear vision, motivates others and thinks strategically about future opportunities and challenges.

Collaboration

Builds effective relationships with colleagues, members, partners and supporters; listens actively and remains approachable.
Values diversity and works respectfully across disciplines, cultures and organisations.

Creativity

Encourages practical innovation, develops solutions and takes considered risks to improve results for children.

Integrity

Demonstrates honesty and the highest standards of integrity, encourages openness and transparency, and acts consistently with organisational values.

QUALIFICATIONS EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS Essential

Master's degree or equivalent in Public Health, Nutrition, Global Health, Medicine or a closely related field, with a relevant first degree or professional qualification in health or nutrition.
At least seven years of progressively responsible experience in Health and Nutrition programming, including at least three years in senior technical leadership, programme quality or advisory roles in humanitarian and/or development contexts.
Demonstrated ability to lead an integrated Health and Nutrition portfolio.
Strong understanding of clinical governance, patient safety, quality improvement, essential commodities and the application of national protocols and recognised humanitarian quality standards.
Experience in fragile or crisis-affected settings, including emergency preparedness or response, and ability to support programmes in insecure or hard-to-reach locations.
Proven experience leading strategy, programme design and technically sound funding proposals; ability to assess budgets, implementation feasibility and value for money.
Strong analytical skills and experience using monitoring data, assessments, evaluations or operational research to improve programmes and demonstrate results.
Demonstrated experience developing staff and partner capacity, managing technical teams and influencing implementation through effective collaboration with operational colleagues.
Strong representation, negotiation and relationship-building skills, with experience engaging government, donors, United Nations agencies and national or local organisations.
Excellent written and spoken English, including clear proposal, report and presentation skills; proficiency in relevant digital tools for analysis, planning and communication.
Commitment to child rights, safeguarding, accountability, gender equality, disability inclusion and Save the Children's mission, values and ways of working.
Willingness and ability to travel regularly to field locations and adapt working arrangements during emergencies, in accordance with organisational safety procedures.

Desirable

Experience in South Sudan or comparable contexts, including collaboration with government health systems and familiarity with national Health and Nutrition priorities.
Experience in senior leadership within an international or national non-governmental organisation, or in a comparable public health institution.
Experience with multi-partner or consortium programmes and with donor-funded Health and Nutrition portfolios, including ECHO, UNICEF or WFP-supported programming.
Practical experience in health systems strengthening, localisation, integrated WASH programming or anticipatory action.
Knowledge of Arabic and/or languages spoken in South Sudan.

Additional job responsibilities

The duties and responsibilities above are not exhaustive. The role holder may be required to carry out additional duties appropriate to their level of skills and experience.

Equal Opportunities

The role is open to national and international applicants. Save the Children welcomes applications from suitably qualified candidates and encourages applications from women and persons with disabilities. The role holder must carry out their duties in accordance with Save the Children International (SCI) Equal Opportunities and Diversity policies and procedures.

Child Safeguarding

We need to keep children safe. Our selection process, including rigorous background checks, reflects our commitment to protecting children from abuse. The role holder must uphold safeguarding requirements and report concerns through established procedures.

Health and Safety

The role holder must carry out their duties in accordance with SCI Health and Safety policies and procedures, including applicable security requirements for field travel.

Additional benefits available to full-time employees, including health, dental, prescription drug coverage, and paid vacation.

title: Planning Technician (Policy and Delivery)
description:
• East Suffolk Council
  • Address: East Suffolk House, Melton, Woodbridge IP12 1RT and Riverside, Lowestoft, Suffolk NR33 0EQ
  • Salary: £29,542 - £35,570 (Band 4/5)
  • Hours: 37 hours per week
  • Contract: Fixed term until December 2027*

East Suffolk Council is an exciting place to work and a great place to make a real difference to people’s lives, delivering vital services to a quarter of a million people across East Suffolk.

We currently have an exciting maternity cover opportunity to join East Suffolk Council's Policy and Delivery Team as a Planning Technician until December 2027.

*Please note that, as this is a maternity cover position, the fixed-term contract may end earlier than December 2027 should the substantive postholder return to work sooner than expected.

The role:

This is an excellent opportunity to join East Suffolk Council's Planning Policy & Delivery Team on a fixed-term maternity cover basis. This role provides a varied mix of technical, administrative and digital support to the Planning Policy & Delivery Team, as well as providing support to other teams in the Planning and Building Control Service, including our Specialist Services team. The Planning Policy and Delivery team leads on the preparation of the Council’s planning policy documents, including Local Plans, planning guidance and monitoring documents. We have an innovative and forward looking team of Technicians, who have driven improvements in our digital ways of working, including how we share our information online and enable the public to interact.

The role involves the creation and management of website content, designing and publishing high-quality documents and maps, and supporting public consultation and community engagement activities, including through the use of digital platforms. The role also involves responding to enquiries from residents and stakeholders, assisting Neighbourhood Plan groups, and supporting the internal administration of the team. Reflecting our ambition to improve the way we make our planning information and data available, and the increasing digitisation of the planning system, the role provides an opportunity for innovation and new ideas, by supporting the Lead Technician in identifying areas for technical and digital improvement. . Our Planning Delivery Dashboard is just one example of the types of projects you will get involved in. The successful candidate will contribute to the delivery of an efficient, customer-focused service while upholding the organisation's values and standards

What you will need:

Knowledge and Experience

We are looking for someone with excellent IT skills and a customer-focused approach to the provision and communication of information, with an ability to work methodically and accurately in a timely manner. Experience in a Planning related role, whilst desirable, is not essential, and the role will provide excellent opportunities for personal development.

Skills and Abilities

You will have strong organisational skills and be able to manage a varied workload in a busy environment. The role requires the ability to work independently and as part of a team, with excellent communication, interpersonal and customer service skills. You will have strong written skills, attention to detail, and the ability to maintain accurate records and filing systems. Good analytical abilities, particularly in relation to data and mapping information, are essential. The role also requires proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, Access and Teams, together with experience of GIS mapping and data analysis. Flexibility, professionalism and the ability to adapt to changing priorities are key.

Education and Qualifications

Applicants should be educated to A-Level standard, including GCSE English and Maths (or equivalent), or hold a Level 3 Town Planning Apprenticeship or equivalent qualification. Relevant planning experience would be advantageous but is not essential.

Additional Requirements

The successful candidate will be able to work from both Riverside and East Suffolk House offices and have access to transport to travel across the district as required. We are looking for someone with a positive attitude, a commitment to customer service and a willingness to develop their skills and contribute to the wider team.

You will be enthusiastic, adaptable and committed to delivering a high-quality service that supports the Council's values.

If you think you have what it takes to be successful in this role, even if you don’t meet all of the essential requirements, please apply. We would appreciate the opportunity to consider your application.

Why work for us?

East Suffolk Council is a great place to work and there are lots of benefits our employees can access. To find out more about why we are so proud of East Suffolk Council, take a look at our video and hear why our employees think it is such a great place to work (YouTube).

Here are some of the main benefits:

  • Generous leave entitlement (equivalent to 25 days a year, increasing to 31 days after 5 years’ service, plus bank holidays)

  • Local government pension scheme

  • Flexible working arrangements

  • Learning and development tailored to your role

  • A wide variety of staff support networks including access to health and wellbeing initiatives and programmes.

  • Discounts on mobile phones, computers, holiday and travel, fashion and clothing, health and beauty and many other products and services.

Find more information about what we offer in our benefits brochure (pdf).

To find out more

title: Demo Coordinator
description:
ABOUT US:

We are Pon Bike UK, home of Santa Cruz, Cervelo, Cannondale, Reserve, OneUp and Nimbl. Six of the most exciting brands in the cycling industry who tend to do things differently. We have over 25 years of bike experience, and our ultimate goal is to sell the best road and mountain bikes in the world while having fun doing it!

ABOUT THE ROLE:

To deliver seamless and industry-leading demo events by coordinating all logistics, equipment and post event follow ups, ensuring a high quality experience for end consumers.

WHAT THE JOB LOOKS LIKE:

  • Coordinate demo event logistics by supporting planning and execution of events in collaboration with Commercial Sales Team and Field Marketing Team.

  • Lead post event wrap-up: unpack the van, clean and prep bikes, and store equipment properly.

  • Produce post event reports covering models ridden, demographics and general event reporting.

  • Follow up with dealers post-demo and hand over to the appropriate sales contact.

  • Support Showroom management (during quiet seasons) by updating the room layout and displays for dealer visits.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE:

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build rapport, influence and build trust in person.

  • Strong self motivation - you thrive working independently.

  • Demonstrated proficiency in bike assembly, advanced mechanical troubleshooting & diagnostics, and routine running maintenance across road, mountain, and e-bikes.

  • Highly organised with strong attention to detail, with proficiency in CRM and Google Suite tools.

  • A passion for cycling is essential.

  • Full UK driving licence and willingness to travel extensively across the UK.

title: ViiV Healthcare (GSK) Director/Toxicology Project Specialist
description:
ViiV Healthcare is a global specialty HIV company, the only one that is 100% focused on researching and delivering new medicines for people living with, and at risk of, HIV. ViiV is highly mission-driven in our unrelenting commitment to being a trusted partner for all people living with and affected by HIV. Our aim is to think, act, and connect differently through a focus on education on and treatment for HIV. We go to extraordinary lengths to deliver the sorts of breakthroughs, both in treatments, care solutions and communities, that really count. We go beyond the boundaries of medicine by taking a holistic approach to HIV through developing and supporting sustainable community programs and improving access to care. We are fully committed to push through every challenge until HIV/AIDS is eradicated. ViiV has played a significant part in delivering breakthroughs that have turned HIV into a manageable health condition. We offer the largest portfolio of HIV medicines available anywhere, and we continue our work to cater for the widest possible range of needs in response to the HIV epidemic.

We are aware of how much is at stake for those affected by HIV and we show up every day 100% committed to the patients. Our work culture is fast-paced, diverse, inclusive, competitive, and caring. But ViiV isn’t just somewhere to work – it’s a place to belong, an invitation to bring your very best, and a team full of impact-driven team members who are hungry to make a difference.

While we have been improving lives of HIV patients for 30 years, this is an especially exciting time to be at ViiV, as we evaluate novel approaches to treatment and prevention that could further reduce the impact of HIV on individuals and communities.

This role will be based out of Upper Providence, PA or Branford, CT or Boston, MA or Durham, NC & is eligible for a domestic relocation package.

As the Director/Toxicology Project Specialist, you will be responsible for developing the end-to-end non-clinical safety strategy for projects across ViiV Healthcare’s portfolio. You will work in a highly matrixed global environment and collaborate extensively to evolve non-clinical safety strategies based on input from market research, competitive intelligence, and learnings from internal programs. You will also work to integrate non-clinical project plans with CMC, regulatory, and clinical plans to optimize speed of drug development.

This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career, these responsibilities include some of the following…

  • Toxicology project team member (PTM) supporting 5-10 projects at any given time

  • Sufficient breadth of knowledge of all areas of NCS (and supportive processes) to strategically and efficiently drive aspects of projects in discovery and/or development phases, including provision for external diligence activities.

  • Has a good knowledge of other disciplines (e.g. Pharmacology, DMPK, Clinical, etc.) to enable visible contributions to a multi-disciplinary scientific/operational strategy.

  • Sustained ability to support multiple projects across various modalities, including small molecules, biologics and alternative platforms.

  • Proven competency to integrate data and craft clear and appropriate narratives for internal governance decision reviews e.g., technical/investment boards, and/or regulatory documentation (IB/IND/NDA/BLA).

  • Proven excellent communicator (both written and verbal skills) which supports the capability to positively influencing external stakeholders, e.g. regulators (at a project level) or senior leaders in ViiV/GSK.

  • Coaches/mentors other project team members and is highly regarded as a reviewer/approver of regulatory and or internal milestone documents.

  • Sustained record of highly effective teamwork leveraging SMEs as required, providing clear and regular line of sight and leadership to project issues and progression challenges.

  • Leadership of major scientific or technical initiatives within and external to the Pre-clinical Sciences team.

  • Record of flexible, creative and courageous thinking, providing multiple options to project teams, EDLs/MDLs, etc.

  • Ability to effectively prioritise multiple and conflicting objectives and evidence of learning agility.

  • Collaborate internally with GSK pre-clinical sciences organization and externally with academic institutions to leverage and enhance scientific capabilities.

  • Participate on due diligence teams in the integrated scientific/technical evaluation of external opportunities.

  • Contribute to consultancy on drug disposition, pre-clinical safety and on-target and off-target engagement/modulation on request, including support for marketed products, as needed.

  • Contribute to training and mentoring of other toxicologists, as appropriate.

  • Participate in internal and external committees and panels as assigned by the team leader.

Why you?

Basic Qualifications:

We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:

  • Master’s degree with 8+ years, or PhD with 6+ years, of experience in non-clinical safety/toxicology

  • Experience as a project team member covering a number of projects across a broad range of stages in development and across all modalities, including biologics

  • Non-clinical Safety capability and experience coupled with an understanding of the interrelationships between disposition, safety and on/off target engagement as applied to the identification and articulation of critical needs and deliverables for projects.

  • Knowledge and experience of the Non-clinical Safety aspects of worldwide regulatory requirements for drug development and registration.

Preferred Qualifications:

If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:

  • Experience in non-clinical discovery and development of long-acting small molecules

  • DABT (Diplomat of American Board of Toxicology)

  • Experience in infectious disease therapy area.

  • May be a recognized leader in a specific scientific field or discipline of interest, maintaining an extensive network (with a publication record) in that specific scientific field.

#LI-GSK

#LI-ViiV


Skills

Biotechnology, Business Strategies, Cell Biology, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Drug Development, Drug Discovery Process, Influencing Without Authority, Interpersonal Communication, Life Science, Market Opportunities, Matrix Leadership, Molecular Biology, Scientific Research, Scientific Writing, Strategic Alignment• If you are based in Cambridge, MA; Waltham, MA; Rockville, MD; or San Francisco, CA, the annual base salary for new hires in this position ranges $178,200 to $297,000. • If you are based in another US location, the annual base salary range is $162,000 to $270,000. The US salary ranges take into account a number of factors including work location within the US market, the candidate’s skills, experience, education level and the market rate for the role. In addition, this position offers an annual bonus and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program which is dependent on the level of the role. Available benefits include health care and other insurance benefits (for employee and family), retirement benefits, paid holidays, vacation, and paid caregiver/parental and medical leave. Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

title: Grain Facility Operator in Training - 1st Shift
description:
Thank you for your interest in joining our team! At CGB, you can contribute to meaningful work, grow professionally and personally, and belong in a place where everyone has a voice.

Founded in 1969, CGB Enterprises, Inc. is known as an innovative and progressive leader in the grain and transportation industries. Today, CGB operates an enterprise with over 100 locations and nearly 2,000 U.S. employees overseeing a diverse family of businesses that provide an array of services for producers and logistics services for an international base of customers. The combination of our assets provides a growing organization that is celebrating over 50 years of strength and stability!

Are you an ambitious worker who is looking for more than just a job? If so this might be just the opportunity, you are looking for. Begin your career with Consolidated Grain and Barge in our Grain Facility Operator in Training Program. Through this program, you can move up through our newly designed Career Path. Every step of the way you will be able to see what it will take to advance to the next level of responsibility and pay.

We are primarily focused on safely and the efficient loading and unloading of railcars and trucks with grain. This is a great opportunity for a person who loves to work in an outdoor work environment and wants a career with a great company.

This job is primarily responsible for working at a facility that loads and unloads barges, rail cars and trucks. This is a general position that performs a wide variety of duties that are based on the daily needs of the operation.

In this job, you will:

Actual responsibilities will vary depending on daily needs and type of facility.

  • Fully participate in the company Safety Program and attends daily pre-shift meetings.
  • Perform all duties within compliance of OSHA, company safety, and environmental regulations (ISO where applicable); including wearing appropriate PPE for task being performed.
  • Perform deckhand responsibilities e.g., reading drafts, opening/closing lids, tying off barges, etc.
  • Perform all barge loading duties e.g., loading barges to meet draft and quality requirements and oversees deckhand(s). Note: Generally the duty of the most highly qualified person(s).
  • Perform duties to transfer, load and move grain to appropriate location, where applicable.
  • Perform duties required to maintain grain quality while being stored and/or transferred.
  • Perform all rail duties e.g. prep, unloading, loading, placement, etc., where applicable.
  • Complete all duties of Scale/Probe Operations position, where applicable.
  • Complete documentation timely, accurately and legibly.
  • Perform general clean-up including sweeping, shoveling, washing, painting and other general housekeeping responsibilities.
  • Dependent on facility and location, may be responsible for any variety of the following; performing preventative maintenance and/or repairs; unloading barges, cleaning barges, movement of product to storage, loading of trucks using heavy equipment, loading of rail, loading of products to required specifications; operating a variety of heavy equipment.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Here’s what you’ll need to be considered:

Education

Required - High school diploma or equivalent, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Experience

Required – None.

Preferred - 1 years’ experience working in an industrial environment with a dependable work record.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Basic mathematical skills (add, subtract, multiply, divide).
  • Effective interpersonal, oral and written communication skills with the ability to interact with all levels of people within and outside the organization.
  • Ability to complete documentation requirements.
  • Ability to follow directions and use logical thought process to interpret oral and written instructions, and troubleshoot problems.
  • Ability to work well both independently and within a team environment.
  • Ability to use tools appropriate for assigned task.
  • Ability to remain focused on exceptional customer service, both internally and externally.

Here’s additional information you need to know:

title: Game Security Analyst - Ricochet Anti-Cheat (Call of Duty)
description:
Job Title:

Game Security Analyst - Ricochet Anti-Cheat (Call of Duty)

Requisition ID:

R028045

Job Description:

Your mission

Call of Duty is one of the most iconic and successful video game franchises in the world, delivering unforgettable experiences to millions of players every day. At the heart of that experience is fair play—and that’s where the Ricochet Anti-Cheat team comes in.

Our mission is to protect the integrity of the online experience, ensuring every player enjoys a level playing field. As a Game Security Analyst, you will play a critical role in identifying and removing cheaters in Call of Duty’s live titles.

The Role

We are seeking a Game Security Analyst to help protect the integrity of the Call of Duty player experience by identifying, investigating, and actioning cheating behavior across our live titles.

As a Game Security Analyst, you will review suspicious player activity, analyze gameplay and enforcement data, and make high-confidence decisions that help remove cheaters from the ecosystem. Working closely with anti-cheat engineers, data scientists, and operations teams, you will contribute directly to the detection, validation, and enforcement processes that support fair play at scale.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong analytical skills with a passion for competitive gaming, player behavior analysis, and operational excellence.

What you bring to the table

The video game industry and therefore our business is fast-paced and will continue to evolve. As such, the duties and responsibilities of this role may be changed as directed by the Company at any time to promote and support our business and relationships with industry partners. Therefore, this role includes, but is not limited to, the following responsibilities:

  • Investigate suspicious player accounts using gameplay telemetry, behavioral signals, and internal anti-cheat tools.
  • Review evidence associated with potential cheating, exploitation, boosting, and other integrity violations.
  • Make accurate and consistent enforcement decisions, including account bans and other disciplinary actions.
  • Identify patterns, trends, and emerging cheating behaviors across the player population.
  • Partner with engineering and data teams to improve detection quality and reduce false positives.
  • Validate new anti-cheat detections before wide-scale deployment.
  • Support incident response during major cheating outbreaks, emerging exploits, or high-profile investigations.
  • Document investigative findings and maintain clear records of enforcement decisions.
  • Provide feedback on enforcement policies, workflows, and tooling to improve operational efficiency.
  • Help develop best practices that improve the consistency, accuracy, and effectiveness of player investigations.
  • Contribute to a culture of fairness, accountability, and continuous improvement in game security operations.

Player Profile

Minimum requirements

Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in game security, trust and safety, fraud detection, player support investigations, cybersecurity, or a related analytical field.
  • Experience investigating anomalous behavior, abuse, fraud, policy violations, or suspicious activity.
  • Proficient working with large datasets and identifying patterns in behavioral data.
  • Experience using SQL to analyze player activity data.
  • Experience working with investigative workflows and case management systems.
  • Working knowledge of data analysis techniques and metrics.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills with the ability to evaluate complex evidence.
  • Excellent written communication and documentation skills.
  • Ability to make objective, evidence-based decisions in a fast-paced operational environment.
  • Background collaborating with technical and non-technical partners.
  • Ability to analyze multiple sources of information and synthesize findings into clear conclusions.

Key Attributes

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy and consistency.
  • Passion for multiplayer gaming and preserving competitive integrity.
  • Understanding of cheating, exploitation, abuse, and competitive integrity challenges in online games.
  • Ability to prioritize workload effectively across multiple investigations.
  • Strong judgment and discretion when handling sensitive enforcement actions.

Extra Points

Experience

  • Experience in anti-cheat operations or trust and safety environments.
  • Experience with Python or scripting for data analysis and automation.
  • Experience working with machine-learning-assisted detection systems.
  • Experience with moderation, enforcement, or account review programs at scale.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Familiarity with Call of Duty gameplay systems and common cheating methods.
  • Knowledge of game telemetry and player behavioral analysis.
  • Understanding of cheat distribution channels and community ecosystems.

Your Platform

Activision Central Tech works to support our development studios and their titles. Comprised of seven main teams, we have many specialties including big data, privacy and security, motion capture and animation pipeline technologies, graphics, build and infrastructure for studio development and data centers, optimization, systems programming and online services including matchmaking and networking. Central Tech is distributed globally with offices across the U.S., and in Canada, England, Ireland and Japan.

Most of our teams are comprised of both engineering and research talent, allowing us to always have an eye on the future. Our talented engineers help with title development and provide valuable knowledge sharing between studios while our researchers are action-oriented and keep a strong connection with the needs of the game studios.

Central Tech is part of Activision. To learn more about us and our research, please visit us at .

Our World

At Activision, we strive to create the most iconic brands in gaming and entertainment. We’re driven by our mission to deliver unrivaled gaming experiences for the world to enjoy, together. We are home to some of the most beloved entertainment franchises including Call of Duty®, Crash Bandicoot™, Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™, and Guitar Hero®. As a leading worldwide developer, publisher and distributor of interactive entertainment and products, our “press start” is simple: delight hundreds of millions of players around the world with innovative, fun, thrilling, and engaging entertainment experiences.

We’re not just looking back at our decades-long legacy; we’re forging ahead to keep advancing gameplay with some of the most popular titles and sophisticated technology in the world. We have bold ambitions to create the most inclusive company as we know our success comes from the passionate, creative, and diverse teams within our organization.

We’re in the business of delivering fun and unforgettable entertainment for our player community to enjoy. And our future opportunities have never been greater — this could be your opportunity to level up.

Ready to Activate Your Future?

We love hearing from anyone who is enthusiastic about changing the games industry. Not sure you meet all qualifications? Let us decide! Research shows that women and members of other under-represented groups tend to not apply to jobs when they think they may not meet every qualification, when, in fact, they often do! We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and strongly encourage you to apply.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, among other characteristics.

We are committed to working with and providing reasonable assistance to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you are a disabled individual requiring an accommodation to apply for an open position, please email your request to candidate-accommodations@activisionblizzard.com. General employment questions cannot be accepted or processed here. Thank you for your interest.

Rewards

We provide a suite of benefits that promote physical, emotional and financial well-being for ‘Every World’ - we’ve got our employees covered! Subject to eligibility requirements, the Company offers comprehensive benefits including:

  • Medical, dental, vision, health savings account or health reimbursement account, healthcare spending accounts, dependent care spending accounts, life and AD&D insurance, disability insurance;
  • 401(k) with Company match, tuition reimbursement, charitable donation matching;
  • Paid holidays and vacation, paid sick time, floating holidays, compassion and bereavement leaves, parental leave;
  • Mental health & wellbeing programs, fitness programs, free and discounted games, and a variety of other voluntary benefit programs like supplemental life & disability, legal service, ID protection, rental insurance, and others;
  • If the Company requires that you move geographic locations for the job, then you may also be eligible for relocation assistance.

Eligibility to participate in these benefits may vary for part time and temporary full-time employees and interns with the Company. You can learn more by visiting .

title: ML Ops Engineer
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


Where AI Meets Medicine: Build the Future of Drug Discovery in the Heart of Silicon Valley!

Making medicine that’s never been made means doing what’s never been done. If you’re an engineer, scientist, or builder who thrives on problems no one has solved before, this is your invitation; we want you on the team. We are ready to challenge the status quo and push medicine forward, all in the name of health. Are you up for the challenge? If so, join us!

About the Lilly and NVIDIA Partnership

Lilly and NVIDIA are launching a new AI co-innovation lab in the heart of Silicon Valley — an up-to-$1 billion, multi-year commitment to solve drug discovery’s toughest challenges. The lab brings Lilly scientists, technologists, chemists and biologists together with NVIDIA engineers under one roof. Together, we are building purpose-built foundation and frontier AI models trained on Lilly data at scale, tightening the feedback loop between automated wet labs and computational dry labs, designing the next generation of medicines for millions of patients across the globe.

What You’ll Be Doing

As an ML Ops Engineer, you build and operate the platforms that run the end-to-end machine learning lifecycle. You enable reliable model deployment, operation, monitoring, retraining, and reproducibility at scale. You optimize infrastructure and GPU resources to support research and discovery workloads. You will work closely with engineering and scientific teams to deliver production-ready AI capabilities.

How You’ll Succeed

  • Lead the operational lifecycle of ML models, including deployment, monitoring, and ongoing reliability.

  • Operate and optimize large-scale inference platforms that support scientific discovery and AI workloads.

  • Ensure models can be deployed, scaled, monitored, and maintained in production environments.

  • Test, refine, and improve model accuracy.

  • Work with data scientists, business analysts and partners to integrate ML models into broader strategies.

  • Automate the platform with infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD, and document it well enough that someone else can operate it.

What You Should Bring

  • Strong Python skills and experience working with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow.

  • Experience deploying, operating, and scaling production machine learning platforms, including model serving, monitoring, and large-scale inference workloads.

  • Experience with MLOps platforms and tools like MLflow, Weights & Biases, KServe, or similar technologies.

  • Proficiency with containerization, orchestration, and distributed compute environments (Docker, Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray).

  • Experience operating large-scale AI platforms that deploy, host, and optimize machine learning models for production use, using technologies such as Triton, vLLM, or TensorRT-LLM.

  • Experience with infrastructure automation and CI/CD practices using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, GitHub Actions, or related.

  • Experience supporting cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and on-premises GPU infrastructure.

  • Knowledge of observability and operational monitoring, including metrics, logging, tracing, and performance tuning.

  • Ability to identify and address system, infrastructure, and model performance issues through automation and continuous improvement.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with research scientists, AI engineers, and infrastructure teams in a fast-paced environment.

Your Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related technical field

  • 4+ years of experience in machine learning engineering, ML Ops, or platform engineering.

Location & Work Flexibility
This role is based at our Silicon Valley Hub. We offer a flexible hybrid work model, with three days onsite and two days working remotely each week, supporting both collaboration and work‑life balance.

title: Software Engineering 5 - Ads Agent (Agentic Platform for Enterprise)
description:

The Team

The Ads Platform Foundations team builds the core platforms, frameworks, and shared services that accelerate development across the Ads organization. We focus on enabling teams to move faster and build consistently through scalable UI infrastructure, common components, and foundational workflows. Our work also powers access control across domains and underpins core systems such as Public API, GenAI foundations, and the Ads Entity Service — a knowledge graph connecting all Ads entities. Together, we provide the technical backbone that drives consistency, reliability, and velocity across Ads.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build core platform primitives - agent framework, tool/skill registry, orchestration runtime, memory and retrieval infrastructure, evaluation harness - that other domain teams use to build their own agents and skills.

  • Define APIs/SDKs and integration patterns so domain teams can plug in their own enterprise (non-coding) use cases without rebuilding core agent infrastructure.

  • Build and iterate on the platform's tool/function-calling framework, planning/orchestration layer, memory, and retrieval subsystems.

  • Explore entity/knowledge graphs as a shared grounding/context layer that multiple agents on the platform can draw on.

  • Partner with domain teams to understand their use cases and shape the platform's building blocks and roadmap accordingly.

  • Own platform reliability, evaluation/observability tooling, and guardrails that other teams' agents inherit for free.

  • Ship fast - take things from prototype to a platform primitive other teams can adopt, with tight iteration cycles.

Must-have qualifications

  • Real, hands-on GenAI experience in enterprise contexts - not coding assistants or developer tools. Customer/partner-facing or internal process automation both count.

  • Experience building platforms, frameworks, or SDKs consumed by other engineering teams - not just point solutions. This role is about building the thing other teams build on top of.

  • Demonstrated high shipping velocity - a track record of building and launching new systems quickly and working comfortably with ambiguity. Backgrounds dominated by maintaining legacy systems are not a fit here.

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals - production-grade systems, API/SDK design, backend engineering.

  • Experience with agent-system building blocks: tool/function calling, orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), prompt/context engineering.

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with entity/knowledge graphs - modeling entities and relations, graph-based retrieval, graph databases, or graph-augmented RAG (useful as a shared grounding layer across agents on the platform).

  • Experience with agent frameworks (SpringAI, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, AutoGen) or having built comparable orchestration frameworks in-house.

  • Experience in ads/marketing tech.

  • Familiarity with evaluation frameworks for LLM/agent quality.

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. title: Principal Cloud Platform Engineer
description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. What you’ll be doing...

As a Principal Cloud Platform Engineer, you will perform tasks that are required to maintain and advance our cloud environment. This includes interfacing with tenants and peer support teams. Verizon is building the next generation unified, AI-driven automation platform “ATOM”. The goal is to leverage artificial intelligence to consolidate all automation and orchestration functions onto a single platform, eliminating redundancy and streamlining operations. As the Platform Engineer, you will drive innovation by leading engineering teams through complex problem-solving, feature implementation, and strategic alignment to build automation and orchestration for wireline and wireless networks.

You will be responsible for the following but not limited to:

  • Autonomous Operations: Using AI agents to automate network deployments, health checks, configuration audits, and service assurance.

  • Machine-readable Method of Procedures: Transforming static procedure documents into an executable format that AI agents can directly process and act on.

  • Unified Automation: Consolidating all network procedures and workflows into a single, cohesive system, making the entire network more intelligent and resilient.

  • Closed-Loop Service Assurance: Designing and implementing self-healing network frameworks that utilize real-time telemetry to trigger proactive remediation.

  • Strategic Alignment: Partnering with business stakeholders to translate complex use cases (including iEN, IP, Transport, Verizon Cloud Platform [VCP] and 5G Network Functions) into scalable platform capabilities.

  • Technical Leadership: Providing technical direction and driving innovation for the ATOM Platform by leading onshore and offshore development teams through complex problem-solving.

  • System Stability: Engaging as a subject matter expert and collaborating with quality assurance and production support teams to ensure systems operate at premium conditions.

  • End-to-End Development: Performing full-cycle application development—including design, coding, and testing—by leveraging AI tools to optimize delivery and performance.

What we’re looking for...

You are a highly skilled and credentialed technical specialist who thrives on solving complex problems and continuously optimizing network designs in fast-paced environments. A natural mentor and exceptional collaborator, you work seamlessly with diverse stakeholders and are deeply committed to understanding and exceeding your customers' expectations. By staying ahead of industry and competitive trends, you constantly push yourself and your team toward continuous improvement while effortlessly balancing multiple priorities.

You’ll need to have:

  • A degree or four or more years of work experience.

  • Six or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.

  • Experience in Cloud-Native & Automation Architecture with full-stack engineering expertise in building resilient applications, event-driven orchestration platforms, and API-first automation workflows backed by modern CI/CD practices for network infrastructure.

  • Experience in driving network design and templates through modular, reusable code architectures (such as Jinja2, YAML, and JSON data models) to abstract infrastructure complexities and ensure configuration consistency.

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

  • Agentic AI: Experience in developing Generative AI solutions and deploying advanced AI Agents within a Python ecosystem. Proven experience engineering RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architectures and utilizing vector databases alongside advanced LLM prompt engineering for major frameworks like Gemini and Claude. Deep proficiency in building orchestrations using agentic frameworks and protocols, including LangChain, LangGraph, LangFlow, and MCP Servers. Hands-on experience with AWS and GCP.

  • Expertise in Python, Linux, and/or JavaScript, advanced Git usage, working knowledge of Openstack, Kubernetes, OpenShift, or VCP WebScale.

  • Experience with Postgres SQL or MariaDB or MongoDB

  • Familiarity with next-generation AI development tools like Claude Code.

  • Experience practicing start up development methodology.

  • Experience with GitLab CI/CD or equivalent automated pipeline architectures.

  • Experience with Vue.js, FastAPI, Django, Flask, Fastify, or Temporal engine.

  • Expertise in telecom domain developing automation, orchestration and service assurance capabilities for wireline and wireless networks , with specific understanding of iEN, IP, Transport, Verizon Cloud Platform, 5G Network Functions, networking protocols and AP, ASPN, ATLAS or similar automation platforms.

  • Certifications in Agentic AI, Machine Learning, or UI/UX design.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

Where you’ll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

title: Director, Site Director Engineering Operations
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.



Position Summary:

This position is responsible for providing leadership and strategic direction to the Engineering, Maintenance, Facilities, Utilities and Environmental organization, assuring the robustness, reliability and availability of the equipment, facilities and systems required to meet production requirements and business plans.

Beyond sustaining operations, this position owns the strategy and is accountable for its execution to transform the site engineering organization toward the future — setting and delivering a multi-year digital vision and maturity roadmap that positions Manatí as a network reference site. This includes building an advanced-manufacturing ecosystem of connected assets (IoT/condition monitoring, closed-loop analytics and digital twins of critical equipment and utilities), applying advanced data analytics and artificial intelligence to engineering and reliability outcomes, establishing predictive and reliability-centered maintenance and asset-lifecycle management, and leading the site energy, sustainability and decarbonization agenda for utilities and facilities.

As the engineering business owner of digital use cases, the incumbent partners with Business Insights & Technology (BI&T). The incumbent leads the organizational change management and workforce upskilling/reskilling required to adopt these new ways of working in partnership with the learning organization business partners.

Comply with all Security guidelines, Environmental Health and Safety regulations and the current Good Manufacturing Practices required by the job function.

Responsibilities:

  • Provides leadership and support to the engineering, maintenance, capital projects, and utilities organization (e.g., optimize product quality; reduce cost; maintain equipment and facilities; select and implement new equipment and technologies; provide upgrades and modifications to facilities and support systems; provide capacity planning; create cost-reduction programs, including cycle-time reductions and yield improvement in partnership with OPEX and Finance).
  • Assures Manufacturing Operations have the equipment, facilities and systems required to meet production requirements at the highest possible quality and competitive cost.
  • Provides guidance, support and implements systems for plant commissioning efforts and assures compliance with all regulatory requirements and industry trends.
  • Leads, motivates, mentors and develops team members to meet Plant and Company goals and objectives.
  • Assures effective integration of plans and resources to achieve effective, timely project-support activities across the site within budget, using proper project-management tools.
  • Develops team members based on technical and leadership development needs; owns succession plans based on business and individual needs.
  • Owns and is accountable for executing the site engineering digital transformation strategy and roadmap, progressing the organization along the digital-plant maturity model; monitors execution, milestones and benefits realization through the engineering leadership team.
  • Establishes reliability as a core site capability — reliability-centered maintenance (RCM), FMEA-based asset criticality, predictive and condition-based (IoT) maintenance, and asset-lifecycle management — to maximize availability (OEE/MTBF/MTTR) and lower total cost of ownership.
  • Champions the application of advanced data analytics, artificial intelligence and digital twins to engineering and reliability outcomes (e.g., predictive maintenance, energy optimization, equipment-related deviation and downtime reduction), acting as engineering business owner and partnering with BI&T for system delivery, CSV and cybersecurity.
  • Owns the site energy management, sustainability and decarbonization strategy for utilities and facilities, aligning site initiatives with corporate sustainability commitments (executed through the Facilities/Utilities organization).
  • Leads organizational change management and a workforce digital-capability strategy (data literacy, upskilling/reskilling, new ways of working) to overcome adoption barriers and embed a data-driven engineering culture; may establish an engineering digital Center of Excellence.
  • Establishes the engineering performance / KPI framework and governance required to make data-driven decisions and hold the organization accountable for safety, quality, reliability, cost and delivery results; represents the site in the network and external benchmarking (e.g., ISPE / FOYA).
  • Performs other work-related activities, as required

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor Degree in Engineering (advanced degree preferred).
  • Ten 10 years of experience in a pharmaceutical or medical device manufacturing industry with five (5) years of managerial experience
  • In-depth knowledge of several manufacturing and engineering technology transfer, Total Quality Management and continuous improvement.
  • Knowledge in the area of Process Engineering, Project Planning, new product and technology transfer.
  • High level of leadership and management skills.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills in both English and Spanish.
  • Future oriented, can create competitive and break through strategies and plans.
  • Committed to continuous improvement.
  • Ability to create a learning environment leading to the most efficient and effective work processes.
  • Independent problem solving abilities and creative/innovative thinking skills.
  • Experience in planning, and developing short and long tern strategic plans to meet business initiatives in a timely manner.

We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway.

title: S4 Material Management Lead
description:
You will report directly to our Director Materials Management, and work from one of the following locations: Houston, TX, Rosemont, IL, Mobile, AL, Charlotte, NC or Shreveport, LA on a Hybrid work schedule.

The Materials Management Lead will play a critical role in the successful implementation of Project Helix, Honeywell’s SAP S4 HANA ERP platform. The scope includes Master Production Scheduling in Production Planning and Detailed Scheduling (PPDS), clear to build, schedule attainment, WIP management, capacity planning, and inventory planning.

The successful candidate must demonstrate an advanced understanding of both make and buy part master data elements. Including: BOMs (Variant Config Planning BOMs), routings and specific planning parameters relating to capacity planning and scheduling, Work Centers including scheduling formulas and shift patterns, utilization and efficiency metrics, and material masters.

Translating S4 process and terminology to clear business improvement outcomes is paramount. The “why we are doing this,” and which planning and business metric does it affect must be clearly understood. This is a business process improvement opportunity, not an IT role.

  • Serve as a primary business and process translator for the S4 HANA project.
  • Convert business operational and planning requirements into standardized, scalable SAP S4 HANA solutions.
  • Lead as is and to be process mapping, including gap identification and closure.
  • Lead design decisions and functional testing including UAT in S4 and PPDS.
  • Align planning process and functionality with the Honeywell operating model.
  • Partner with all functional stakeholders and align design decisions
  • Lead master data cleanliness and readiness to improve MRP results and implement PPDS

Responsibilities

  • 10+ years of experience in Supply Chain within a manufacturing environment.
  • Advanced SAP ERP Production Planning knowledge in manufacturing environments including ERP implementation, or transformation experience.
  • Advanced knowledge of material planning processes and key master data elements.
  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills. Must be comfortable presenting data and process to demonstrate and solve problems.
  • Strong knowledge of materials management, operations, inventory management, procurement logistics, and manufacturing.
  • Strong verbal and written English communication skills for effective stakeholder management.
  • PPDS implementation and practical use is an added advantage. An ability to successfully demonstrate work center and routing cleansing and importance to MRP and capacity planning is essential.

WE VALUE

  • Experience with S4 Hana
  • Experience with ERP implementation
  • Experience with Kinaxis or other advanced planning system
  • Familiarity with Lean Six Sigma methodologies to drive continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Knowledge of sourcing, procurement strategies, and supplier management
  • APICS, CPIM, CPSM, or CPE certification or similar preferred.
  • Certification in project management (PMP, Agile, etc.) is a plus.
  • Ability to collaborate with both internal and external customers to achieve business objectives.

ABOUT HONEYWELL

Honeywell International Inc. (Nasdaq: HON) invents and commercializes technologies that address some of the world's most critical challenges around energy, safety, security, air travel, productivity, and global urbanization. We are a leading software-industrial company committed to introducing state-of-the-art technology solutions to improve efficiency, productivity, sustainability, and safety in high growth businesses in broad-based, attractive industrial end markets. title: Analyytikko (määräaikainen), Yle Tiedolla johtaminen
description:
Etsimme innostunutta analyytikkoa kehittämään datan hyödyntämista ja analytiikkaa Ylen uutispalveluiden tueksi. Pääset tekemään palvelukehityksen analytiikkaa ja kehittämään AI-avusteista analytiikkaa sekä eksploratiivisen analytiikan menetelmiä. Jos sinulla on vahvaa kokemusta analytiikasta, näet tekoälyn mahdollisuudet suurten tietomassojen analysoinnissa, ja haluat, että työsi vaikuttaa suomalaisten media-arkeen, saatat olla juuri oikea henkilö meille!

Mitä on luvassa?

Ydintehtäväsi on olla Ylen uutispalveluita ( sekä yle-sovellus) tukeva analyytikko. Analysoit mm. käyttäjäpolkuja, uusien ominaisuuksien suoriutumista ja olet palvelukehityksen ensimmäinen kontakti kun tarvitaan tietoa päätöksenteon tueksi. Kehitämme myös AI-avusteista analytiikkaa ja pääset osallistumaan tähänkin työhön. Tulet työskentelemään useiden eri sidosryhmien kanssa sekä osallistumaan projekteihin niin operatiivisella kuin strategisellakin tasolla.

Lisäksi työtehtäviisi kuuluu:

  • Mahdollistaa datan hyödyntäminen palvelukehityksessä

  • Verkkoanalytiikan mittauksen kehittäminen ja laadun varmistaminen

  • Havaintojen ja hypoteesien tuottaminen ohjaamaan seuraavia toimenpiteitä ja auttamaan tavoitteiden saavuttamisessa

  • Projektien ja hankkeiden suunnittelu ja priorisointi yhdessä palvelukehityksen tiimien kanssa

  • Kokeilujen ja toimenpiteiden vaikutusten arviointi

  • Palvelukehityksen analytiikkatarpeiden AI-avusteisen analyysin kehittäminen

  • Uusien mittareiden ja analyysitapojen kehittämistä

  • Osallistuminen AI-avusteisen analytiikan kehittämiseen

Työssä käytät mm. Snowflakea, PowerBI:tä, SQL:ää ja AI-kielimalleja. Pääset kehittämään myös uusia käyttöliittymiä ja raportointimalleja.

Tiimistä:


Tulet tiimiin, jossa työskentelee 13 kokenutta data-, analytiikka- ja mittausasiantuntijaa. Kulttuurimme on avoin, keskusteleva ja ratkaisukeskeinen – meillä jaetaan osaamista ja opitaan yhdessä. Tukenasi ovat data-analyytikot ja -scientistit sekä mediamittauksen ja palvelukehityksen analytiikan asiantuntijat. Työskentelemme joustavasti, pääset vaikuttamaan työsi priorisointiin ja hankkeiden toteutukseen. Esihenkilö tukee roolissa kehittymistä ja antaa tilaa omille oivalluksille.

Työskentelemme matriisiorganisaatiossa, eli tulet oman tiimin lisäksi työskentelemään laajasti myös muiden yleläisten kanssa. Mm. data- ja AI-kehittäjien, journalistien sekä palvelukehityksen ammattilaisten kanssa.

Työskentelemme sujuvasti etänä ja läsnä, mutta toivomme, että pääsisit läsnätyöhön Pasilaan noin kolmena päivänä viikossa.

Tehtävä on määräaikainen sijaisuus 19.11-25.2.2028.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Sinulla on vähintään kolmen vuoden kokemus analyytikon tehtävistä, joissa kokemusta myös työstä digitaalisen liiketoiminnan parissa. Hallitset verkkoanalytiikan keskeiset mittarit ja niiden tulkinnan, eventtipohjaisen tapahtumaseurannan, seurantatunnusten toimintaperiaatteet sekä yleisimmät analytiikka- ja raportointityökalut. Osaat muuttaa datan raporteiksi ja johtopäätöksiksi, jotka auttavat liiketoiminnan kehittämisessä hyödyntäen eri työkaluja joustavasti. Vahva SQL-osaaminen on välttämätöntä

Lisäksi edellytämme:

  • Kiinnostusta AI-avusteisten data-käyttöliittymien kehittämiseen

  • Kokemusta BI- ja visualisointityökalujen käytöstä (Power BI, Tableau tms.) raporttien ja itsepalvelu-dashboardien rakentamiseen.

  • Erinomaista suomen kielen taitoa (työkieli) sekä hyvää englannin kielen taitoa.

Lisäksi arvostamme korkeakoulututkintoa tietojenkäsittelytieteestä, tilastotieteestä, analytiikasta tai vastaavasta alasta. Toivomme myös itsenäistä työskentelyotetta, jossa näkyy viimeistelty työnjälki ja kyky viedä asioita loppuun. Arvostamme myös hyviä kommunikointitaitoja ja että pystyt työskentelemään eri sidosryhmien kanssa.

Työskentelemme Snowflake ympäristössä ja katsomme eduksi kokemuksen siinä tai vastaavassa pilviympäristössä työskentelystä (esim. Databricks, Azure). Arvostamme myös työkokemusta media-alalta, erityisesti uutis- ja ajankohtaispalveluista sekä näyttöjä ja kiinnostusta digitaalisen kasvun edistämiseen, esimerkiksi kokemusta konversio-optimoinnin toteutuksista.

Miksi meille?

Yle on ainutlaatuinen talo, jolla on ainutlaatuinen tehtävä; tavoitteemme on tarjota puolueetonta tietoa, edistää demokratian toteutumista ja tarjota maan parasta mediapalvelua kaikille taustasta, äidinkielestä ja lompakon paksuudesta riippumatta.

Ylellä pääset vaikuttamaan työlläsi miljoonien suomalaisten arkeen ja osallistumaan kokonaan uudenlaisen median kehittämiseen. Työtä ohjaavat periaatteet ovat luotettavuus sekä vastuullisuus. Tavoitteena on tuottaa arvoa kaikille suomalaisille, myös niille jotka eivät tällä hetkellä käytä Ylen palveluita.

Pääset työssä pureutumaan erittäin rikkaaseen ja laajaan dataan. Ylen digitaaliset palvelut ovat suomen käytetyimpiä ja datan laatuun sekä infrastruktuuriin panostetaan jatkuvasti. Pääset myös osallistumaan kansainväliseen yhteistyöhön muiden yleisradioyhtiöiden kanssa (mm. BBC, NRK, SVT).

Yle tarjoaa kattavat henkilöstöedut, mm. joustavat työajat, osaamisen kehittämisen mahdollisuudet ja kattavan työterveyshuollon.

Kiinnostuitko?

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja CV:si viimeistään 30.09.2026. Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuajan puitteissa.

Palkkaukseen eteneville henkilöille toteutetaan heidän suostumuksellaan turvallisuusselvityslain tarkoittama henkilöturvallisuusselvitys.

title: Radar Requirements Analyst
description:

  • Develop briefings, point papers, and trace reports for prime item development specification and relevant system model deliveries
  • Coordinate support from supporting personnel as needed, provide concise instructions and expectations to assist in managing databases and models
  • Evolve current requirement management practices in response to changing information system capabilities

  • Provide technical direction to Test Readiness Reviews (TRRs), Technical Interchange Meetings (TIMs), Design Reviews (PDR, CDR, FDR)

What Required Skills You'll Bring:

  • Active Secret clearance or higher
  • Bachelor's Degree in a STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics) or related field, or equivalent work experience that meets guidelines established for job
  • Master's Degree or equivalent, may be preferred at this level
  • 8+ years of related professional experience
  • Knowledge and application of (or interest in) Model Based System Engineering environments and SysML experience (CAMEO)
  • Experience with DOORS and/or DXL/Macro scripting

What Desired Skills You'll Bring:

  • Bachelor's degree and 20+ years working on a missile defense-related or other complex, large DoD program/project or radar system or a Master's degree and 12+ years working on a missile defense-related or other complex, large DoD program/project or radar system
  • Experience with radar operation or radar acquisition
  • Knowledge of Electronic Warfare principles
  • Review of verification results of Prime Item Development Specifications
  • Works independently, applying engineering rigor to analyze and resolve problems within a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Ability to self-manage and initiate within a team structure
