title: Program Manager Product Cost - Golf Ball
description:
The Golf Ball Cost Manager has a pivotal role on the TaylorMade Global Operations team, offering a remarkable opportunity for candidates with strong supply chain and technical backgrounds. In this position, you will spearhead the cost assessment and strategy of existing and new products, working closely with our R&D, Engineering, Finance, and leadership teams. The primary focus of this role will be centered around identifying the true costs of vertically integrated golf ball products, and those at external suppliers, and increasing product margin in those products. To be successful in this role you will need to apply specific skills sets and knowledge such as activity-based costing, demand planning, and financial modeling to help create the supply chain strategy for TaylorMade golf ball.

We are seeking a candidate who has extensive costing knowledge and can conduct on-site negotiations with internal and external vendors. This individual should be genuinely passionate about optimizing operations, reducing costs, and implementing strategic initiatives. The ability to create relationships and influence stakeholders is essential. This role reports directly to the Associate Director of Purchasing and Capacity Planning for TaylorMade golf ball and offers a compelling career path for supply chain professionals eager to make an impact in the golf industry.

Essential Functions and Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead activity-based costing initiative to identify cost by product type and facility.
  • Lead Cross-functional team in golf ball margin initiative by identifying and implementing cost reduction projects across vertically integrated facilities and external suppliers.
  • Build financial models to aid senior leadership with capital investment ventures.
  • Create and present golf ball supply chain strategy initiatives to senior/executive leadership.
  • Lead the solicitation and evaluation of supplier proposals/quotations, negotiating prices and terms to achieve cost optimization.
  • Provide leadership, insights, and support on cross-functional new product introduction teams.
  • Support the development of analytical models and tools to better understand the relationship between design and cost drivers.
  • Establish and maintain a price quoting process for domestic and foreign suppliers.
  • Manage and update price lists and price revision history for each product and supplier.
  • Create cost roll-up documents for all new product introductions.
  • Research pricing trends of commodities critical to TaylorMade’s supply chain.
  • Facilitate cost reviews and propose new design-for-manufacture cost options in collaboration with R&D, Engineering, and Product Creation.
  • Represent the sourcing function in weekly development and new product introduction meetings.
  • Develop and manage a sourcing strategy to enable faster and more cost-effective delivery of TaylorMade’s ball business category.
  • Perform other related duties and assignments as required.

Knowledge and Skills Requirements:

  • Fluent verbal and written English communication skills are required.
  • Manufacturing expertise, including knowledge of various processes such as injection molding, automated painting, and packaging.
  • Cost analysis and negotiation expertise
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Suite, especially Excel
  • Experience in lean manufacturing and continual process improvement.
  • Ability to identify and drive manufacturing process changes.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to engage with external and internal stakeholders.
  • Ability to build relationships and establish credibility across the organization.
  • Proficient at simplifying complex data for presentation to diverse management levels.
  • Familiarity with Business Objects and DOMO, or Oracle

Education, Work Experience, and Professional Certifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or related field
  • Master of Business Administration or other graduate degree preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in a costing, new product introduction, product development, sourcing, or engineering function
  • Continuous education efforts that support project management, leadership, sourcing strategy, and supply chain metrics

Work Environment / Physical Requirements:

  • Normal office conditions with extensive computer and phone usage.
  • Ability to work extended hours as necessary.
  • Able to work efficiently and accurately in an atmosphere of frequent interruption.
  • Light physical effort equal to frequent lifting or moving of lightweight materials.
  • Frequent travel domestically and internationally may be required.

TaylorMade is a performance driven organization and our total rewards approach to compensation is designed to support this. We consider many factors in determining base compensation, including position scope, job related knowledge, education, skills, experience, and work location. The expected annual base pay range for this position is $100,000 - $115,000. description:

While global in presence and reach, ours is a close, collaborative community of just over 3,000 professionals. Lazard is a place of continuous knowledge sharing, skill development and relationship building, where professionals grow and succeed together. Our entrepreneurial culture, flat structure and embrace of individual differences, allow creative ideas, original concepts, and unique perspectives to drive our business forward — and for careers to take flight.

Through our financial advisory business, Lazard advises clients around the world on strategic and financial matters including mergers and acquisitions, restructurings, capital structure and capital raising. Our client relationships are built on trust and discretion. As the world’s largest advisory-focused firm, we have exceptional depth of expertise across industry sectors and geographies. We value the rich diversity that comes from blending local perspective with our global network.

Analyst - Equity Advisory Team – London

Lazard is seeking to recruit an Analyst to join the Equity Advisory Team in London. This position will play a central role on transactions and client interactions, as well as contribute to the team’s collegiate culture, reporting into senior bankers.

As the leading independent IPO advisory team in EMEA, Lazard has advised on landmark deals over the last decade, with a strong pipeline for the upcoming years. The team is also involved in capital raisings, secondary selldowns and supporting the broader capital solutions and M&A teams on a range of transactions.

We are looking for an enthusiastic, motivated, and outgoing individual with a clear interest in equity capital markets to join our team in London.

We’ll trust you to:

  • Demonstrate strong technical and analytical skills.
  • Research, analyse and evaluate qualitative and quantitative data; financial and statistical analysis/modelling.
  • Conduct company and industry analysis on new transaction opportunities.
  • Assist with the execution of transactions in an efficient manner.
  • Be responsible for assisting in the preparation and production of presentations and marketing materials for clients and prospective clients in consultation with senior team members.
  • Identify issues arising in transactions and assist in conducting due diligence.
  • Develop sound and logical commercial views, focusing on both big picture and minutiae.
  • Effectively manage your own work; take responsibility for accuracy, quality, consistency, and grammar.
  • Assist senior bankers on an ad hoc basis as needed with various reports and analyses.
  • Contribute to firm wide initiatives including recruiting, training, professional development, and other activities.

title: Distribution Lines Designer - Fairlea, WV
description:
FirstEnergy at a Glance

About the Opportunity

The Distribution Designer is responsible for the designed construction, relocation, and new business work for the Distribution function of the Company. The Designer leverages customer service, software use, and learned expertise in design standards and regulatory requirements.   • Facilitating billing functions for line extension and applicable relocation work, including billing recommendations in non-routine scenarios.
  • Facilitating completion of outage management system (OMS) follow-up requests, inspection and maintenance repairs, streetlight installation and replacement, claims, Transmission priority repairs, and aerial patrol findings.

Qualifications

  • Associate Degree in a technical discipline is required.

  • Strong communication ability to guide decision-making or consensus, negotiate acceptable outcomes, and diffuse challenging situations.
  • Willing to seek guidance and advice to fill gaps in understanding.
  • Self-motivated and able to manage shifting priorities.
  • Able to interpret complex written and visual information, such as procedures, manuals, drawings, and schematics.
  • Able to gain working familiarity with standards, codes, regulations, electrical systems, construction methods, equipment, and safety requirements, including practical applications.
  • Able to gain proficiency in software applications including Microsoft Office, SAP, customer request work scheduling (CREWS), outage management system (OMS), and graphic work design (DDS).
  • Willing to participate regularly in emergency and storm-related activities, including the ability to work additional hours and/or modified schedules when necessary.

title: Specialist Family Violence Practitioner - The Orange Door
description:
Number of Positions Available:

1

ABOUT US

The Salvation Army is a Christian movement and one of Australia's largest and most-loved charities. We believe in doing good that transforms lives and futures for the better. It is this belief which drives us to find new ways and places where we can make a difference. From times of personal crisis to moments of national grief, we are always here — providing support, safety, community, and opportunity.

Why this role matters

The Salvation Army (Salvos) provides a wide range of services that support women and women with children impacted by family and domestic violence. We offer accommodation, counselling, support, behavioural programs, and advice to women and children at risk of, experiencing or escaping family violence. Our services focus on prevention, restoration, and healing to provide specialised support to address immediate safety issues and provide advice, referrals, and connection to assist the recovery journey. We also deliver high quality, safe and and effective responses to adults who use family violence so that the risk they pose can be assessed and they are held to account for their behaviour.

About the role

Employed by The Salvation Army within The Orange Door network, as a Specialist Family Violence Orange Door Practitioner, you will play a critical role in delivering integrated, high-quality support to individuals and families experiencing family violence across the Inner Gippsland area. Working within a multidisciplinary Orange Door team, you will assess and respond to the needs and risks of victim survivors, children and families, while maintaining a strong focus on perpetrator accountability and behaviour change.

Reporting to the Team Leader, this is a permanent full-time position, based on-site in Morwell VIC.

Conditions

Compensation is in accordance with SCHADS Award Levels 5-6 (dependant on qualifications and experience).

How you will make an impact

  • Conduct risk assessments, triage and crisis responses for adults using family violence
  • Deliver targeted interventions and coordinated referrals that support behaviour change and accountability
  • Work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team to assess risk and develop integrated support plans
  • Provide interim case management and support to clients while facilitating access to appropriate services
  • Contribute to a culture of continuous learning through training, reflective practice and professional development

What you will bring

  • Must hold or be ‘working towards’ an Australian Qualification Framework (AQF) Level 7 or above qualification in family violence or a related discipline. AQF Level 7 qualifications include Bachelor Degrees, Graduate Certificates, and Master Degrees
  • Qualifications must align with the Mandatory Minimum Qualification Requirements for Specialist Family Violence Practitioner (Recommendation 209)
  • Experience working in the family violence sector with an emphasis on adults who use violence is desirable
  • Demonstrated knowledge of the physical, emotional, psychological, and behavioural impact of trauma and abuse
  • Knowledge of Family and Domestic Violence including context, principles, philosophies, theories, policies, regulations, and legislation
  • A current Victorian Driver's Licence
  • A current Employee Working with Children Check

What we offer

The Salvos offer eligible employee's a well-balanced package of meaningful benefits including:

  • Salary packaging up to $15,900 tax free + $2,650 meal entertainment benefit
  • Generous Paid Parental leave for primary (12 weeks) & secondary carers, Purchased Leave Scheme (up to 8 weeks) and 5 days paid leave per year to experience working in other TSA programs or activities
  • Access to EAP and health & wellness initiatives incl Fitness Passport
  • Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander supports such as: Burra Burra Network (pastoral care network), Cultural Events, Sorry Business and Ceremonial Leave (up to 10 days)
  • Ongoing training and development opportunities that enhance on the job skills and proficiency
  • Rewarding and fulfilling purpose driven careers that have positive and sustainable / social impacts

How to apply

If you’re passionate about making a difference and ready to join a team dedicated to creating positive change, please submit your resume and cover letter detailing your alignment with the requirements of the role. Together we can build a brighter future.

Applications will close as soon as a suitable candidate is secured.

The Salvation Army is an Equal Opportunity Employer who provides an inclusive work environment and embraces the diverse talent of its people. We value people of all cultures, languages, capacities, sexual orientations, gender identities and/or expressions. We are committed to achieving a diverse workforce and strongly encourage applications from Aboriginal people and Torres Strait Islander people.

The Salvation Army is a child safe organisation and is committed to protecting children and young people from harm. All child facing roles will require the successful completion of a Working with Children Check. Applicants for all roles require a mandatory Nationally Coordinated Criminal History Check.

We value Integrity, Compassion, Respect, Diversity, and Collaboration

title: Senior Community Infrastructure Planner
description:
Senior Community Infrastructure Planner

Reference number: 11308

Closing date: 11:00pm, Sunday 4 October 2026

  • Full-time permanent position.
  • Salary commencing at $112,111.93 per annum, plus 12% superannuation, commensurate with skills and experience.
  • Band 7.

The Opportunity

Join Moonee Valley City Council as a Senior Community Infrastructure Planner and play a key role in planning for the community facilities and infrastructure needed to support future population growth and changing community needs. You will undertake evidence-based community infrastructure needs analysis, identify opportunities for new and improved facilities, and support the development of projects through Council’s investment framework.

Working collaboratively across Council and with a diverse range of stakeholders, you will provide specialist strategic advice on community infrastructure planning and contribute to the development of innovative solutions that deliver equitable community outcomes. You will also support the ongoing monitoring and evaluation of Council’s community infrastructure network, ensuring robust information is available to inform asset renewal, upgrades and future investment decisions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Undertake community facility and infrastructure needs analysis using evidence-based planning models and available data.
  • Identify innovative solutions for the provision of community facilities and contribute to the development of project business cases.
  • Maintain a strong evidence base to support community infrastructure network and project planning through research, data analysis and stakeholder engagement.
  • Provide specialist strategic advice and advocacy on community infrastructure planning matters.
  • Lead and contribute to the planning and delivery of new community infrastructure projects.
  • Develop comprehensive project plans, manage risks and coordinate project delivery to achieve agreed outcomes, timelines and budgets.
  • Build and maintain effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including government agencies, community service providers and other partners.
  • Support improved asset management planning, evaluation and decision-making relating to community infrastructure.

Skills & Experience

You will have a degree or postgraduate qualification in Strategic Planning, social sciences or a related discipline, or an alternative tertiary qualification supported by extensive experience in community infrastructure planning. You will bring extensive experience in community infrastructure planning, policy development, strategic planning and project management, ideally within a government or local government context. You will have strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, experience researching and interpreting strategy, policy and legislation, and the ability to develop innovative solutions and successful project business cases. Your highly developed communication, negotiation and stakeholder management skills will enable you to build strong partnerships across diverse sectors, lead cross-functional project teams and achieve effective outcomes. Experience with asset management systems, processes and evaluation tools, budgeting and capital works programs, as well as experience leading teams to deliver projects on time and within budget, will be highly regarded.

Next Steps

Calendar and events:

Improves student learning through the facilitation of collaborative team time to support teacher and school growth in at least one of the following areas: rigorous and relevant curricula in daily and long-term planning; equity in instruction to close achievement gaps through culturally responsive teaching practices and improved supports for English language learners; and use of student data including Data-Driven Instruction (DDI) and Student Learning Objective (SLO) progress monitoring.

title: Strategic Sourcing Intern
description:
Join a Company That’s Redefining Air and Improving Lives

At Broan-NuTone, we don’t just lead the residential ventilation industry in North America, we’re shaping its future. Through innovation, ingenuity, and a relentless focus on quality, we’re on a mission to be the most trusted and forward-thinking manufacturer of residential ventilation solutions.

Our impact is everywhere: in more than 110 million homes across North America, where our products help families breathe easier every day. In fact, we move nearly 13 trillion cubic feet of fresh air annually; a testament to the scale and significance of what we do.

Behind that impact are our 2,000+ entrepreneurs working across four countries, driven by a shared passion for innovation and excellence. Our products are crafted in our three manufacturing facilities and supported by a network of trusted partners. Together, we bring to life a powerful portfolio of industry-leading brands, including Broan-NuTone, Zephyr, BEST, and Venmar.

We’re proud to foster a collaborative, high-energy culture where ideas thrive, innovation is encouraged, and people feel empowered to make an impact.

Our purpose is simple yet powerful: improving lives through better air. Every product we create is designed to make homes healthier, more comfortable, and longer lasting; helping families flourish and giving professionals solutions they can trust. It’s meaningful work we can stand behind.

Part of Something Bigger

Founded in 1932, Broan-NuTone is a cornerstone of Madison Air, one of the fastest-growing companies transforming the future of air. In April 2026, Madison Air went public on the New York Stock Exchange (MAIR), reflecting its remarkable growth and momentum. Today, Madison Air includes:

Business Job Title: Strategic Sourcing Intern

Job Summary:

The Strategic Sourcing Intern will work closely with Commodity Managers, Supply Chain professionals, Engineering, Finance, and Operations teams to support sourcing initiatives, supplier engagement activities, data analysis, and new product development projects. This role provides hands-on exposure to strategic sourcing, supplier management, cost reduction initiatives, and cross-functional business operations.

This internship is designed for a motivated student who is eager to gain practical experience within a fast-paced manufacturing and supply chain environment while developing analytical, communication, and project management skills.

Intern Details:

  • Duration: Full-time Summer opportunity – Hybrid role

Job Responsibilities:

  • Support Group Commodity Managers in sourcing activities, supplier bid processes, and cost reduction initiatives.
  • Assist with supplier RFQs, bid package preparation, pricing analysis, and supplier evaluations.
  • Participate in cross-functional teams focused on commodity strategies, value analysis, and productivity improvement programs.
  • Support sourcing activities within the New Product Development (NPD) process
  • Analyze supplier, spend, and commodity data to identify cost-saving opportunities and business insights.
  • Create reports, presentations, and business summaries for sourcing and leadership teams.
  • Attend supplier meetings and support negotiation preparation activities.
  • Assist with process improvement projects and contribute ideas to enhance sourcing effectiveness and operational efficiency
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Engineering, Operations, Quality, Finance, and Supply Chain.

Job Requirements:

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Operations Management, Engineering, Finance, or a related field.
  • Junior or Senior standing preferred.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.
  • Ability to interpret and analyze data to support sourcing and business decisions.
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Word.
  • Demonstrated organization, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Ability to work independently while also contributing effectively in a team environment.

Preferred Skills (not required):

  • Previous internship, co-op, campus leadership, project, or work experience.
  • Interest in procurement, strategic sourcing, supply chain management, manufacturing, or operations.
  • Experience working with data analysis, business intelligence tools, or ERP systems.
  • Negotiation, project management, or supplier-facing experience.
  • Participation in ASCM or other professional student organizations.
  • Fluency in Mandarin Chinese, French, or Spanish is a plus.

What the Intern Will Gain

  • Hands-on experience supporting real business projects and department priorities.
  • Exposure to professional tools, systems, and workplace expectations.
  • Opportunities to build communication, problem-solving, and collaboration skills.
  • Mentorship and feedback from experienced professionals.
  • Greater understanding of potential career paths within the organization.

Schedule and Duration

This internship is expected to run from Tuesday June 1, 2027 through Friday August 21st, 2027. The anticipated schedule is full time during the summer, with work performed hybrid based on business needs.

title: Senior Associate
description:
We are mission-driven to advance wellbeing across the Quality of Life ecosystem through impactful leadership. Come join us!

THE ROLE

The Senior Associate’s primary role is to manage the initial candidate identification and development process. In addition, the Senior Associate will assist Consultants, Principals, and Senior Partners in generating, managing and/or executing search assignments including potential candidate development, screening and presentation to clients, cultivating and/or maintaining client and candidate relationships.

As a vital member of the search team, you will have the ability to network with professionals and assist them in achieving their career objectives in organizations committed to improving the quality of life, assess a candidate’s skills against a client’s needs, and collaborate with colleagues across the firm.

This position offers a base salary of $85,000 to $110,000. In addition to base salary, this role offers a semi-annual bonus opportunity under a production-based incentive program. With no cap on earnings, the plan provides meaningful earnings to reward strong contributions to business and revenue growth. Salary within our ranges is determined by your education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as required by the role, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. WittKieffer offers a full benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401k, life and disability insurances, and generous paid time off.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Actively participate in and/or lead the search process including, but not limited to, working with clients and search committees, sourcing, interviewing, conducting references, negotiating, and closing assignments.

  • Build, manage, and/or nurture client and candidate relationships with a goal of repeat business.

  • Participate in and/or lead client calls and meetings.

  • Prepare materials for client meetings and presentations.

  • Ability to build and maintain strong client relationships.

  • Support search consultants in the execution of search engagements. This includes creating search engagement strategies necessary to identify outstanding candidates and then executing the candidate identification and profiling processes through a variety of primary and secondary sources.

  • In conjunction with the search consultant and client, develop an effective and compelling presentation to market the role and client company to prospective candidates. Communicate position profile to potential candidates.

  • Understand the client position needs thoroughly, and execute accordingly, contacting, identifying, and screening candidates for the position "fit," from a content and functional perspective.

  • Participate in candidate development. When appropriate, will manage candidates through the search process, including candidate interviews, candidate presentations, and referencing.

  • Conduct preliminary phone screen evaluations of candidates and assess a candidate's skills against a client's needs through a telephone interview.

  • Proactively network and seek out the candidates in an expeditious and most cost-effective manner.

  • Work closely with lead consultants as well as Research and Data Management.

The Senior Associate will be expected to accomplish the following in the first 12 months:

  • Demonstrate an understanding of the full search process.

  • Demonstrate an understanding of the role a WittKieffer Senior Associate plays in the search process.

  • Carry a full search load (approximately 10 searches).

  • Have the ability to travel as needed.

  • Demonstrate ability to appropriately assess potential candidate eligibility through telephone screening.

  • Be seen by others as collaborative.

  • Live the WittKieffer values.

  • Gain a firm understanding of the industry their practice operates.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Qualifications:

  • A Bachelor’s degree is required; Master’s strongly preferred.

  • 5+ years' experience in executive search, research capacity, or recruitment or industry related experience.

  • Significant previous experience and skill working with computer systems, databases, email, etc.

  • Strong assessment skills.

  • Strong communication skills (verbal, written, listening).

Critical Competencies:

  • Strong Work Ethic: Search work activities and project outcomes often are defined by criteria outside of a senior associate's span of control. A senior associate's level of effort and thoroughness of process are factors that are proportional to a successful outcome.

  • Team-Based and Collaborative: A successful search involves a team comprised of administrative staff, researchers, data managers, associates, consultants, and other personnel who support operations. It is essential that everyone be aware of the value of each member's role and be quick to award credit.

  • Action/Results Oriented: Focused on the outcome of personal and teamwork; does not get bogged down in process; enjoys working hard and seizing opportunities; pushes self and others for results.

  • Customer Focused: Concerned for and dedicated to satisfying external and/or internal customers; works hard to understand needs of customers and can adjust work style and products accordingly.

  • Priority Setting: Spends own and other's time on what is important; zeroes in on critical few and puts "the many" aside; demonstrates good time management skills.

  • Assessment Skills: Has a nose for talent; can articulate strengths and weaknesses of people after short exposure; can separate performance and potential; makes accurate appraisals of others.

  • Process Management: Manages multiple activities simultaneously; uses resources effectively and efficiently; creates processes to manage workflow and gets more out of fewer resources.

  • Ethics and Values: Models firm values during both bad and good times and reinforces the right values in others.

  • Listening: Attentive and active listener; hears people out; allows others to participate in conversations without dominating; gets the point of what others are saying.

  • Results Oriented: Adherence to identified process is important, but timeliness of work product and search completion within the client's parameters is key.

  • Self-Starter: Each senior associate assumes the role of project manager. An individual more comfortable with being given a systematic timetable will not be successful in this environment where initiative is key to success.

Witt/Kieffer Inc. ("WittKieffer") provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants. WittKieffer will recruit, employ, train, promote and compensate our employees without regard to race, religion, creed, color, national origin, citizenship, gender, pregnancy, military status, age, marital status, sexual orientation, sexual identity, disability or any other personal characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law. WittKieffer will endeavor to make reasonable accommodation, as required by law, for qualified individuals with known disabilities or religious practices unless doing so would result in an undue hardship on the operation of our business.

title: Platform Specialist
description:
The Platform Specialist provides operational support for assigned product platform activities. Working together with the Platform Manager, this individual prepares recurring reports and day-to-day analyses, tracks agreed actions and deadlines, coordinates inputs from cross-functional and regional teams, and helps translate global priorities into clear regional information and follow-up. The role contributes to defined projects and deliverables but does not own platform strategy, pricing decisions, portfolio direction, or people management.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Product Platform Reporting and Coordination Support:

  • Supports the Platform Manager by maintaining platform trackers, action logs, timelines, and recurring reporting.

  • Collects and consolidates inputs from Product Management, Marketing, Sales, R&D, Operations, and regional teams.

  • Performs routine market, competitor, sales, and business performance analyses using defined sources, tools, and templates.

  • Prepares dashboards, summaries, and presentation materials and escalates relevant findings or data gaps to the Platform Manager.

  • Coordinates ideation and project review meetings, records decisions, and follows up on agreed actions with responsible stakeholders.

  • Supports regions in understanding and translating global platform priorities, tools, and messages into regional execution requirements.

  • Day-to-Day Portfolio Analytics and Follow-up:

  • Maintains pricing, margin, profitability, sales, and product performance files using agreed definitions and templates.

  • Monitors recurring business indicators, identifies variances, and prepares factual summaries for review by the Platform Manager.

  • Tracks new product introduction milestones, launch requirements, and outstanding actions, escalating delays or missing information.

  • Coordinates regional data collection and supports the consolidation of inputs for strategic planning, forecasts, and business reviews.

  • Maintains accurate documentation, shared files, and version control for platform reports and presentations.

  • Regional Translation and Innovation Coordination Support:

  • Coordinates product application information, training materials, and approved technical resources for regional Sales and Marketing teams.

  • Organizes customer, supplier, and internal follow-up activities as assigned and ensures actions are recorded and communicated.

  • Supports the R&D Program Manager and Corporate Technology teams by scheduling reviews, consolidating updates, and tracking agreed innovation actions.

  • Collects compliance inputs from Environmental Health & Safety and other subject-matter experts and shares approved information with relevant regions.

  • Monitors product availability information from production and supply teams and communicates potential service issues through established channels.

  • Supports trade and industry event preparation, captures market information, and summarizes relevant insights for internal stakeholders.

Scope

  • Personnel: Individual contributor.
  • Budget: None
  • Sales Revenue: Business Unit Specific.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Chemistry, Materials Science, Data Analytics, or a related field.

  • Less than one year of relevant experience, including internships, apprenticeships, graduate placements, or other early-career experience in product management support, marketing, business analysis, project coordination, or a commercial or technical environment

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to maintain trackers, coordinate inputs, and follow actions through completion.

  • Good analytical skills and proficiency in Excel and presentation tools; familiarity with reporting, dashboard, data-visualization, or analytics tools is an advantage.

  • Basic familiarity with AI tools and an interest in using approved generative AI and automation solutions to support research, data analysis, reporting, presentations, and routine coordination activities.

  • Ability to work with structured data, recognize trends and inconsistencies, and translate analytical outputs into clear, factual summaries under guidance.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional and regional stakeholders.

  • Comfort working in a global matrix environment and supporting the translation of global priorities into regional actions and communications.

  • Curiosity, reliability, and willingness to learn about products, markets, customers, and internal business processes.

  • Experience in manufacturing, specialty materials, regulated products, or multilingual and cross-regional coordination is preferred but not required.

title: Estimator
description:
Position Summary:
The Estimator is responsible for creating accurate quotations for preventative fire asset services. This role combines technical estimation with essential administrative tasks. The primary focus is on estimation (70–80% of the role) while also offering support in documentation, invoicing, and maintaining records using our asset software.

Job Details:

  • Work Set Up: The role begins with an on-site training. Once training is complete, the position can be performed from home.
  • Shift: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM (Perth/Manila time).
  • Holidays Followed: The position follows Australian public holidays. There is a shutdown towards the end of the year (Dec 21 to Jan 4, 2026) During this time you need to use your leaves to offset the non-holiday days.
  • Training Details: The training program includes approximately two weeks of remote online training to cover asset software, videos, and assessments, followed by 1 to 1.5 weeks of on-site training. Additional refresher onsite sessions may be provided every six months as needed.


Responsibilities:

  • Prepare service defect quotations accurately and within the set tolerance levels.
  • Complete general (non-defect) service quotations promptly following the company pricing structure.
  • Ensure technicians’ defect notes are clear, correct, and legible; escalate issues to the appropriate supervisors or managers when needed.
  • Process repairs and callout task invoicing in line with company targets.
  • Provide general administrative support, including handling emails, scheduling tasks, and compiling reports.
  • Maintain and update site information and contacts in the FSS asset software.
  • Support the leadership team and other departments to help achieve overall service excellence.


Qualifications:

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in estimation, preferably in the fire protection or preventative fire services field.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to interpret defect reports and technician notes accurately.
  • Familiarity with estimating software, especially “uptick.”
  • Experience with soft asset software is a plus.
  • Willingness to participate in both remote and on-site training sessions and adapt to a hybrid work role.

title: Production Clerk - 1st Shift
description:

This role starts at $21.00 per hour for entry-level candidates. We also consider experience when determining starting pay!

Hours: 7:00AM - 5:30PM Monday through Thursday / Fridays as needed

  • Assist with the cycle count process, complete cycle counts and investigate inventory discrepancies

  • Recording plant metrics and or key performance indicators (KPIs).

  • Monitor and maintain min/max levels, reorder points, & safety stock levels for maintenance, safety & operating supplies.

  • Troubleshoot operator SAP data entry errors, investigate barriers to job closure, etc

  • Print process orders, pick tickets and labels for production team

  • Monitor and maintain inventory levels for operating, safety and maintenance supplies

  • Effectively utilize purchasing software (Coupa) to purchase non-BOM materials, maintain vendors and maintain accurate pricing

  • Own, manage and improve upon production CANBAN systems for inventory management

  • May assist with updating and maintaining production training records

  • Manage time and communication via Microsoft Outlook

  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED

  • Computer proficiency

  • Proficient with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.)

  • Experience with an ERP (SAP preferred) system

  • Experience with an MRO Purchasing system (Coupa preferred)

  • Strong math, measurement, and reading skills

  • Ability to interact effectively and professionally with others in a team environment

  • Abilities in prioritization, multi-tasking and problem solving while maintaining strong attention to detail

Additional Qualifications

  • Personal Skills - Quantitative Skills, Self-Motivated, Ability to Multitask, Ability to Work Independently, Time Management

title: Executive Director, PDS Communications
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.



Position Summary
Reporting to the Vice President, Research & PDS Communications, the Executive Director, PDS Communications, leads the development and execution of an integrated communications strategy for Bristol Myers Squibb's Product Development & Supply (PDS) organization. This role serves as a strategic advisor to PDS leadership, translating business strategy into impactful
internal, external, and executive communications, managing enterprise reputation and issues,and positioning BMS's commitment to quality, reliability, and innovation across development, supply, manufacturing, and technical services. Leading a team of communications professionals, the Executive Director participates in the relevant PDS and Corporate Affairs
leadership forums and is accountable for delivering measurable communications outcomes across the PDS portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and evolve the integrated PDS communications strategy, aligning to business priorities and delivering measurable impact across internal and external stakeholders.

  • Serve as a strategic advisor to the PDS organization's executive leadership, anticipating communications needs and providing proactive counsel on opportunities and risks.

  • Develop and oversee distinct communications plans for core PDS business priorities – spanning Product Development, Global Supply Chain, Global Quality, MS&T, the Global Business Unit, CTDO, and Global Technical Services – integrated with broader PDS and BMS enterprise objectives.

  • Maintain relationships and visibility with PDS operating-unit and function leadership teams to support cohesion across all PDS Communications workstreams.

  • Partner with the BMS corporate communications and Leadership Communications teams to ensure PDS communications are aligned with enterprise strategy.

  • Oversee development and execution of organizational communications that promote employee engagement and understanding of PDS business strategy through town halls, leadership messages, internal videos, and other channels across distinct working environments.

  • Set and oversee PDS external communications strategies to support BMS enterprise reputation through proactive media relations, digital and social content, industry associations, awards and rankings, events, speaking engagements, and other strategically aligned initiatives.

  • Manage issues and special situations that may disrupt PDS operations and pose risk to enterprise reputation and stakeholder relationships.

  • Manage agency partners and corresponding budgets effectively, ensuring disciplined stewardship against strategic priorities.

  • Lead, manage, and develop a high-performing team, promoting a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Approximately 15 years of communications experience in the pharmaceutical, life sciences, or related industries is preferred, or a combination of professional experience that provides an equivalent career foundation in a large organization or agency setting.

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in journalism, communications, public relations, or a related field.

  • Proven experience crafting strategic communications plans and providing strategic counsel to senior executives across a complex, matrixed organization.

  • Exceptional writing, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.

  • Strong leadership and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.

  • Demonstrated experience executing integrated internal and external communications and issues management across owned, earned, social, and paid media.

  • Strong business and industry acumen, including an understanding of development, quality, supply, and manufacturing operations.

  • Understanding of ethical generative AI use in writing and content development.

  • Demonstrated people-management and talent-development abilities, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and delegate effectively across matrixed organizations.

title: Summer Intern | Competition Practice | London
description:
Who We Are:

We are one of the world’s leading economic consulting firms. We strive to recruit and develop talented people to work together to produce meaningful economic analysis of exceptional quality, and to create a positive impact on our clients and society.

Our Competition Practice provides expert economic advice on competition policy, economic and financial regulation, public policy and the assessment of damages in complex disputes.

We are looking to hire junior economists to help us to provide advice to our clients on some of the most high-profile cases before the European Commission, the General Court and national competition authorities, regulators and courts.

We believe that working in diverse teams, where everybody’s views are considered and respected, helps us to deliver work of the highest standards of quality and integrity.

About the role:

We pride ourselves on providing Interns with an opportunity to make a significant impact from day one. As an Intern you will gain extensive hands-on experience of working at an economic consultancy. You will contribute to cases in a variety of ways, working closely with senior staff to understand the issues that face the client, relating those issues to relevant economic theory, and supporting the analysis with solid and persuasive empirical evidence.

Interns typically join us for 8 to 12 weeks during, in-between, or shortly after completing their economics degree(s). Please indicate in your cover letter when you would be available to start your internship.

For those applying whilst completing their Bachelor's degree, please note that our Intern candidates are usually hired in their final year. We would consider only exceptional second-year students. If you are in your second year and unsuccessful in your application, we would encourage you to apply again next year.

Applications for a Summer 2027 start close on 29th January 2027.

Key responsibilities:

  • Analysing qualitative and quantitative client data to better understand how competition works in their industry

  • Reviewing literature and contributing to discussions about the theoretical and empirical approach

  • Conducting empirical analysis using Excel and Stata

  • Drafting reports summarising analysis

  • Participating in client meetings and conference calls

Skills/profile sought:

  • Currently undertaking or recently completed Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Ph.D. in economics, ideally with a focus on microeconomics, industrial organisation and/or econometrics

  • Highly analytical

  • Strong organisational and communication skills

  • Accuracy and attention to detail

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team

  • Stata and Excel skills desirable

Benefits of working at Compass Lexecon:

  • Competitive salary and benefits

  • A wide variety of interesting and challenging projects

  • An international team with a broad range of backgrounds and experience

  • A blend of professional and academic environments

  • The opportunity to work with top law firms, corporations, government bodies and academics

  • A steep learning curve, coupled with a supportive and collaborative team

  • The opportunity to contribute from day one

When drafting your application:

We ask all applicants to provide their most up to date CV, cover letter and transcripts.

We acknowledge that AI is now commonly used for drafting, however we emphasize the importance of personalization to truly reflect your unique experiences. We are able to recognise applications that are solely created using AI and those that demonstrate individuality.

What happens next?

Once your application has been submitted, you will receive an email confirmation outlining next steps.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. We encourage interested candidates to apply as soon as possible.

What does our interview process look like?

Our interview process for Interns includes one 60-minute interview with both motivational and technical questions. All interviews are currently being conducted virtually.

Compass Lexecon is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We appreciate that recruitment agencies may have speculative CVs that they wish to submit to Compass Lexecon. To avoid any ambiguity around fees, please note that speculative CVs received by Compass Lexecon, that have not been authorised in advance by the Recruitment team, will be ineligible for an agency fee.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analysing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Director Sustainability Central Europe
description:
Director Sustainability Central Europe

Location:

Maastricht Op De Bos Office

At Sibelco, we advance life through materials.
For over 150 years, we’ve been a trusted leader in sourcing, transforming, and distributing specialty industrial minerals. Our work powers progress across industries as diverse as glass, ceramics, construction, coatings, polymers, and water purification. Beyond our materials, we’re proud of our commitment to sustainability, innovation, and empowering people from all walks of life to thrive and make a meaningful impact.

Are We the Perfect Match?

At Sibelco, we believe building a successful career is a two-way journey. We’re looking for individuals who share our values and vision, just as much as you’re seeking a company that aligns with your aspirations. Together, we can shape the future.

Job Description:

Director Sustainability Central Europe

Role Information

Location: Region of Maastricht preferred, with flexibility possible for candidates based elsewhere in the Netherlands or in Belgium.
Working model: Hybrid, with regular presence at operational sites important for permitting, stakeholder engagement and team collaboration.

Regional scope: Belgium, the Netherlands, Germany, the Czech Republic, Poland and Ukraine.
Reports to: Vice President Sustainability
Contract: Permanent | Full-time

Are you passionate about sustainability and the environment, looking for a leadership role with real ownership and the opportunity to influence long-term business decisions? As Director Sustainability Central Europe at Sibelco, you will join a supportive and collaborative global Sustainability team, lead Sustainability Managers and Specialists across the region, and play a key role in shaping the environmental agenda for Central Europe. With significant autonomy and visibility, you will influence long-term decisions around land, permitting, quarry development and environmental performance. This is a leadership role for someone who wants to stay close to the action — not only setting direction and reviewing results, but actively engaging in key permitting, land and environmental matters alongside the team. It is a rare combination of regional leadership and hands-on environmental work.

Your Impact In This Role

We are seeking a pro-active and hands-on Director Sustainability to lead the sustainability activities across the Central Europe sub-region, covering Belgium, the Netherlands, Germany, the Czech Republic, Poland and Ukraine, while also actively managing permitting and land files in the base country.

You will be responsible for securing and maintaining the legal and social licence to operate across the sub-region, obtaining permits and managing land-related matters in the base country, ensuring effective reporting on environmental and sustainability performance and contributing to the development and execution of Sibelco’s ESG strategy.

The Director Sustainability is part of the sub-regional leadership team and works closely with the global sustainability team. You will report to the Vice President Sustainability.

Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

  • Lead the sustainability activities across the sub-region to ensure activities are performed according to Sibelco’s standards.
  • Obtain environmental and mining permits, manage land, conduct environmental impact studies and engage with communities in the base country.
  • Be the direct manager of the Sustainability Managers and Specialists in the sub-region.
  • Identify, manage and monitor environmental and sustainability risks and opportunities in the operations in the sub-region and support them to improve their environmental compliance.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of global sustainability programs, projects, and key performance indicators (KPIs) across key focus areas, including GHG emissions, water stewardship, waste management, biodiversity and mine closure planning.
  • Ensure accurate, timely and effective reporting.
  • Act as a business partner towards the Sub-regional Vice President and the sub-regional leadership team.
  • Be a proactive member of the global sustainability team.

What You Bring to the Table

  • University degree in law, geology or engineering, or a similar field, or an equivalent combination of studies and experience.
  • Minimum 7 years of work experience in environmental management, sustainability or a similar field.
  • Experience working with authorities, regulators, communities and NGOs.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of environmental legislation and its practical application in an industrial environment.
  • A pragmatic, hands-on approach, with strong communication skills and strong environmental expertise.
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to translate complex environmental matters into clear, concise messages for senior leadership, while maintaining a broad practical understanding of environmental management, permitting and stakeholder engagement.
  • Native Dutch and fluent English. Other languages are an asset.

About the Role

This role combines leadership responsibility with hands-on environmental involvement.

You will manage sustainability professionals across the sub-region while remaining directly involved in key environmental and permitting matters in the base country. As part of the Sub-regional Leadership Team, you will work closely with Operations and other key functions, combining environmental expertise with a strong understanding of the wider business.

With Sibelco’s long-term approach, you will have the opportunity to influence areas such as land acquisition, quarry development, permitting, environmental performance and stakeholder relationships.

The role offers significant autonomy, ownership and senior-level exposure, while being part of an international sustainability team.

Employee Type:

Permanent

Sibelco is more than a workplace—it’s a community that encourages growth, innovation, and collaboration. Here’s what you can look forward to when you join our team:

  • Meet Our People: Careers

  • Learn About Our Recruitment Process: Learn More

  • Discover Our Sustainability Goals: Sibelco priorities

We also welcome applications from all backgrounds and are committed to providing reasonable adjustments to support you through the selection process.

How to Apply

Follow us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Twitter/X and Facebook to learn more about life at Sibelco. Submit your application in the Apply option.

description:
If you're ready to be part of our legacy of hope and innovation, we encourage you to take the first step and explore our current job openings. Your best is waiting to be discovered.

Night - 12 Hour (United States of America)

This is a Stanford Health Care job.

A Brief Overview
Perform diagnostic and therapeutic clinical procedures as defined in the Respiratory Care Services scope of clinical practice. Work performed in accordance with physician orders or protocols. Defined duties are performed in adult patient populations. This is an entry level position.

Locations
Stanford Health Care

What you will do
  • Administration of aerosolized medications via handheld nebulizers (HHN), metered dose inhalers (MDI), dry powder inhalers (DPI), large volume continuous nebulizers, and intrapulmonary percussive ventilation (IPV);
  • Administration of medical gases via nasal cannulas, oxygen masks, high flow nasal cannulas, and large volume nebulizers;
  • Performing routine tracheostomy care, weaning, and downsizing;
  • Assembling and assuring safety and proper functioning of all equipment /supplies necessary for providing respiratory care;
  • Documentation of results, findings, and assessments in the patient’s electronic medical record;
  • Performing airway clearance using chest physiotherapy (CPT), vibratory positive expiratory pressure devices, cough assist device, or nasotracheal suctioning;
  • Assessing pulmonary mechanics using portable spirometry devices;
  • Responding to cardiopulmonary arrests and rapid response calls;
  • Responds to calls and provides therapy to patients requiring emergency care for non- traumatic conditions;
  • Educating patients, families, physicians, nurses, and other members of the health care team about routine respiratory procedures, medications, modalities, and disease processes;
  • Providing continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP) or biphasic positive airway pressure (BiPAP) for patients who require ventilatory support;
  • Providing invasive ventilation for medically stable patients who use such devices at home;
  • Performing arterial blood gas sampling and analysis;
  • Oversees and trains staff and community college students working on general medical floors.

Education Qualifications
  • AMERICAN MEDICAL ASSOCIATION (AMA) APPROVED RESPIRATORY CARE PROGRAM WITH RECEIPT OF AN ASSOCIATE LEVEL DEGREE
  • BACHELOR’S DEGREE PREFERRED.

Experience Qualifications
  • No Previous Respiratory Care Experience Required

Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
  • Ability to adjust communications to fit the needs and level of understanding of the receiver;
  • Ability to think critically, conduct analysis, formulate conclusions, and reflect on practice;
  • Ability to process equipment and utilize personal protective equipment to reduce risk of infection;
  • Understanding of commonly used medical terminology;
  • Knowledge of new technologies, changes in practice, or updates relating to respiratory care;
  • Knowledge of the principles of health, hospital, and clinic organization and administration;
  • Knowledge of the indications, contraindications, and hazards of respiratory therapies, anatomy, physiology, and pathophysiology related to the cardiopulmonary system;
  • Ability to provide superior customer service along with quality respiratory care to positively impact patient experience and outcomes

Licenses and Certifications

Blood Borne Pathogens

title: Access Control Officer VA - Part-Time (Top Secret w/Poly)
description:
This part-time Access Control Officer position supports a high-security environment in Warrenton, Virginia and is intended to provide coverage for scheduled shifts, weekends, holidays, or other staffing needs. The role is responsible for controlling access to restricted areas, verifying credentials and required clearances, screening for prohibited items, monitoring alarms and surveillance systems, conducting patrols, escorting authorized visitors, and responding to incidents in accordance with site procedures, customer requirements, and applicable security standards. Candidates must meet the stated minimum qualifications and complete the formal application process to be considered.

Key Responsibilities

  • Control access to designated facilities, sensitive areas, and classified information in accordance with security protocols and clearance requirements.
  • Verify employee, visitor, and vendor identification, credentials, and authorizations before granting entry.
  • Operate access control systems, badge readers, biometric devices, handheld screening equipment, and related security technology.
  • Monitor cameras, alarms, and surveillance systems to identify and respond to suspicious activity or potential security breaches.
  • Conduct screening for prohibited items, devices, and materials at established checkpoints.
  • Escort visitors and non-cleared personnel in sensitive areas during construction, maintenance, and other critical activities.
  • Assist with site evacuations, emergency response activities, drills, and other security events, including active threat scenarios when required.
  • Perform routine foot patrols, including walking and stair climbing, to verify physical security barriers and compliance with site procedures.
  • Document access control activity, incidents, inspections, and security logs accurately and completely.
  • Partner with site leadership, security teams, and government representatives to report and resolve incidents promptly.
  • Support continuous improvement of access control processes, procedures, and site security measures.
  • Provide professional customer service while consistently enforcing security standards and protecting sensitive information.
  • Complete required training and comply with company policies, federal regulations, and clearance-related requirements at all times.

Required Qualifications

  • Active Top Secret clearance required; Full Scope Polygraph preferred.
    Candidates must be able to meet customer and site access requirements, including any additional clearance processing required for the assignment.
  • High school diploma or equivalent; additional security training or certifications are a plus.
  • Experience in access control, physical security, screening, or a related protective services role.
  • Knowledge of access control systems, physical security procedures, alarm systems, and surveillance technology.
  • Ability to stand for extended periods, conduct screening activities, and perform foot patrols indoors and outdoors in varying weather conditions.
  • Ability to walk long distances during a shift and work independently during patrols and screening assignments.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow standard operating procedures precisely.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with employees, visitors, clients, and vendors.
  • Ability to remain calm under pressure, resolve conflicts professionally, and enforce screening and access policies consistently.
  • Sound judgment, reliability, and the ability to prioritize tasks and make decisions in a fast-paced, high-security environment.
  • Flexibility to work day, night, weekend, holiday, and extended shifts as needed to maintain minimum staffing levels.
  • High ethical standards, discretion, and commitment to confidentiality.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to walk approximately 3 to 5 miles during a shift.
  • Ability to stand for up to 60 minutes at a time and remain on your feet for extended periods.
  • Occasional climbing of ladders.
  • Frequent climbing of stairs and ramps.
  • Occasional lifting of up to 50 pounds.
  • Occasional pushing or pulling of 50 to 75 pounds with an assistive device.
  • Normal near, far, and peripheral vision, with correction if applicable.
  • Normal color vision where required for job duties.

title: Senior Systems Engineer– Low Voltage Systems
location: Milford, Michigan, United States of America
description:
Job Description

The Team:
The Low Voltage Infrastructure Team within the Embedded Platform Systems & Infrastructure organization is focused on the development of systems and controls centered around on-vehicle low voltage power generation, energy storage, power management, distribution, and consumption on ICE, EV and PHEV vehicle platforms. There is no better time to join this domain as we evolve to the next generation of low voltage power strategy, innovation, and capability in current product VIP and the next generation on SDV2.0.

The Role:
As a Senior Systems Engineer - Low Voltage Systems, your technical expertise in low voltage power consumption will be leveraged throughout the entire vehicle development life cycle, including requirements, design, testing, and problem resolution.

You will own and define specific low voltage system functions through understanding of customer use cases and expectations. You will drive GM’s industry leadership of optimized low voltage consumption by defining low voltage energy consumption use cases, setting consumption targets, analyzing and driving reductions in power consumption for complex devices and features, and assessing competitor low voltage consumption performance.


What You'll Do (Responsibilities):

  • Define low voltage energy use cases, lead low voltage system performance requirements development and decomposition, and set energy consumption targets for components and features.
  • Define and own various low voltage system functions, driving their implementation through the System Technical Specification.
  • Ensure traceability of system requirements and targets to hardware subsystem and ART solution requirements.
  • Develop test requirements and ensure test case traceability to requirements and targets.
  • Analyze and summarize status to energy consumption targets based on use cases.
  • Analyze competitive performance with respect to power consumption reduction and optimization strategies. Drive action to the appropriate organizations to address gaps.
  • Lead complex trade-off decisions, buy-offs, and escalation of power consumption issues with vehicle and product teams.
  • Develop, maintain, and produce technical documentation and system specifications with tools such as DNG. Track changes and issues using Jira.

Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications):

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering.
  • 5+ years of automotive engineering experience related to embedded controls, requirements development, architecture development, and/or systems engineering.
  • Ability to process a large amount of information flow, identify multiple parameters, interdependencies and inconsistencies to provide both high-level systems overview and deep domain expertise.
  • General understanding of vehicle electrical architectures, communication protocols, and ECU wakeup strategies.
  • Solid understanding of the major vehicle systems.
  • Deep knowledge of Systems Engineering principles and a proven track record of successful implementation.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in writing and comprehending software and hardware requirements and interfaces.

People Skills:

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, including independent judgement and decision-making skills, where problems are very unusual and extremely difficult.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple complex projects and assignments with a high level of autonomy and accountability for results.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability of leading cross-functional teams, influencing without direct authority, and building relationships in difficult circumstances.


What Will Give You A Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications):

  • Master's degree in Engineering with a focus on Controls, Electrical, Mechanical, and/or Systems Engineering.
  • Experience analyzing, estimating, and reducing low voltage power consumption of vehicle components, ECUs, and features.
  • Proficiency in Agile processes and built-in quality concepts such as Behavioral Driven Development.
  • Experience executing production programs through launch.
  • Proven expertise in low voltage power consumption analysis and reduction.
  • Record of innovation in systems, subsystems, or feature design: patents, awards, or publications.
  • Development experience with Software Defined Vehicle electrical architecture.
  • Experience with requirements management tools (i.e. DOORs, DNG, Markdown, etc.)
  • Experience with change management tools (i.e. Jira, GIT, etc.)
  • Experience leveraging simulation environments and plant modeling for testing or requirements generation is a plus (e.g., MATLAB/Simulink, D-Space HIL, SIL, ETAS Inca, etc.)

title: Director, Franchise Platform
description:
A Day in the Life:

The Director of Franchise Platform is responsible for shaping and executing Hertz’s global franchise platform strategy, creating a scalable and differentiated offering that provides franchisees with the products, services, tools, and support needed to succeed. Reporting to the Global Head of Franchise Growth, this role owns the franchise platform roadmap and translates Hertz’s brand strength, capabilities, and expertise into a market-leading franchise proposition that enhances the overall franchisee experience.

This highly collaborative and execution-focused leader partners across regions and functions to identify franchisee needs, align stakeholders, and drive delivery of key initiatives. The Director ensures the platform balances global consistency with local market flexibility while improving franchisee profitability, customer experience, network performance, loyalty, and trust through effective cross-functional leadership and accountability.

The starting salary for this role is $120,000, commensurate with experience.

What You'll Do:

Platform Leadership & Proposition Ownership:

  • Lead the Franchise Platform success pillar, translating the Franchise Growth strategy into a clear, prioritized, and sequenced multi-year roadmap across all brands and regions
  • Own a portfolio of franchise platform design & build initiatives from business case through design, pilot, launch, adoption, continuous improvement, and benefits realization
  • Execute the build out of a market leading global franchise value proposition with the appropriate balance between a consistent global core and regional / local flexibility
  • Work with regional teams to set measurable outcomes for adoption, franchisee satisfaction, customer experience, service quality and financial performance

Franchisee Insight & Experience:

  • Create a fact-based view of franchisee platform needs across the full lifecycle, from onboarding and mobilization through day-to-day operation, growth, renewal, and transformation
  • Translate common pain points and unmet needs into a prioritized platform roadmap, using co-design and pilots to validate value before scaling
  • Simplify how franchisees discover, access, understand, and use Hertz capabilities, creating a consistent experience across functions, regions, and brands

Products, Services & Platform Innovation:

  • Work with relevant Hertz teams to build capabilities and continuously improve a coherent portfolio of franchise-facing products and services
  • Execute initiatives to build a consistent, sustainable, and scalable franchise offering
  • Develop commercial models for new platform services
  • Build a disciplined franchise innovation pipeline that identifies, tests, scales, improves, or retires propositions based on franchisee value, strategic fit, adoption, and financial impact

Execution, Adoption & Value Realization:

  • Represent the Franchise business as the accountable owner of platform initiatives working with and mobilizing cross-functional teams
  • Establish disciplined governance and execution best practice, maintaining visibility of progress, dependencies, investment requirements, risks, critical decisions, and benefits delivery
  • Assign clear product and service owners, delivery milestones, acceptance criteria, resource plans, and accountabilities across each initiative
  • Provide concise executive reporting and recommendations, escalating barriers early and securing the decisions and resources required to deliver at pace

What We’re Looking For:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Marketing, Economics, or a related field.
  • A Master’s degree (MBA or similar) is advantageous but not required
  • Extensive experience in franchise development, growth, or expansion, ideally within multi‑location, service‑based, or mobility‑focused industries
  • A proven track record of driving franchise network and platform growth
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to evaluate business cases, assess franchisee financials, and build compelling growth strategies
  • Demonstrated success in building and managing high‑value relationships with prospective and existing franchise partners, acting as a trusted advisor and strategic partner
  • Exceptional communication and influencing skills, with the ability to present to senior leaders, negotiate agreements, and represent the brand externally
  • A data‑driven mindset with the ability to interpret market insights, performance metrics, and competitive intelligence to inform decision‑making
  • A proactive, growth‑oriented mindset with the ability to identify new opportunities, challenge the status quo, and drive continuous improvement

What You’ll Get:

title: Protective Security Intelligence Analyst
description:
Create your best future and join Westpac as a Protective Security Intelligence Analyst.

What’s the role?

If you're naturally curious, love connecting the dots and can turn complex information into clear, actionable insights, this could be the role for you.

As a Protective Security Intelligence Analyst, you'll help identify, assess and respond to threats that could impact Westpac's people, customers, operations and reputation. Working within a highly experienced Protective Security team, you'll gather and analyse information from a range of sources, including open-source intelligence, social media, internal reporting and specialist intelligence platforms.

This is a role where investigative thinking and intelligence analysis come together. One day you might be building a threat assessment, the next you're supporting a protective security investigation or preparing an executive briefing on an emerging risk.

Your work will help leaders make informed decisions during incidents, investigations and rapidly evolving situations. You'll join a collaborative team with deep expertise across intelligence, law enforcement, military and protective security backgrounds, offering a unique opportunity to learn from experienced professionals while contributing your own perspective and expertise.

This is a permanent, full-time role based in Sydney / Warrane, Gadigal Country, with flexible hybrid working arrangements available. Standard working hours are 38.5 hours per week, with some flexibility required during security incidents or urgent intelligence matters.

What do I need?

  • Proven experience in intelligence, investigations, protective security, law enforcement, journalism, or a comparable analytical discipline
  • Strong understanding of intelligence collection, structured analytical techniques, threat assessment methodologies, and intelligence production
  • Demonstrated experience using OSINT and SOCMINT ethically, safely, and in accordance with policy requirements
  • Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to identify patterns, emerging risks, intelligence gaps, and concerning behaviours from diverse information sources
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear, concise, and executive-ready intelligence products
  • High levels of integrity, discretion, and professionalism when handling sensitive and confidential information

Highly desirable:

  • Experience in financial services, corporate security, investigations, or regulated industries
  • Experience using intelligence platforms, social media monitoring tools, and vendor intelligence systems
  • Understanding of protective security threats such as insider risk, protest activity, fixated persons, criminal threats, cyber-enabled physical security risks, and geopolitical developments

Why join us?

We’re obsessed with becoming our customers' #1 banking partner for life and we’re looking for people who are passionate about helping us achieve that goal. In return, we’re committed to making Westpac the best place to work in the country. Here are just a few of the ways we’re already doing that:

  • Special offers on banking products and discounts from top brands, including generous employee-only mortgage rates!
  • Flexible work arrangements to help you achieve a greater work/life balance, and a variety of leave options including Culture, Lifestyle and Wellbeing leave.
  • Tailored learning and development opportunities to help your grow your career within the bank.
  • Lots of opportunities to ‘give back’ to the Community by getting involved in our many volunteering initiatives.

We’re all about creating a supportive and inclusive community. We welcome everyone – no matter your age, gender, background, or abilities. We also provide additional support to welcome our veterans, Indigenous Australians and neurodiverse community.
