title: Associate Director, Data & Analytics
description:
Grant Thornton is seeking a Data & Analytics Associate Director to join the team. Approved office locations can be found below.

Associate Director, Data & Analytics – Position Summary:

Grant Thornton GTech’s vision is centered around enabling scalable, secure, and repeatable data integration capabilities that support enterprise transformation, mergers and acquisitions, and modern analytics. The Data & Analytics function is responsible for designing and delivering governed data solutions that connect critical business and technology systems while enabling trusted reporting, archival, and analytics at scale.

The Associate Director, Data & Analytics will be responsible for designing and implementing data pipelines within enterprise standards that support the integration of systems from acquired companies, as well as data archival in Snowflake. This role will partner with data architecture, enterprise architecture, application teams, security, infrastructure, implementation partners, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable, governed, and reusable data integration capabilities that support M&A integration, operational continuity, compliance, analytics, and long-term data asset management.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement enterprise data pipelines that support the integration of systems, applications, and data assets from acquired companies.
  • Build data ingestion, transformation, validation, and archival patterns that align with enterprise data architecture, security, governance, and operational standards.
  • Implement data archival solutions in Snowflake that support acquired-company integration, historical reporting, data retention, compliance, and future analytics needs.
  • Partner with data architecture and enterprise architecture teams to ensure pipeline designs follow approved architecture patterns, naming conventions, metadata practices, access controls, and integration standards.
  • Collaborate with M&A integration, application, infrastructure, security, and business teams to understand source-system requirements, data dependencies, integration timelines, archival needs, and target-state usage patterns.
  • Translate business, technical, and integration requirements into data pipeline designs, data mappings, transformation logic, quality rules, and deployment plans.
  • Develop and maintain scalable data engineering processes for batch, incremental, and event-driven data movement, where appropriate, across enterprise platforms and acquired-company systems.
  • Establish data quality checks, reconciliation routines, exception handling, monitoring, and operational controls to ensure pipelines are reliable, auditable, and production-ready.
  • Support data migration and archival activities by coordinating source extracts, transformation rules, target loading, validation outcomes, and issue resolution across internal and partner teams.
  • Work with analytics and reporting stakeholders to ensure integrated and archived data assets are structured to support downstream business intelligence, analytics, AI, and operational reporting use cases.
  • Partner with implementation vendors and technology teams to coordinate delivery activities, resolve blockers, validate deliverables, and ensure adherence to enterprise standards.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, including data flow diagrams, pipeline specifications, source-to-target mappings, operational runbooks, metadata, and support handoff materials.
  • Support go-live readiness, cutover planning, data validation, post go-live hypercare, and transition of pipelines to steady-state data operations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve data engineering patterns, automation, reuse, performance, cost efficiency, data observability, and operational supportability.
  • Act as a data engineering leader within the Data & Analytics function, promoting strong engineering discipline, secure data handling, and consistent implementation practices.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in data engineering, data integration, data architecture, analytics engineering, application integration, or related enterprise technology roles.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing production data pipelines using modern ETL/ELT, orchestration, data warehousing, data lake, or cloud data platform technologies.
  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake, including data loading, transformation, schema design, performance considerations, access patterns, and operational support concepts.
  • Experience integrating data from multiple enterprise systems, acquired-company systems, SaaS platforms, ERP systems, operational applications, or legacy technology environments.
  • Strong understanding of source-to-target mapping, data transformation, data validation, reconciliation, data quality, metadata, lineage, and pipeline monitoring practices.
  • Knowledge of enterprise data architecture standards, data security, access management, privacy, data retention, archival patterns, and governed data delivery practices.
  • Experience working with business stakeholders, application teams, architects, security, infrastructure, vendors, and delivery partners to translate requirements into implemented data solutions.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced integration environment with multiple priorities, dependencies, delivery milestones, and business continuity requirements.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and business audiences.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Analytics, Business, or related field required; advanced degree or relevant cloud/data certifications preferred.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience supporting merger, acquisition, divestiture, or acquired-company technology integration programs.
  • Experience with cloud data platforms and tools such as Snowflake, Azure Data Factory, Databricks, dbt, Informatica, Fivetran, Matillion, Airflow, or comparable data engineering technologies.
  • Experience with data archival, historical data retention, legacy system decommissioning, or compliance-driven data preservation initiatives.
  • Familiarity with analytics and reporting platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, or comparable business intelligence tools.
  • Experience operating in a professional services, consulting, accounting, or complex global enterprise environment.
  • Experience developing reusable pipeline frameworks, engineering standards, data platform runbooks, and operational support models.

Success Measures

  • Data pipelines for acquired-company system integration are delivered in alignment with enterprise standards, scope, timeline, and quality expectations.
  • Snowflake archival solutions are reliable, governed, validated, discoverable, and structured to support retention, reporting, analytics, and future reuse.
  • Source-to-target mappings, data quality checks, reconciliation outcomes, pipeline documentation, and operational handoffs are complete and supportable.
  • Integration and archival activities protect business continuity during cutover, go-live, and post go-live hypercare.
  • Data engineering patterns are reusable, secure, cost-aware, and aligned with enterprise data architecture and governance expectations.

The base salary range for this position is between $172,000 and $250,000. Placement within the pay range is at Grant Thornton’s discretion, and it is based on multiple factors, including but not limited to, job-related knowledge/skills, experience, business needs, progression within the role, geographic location, and internal equity. At Grant Thornton, compensation decisions are dependent upon the facts and circumstances of each position and candidate.

title: Test Analyst, AI
description:
Overview
The AI Test Analyst is responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and effectiveness of AI-powered solutions, including generative AI applications, intelligent agents, and AI-enabled business processes. The role focuses on validating AI models and outputs, assessing data quality, monitoring performance, and ensuring adherence to Responsible AI principles, regulatory requirements, and organizational standards.
The role supports the adoption of AI-driven testing practices by leveraging automation, innovative testing techniques, and AI-enabled tools to improve testing efficiency and coverage. It also contributes to the development of testing capabilities across the organization by promoting best practices and supporting the upskilling of testing teams in AI and automation technologies.
As MUFG Retirement Solutions continues to integrate AI across its products, services, and testing functions, the AI Test Analyst plays a key role in embedding AI into testing processes, identifying cost-effective quality assurance solutions, and ensuring that testing strategies align with business objectives, quality standards, and the organization's AI transformation agenda.

Key Accountabilities and main responsibilities
Strategic Focus
  • Develop and execute testing strategies for AI, Machine Learning (ML), and Generative AI solutions to ensure accuracy, reliability, performance, and business value.
  • Establish and maintain test automation frameworks and scripts that support various types of testing, such as functional testing, integration testing, API testing, system testing, model validation, data validation, API testing, system testing, and end-to-end AI solution testing.
  • Validate AI model outputs against defined acceptance criteria, business requirements, and responsible AI standards.
  • Ensure comprehensive testing coverage across the AI lifecycle, including data ingestion, preprocessing, model training, inference, output validation, and reporting.
  • Assess AI solution performance across dimensions such as accuracy, relevance, consistency, explainability, fairness, robustness, and reliability.
  • Integrate AI testing activities and test automation framework & scripts with continuous integration, CI/CD pipelines and tools to support continuous testing and deployment of AI solutions.
  • Collaborate with developers, business analysts, product owners, and project managers to define testing requirements, success criteria, and quality measures.
  • Manage the execution of automated test suites, monitor the test results and collaborate with teams to troubleshoot and resolve the issues promptly.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage AI-driven testing tools and automation techniques to improve testing efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Research emerging AI testing methodologies, tools, technologies, new test automation tools and industry best practices, providing recommendations for continuous improvement.
  • Support the establishment and adoption of enterprise standards, processes, and quality controls for AI testing and validation.
Operational Management
  • Design, develop, execute, and maintain test cases and test scripts for AI, ML, and Generative AI applications.
  • Validate data quality, data integrity, and data lineage across AI systems and supporting platforms.
  • Perform functional, integration, API, regression, user acceptance, and end-to-end testing of AI-enabled solutions.
  • Evaluate AI model outputs for accuracy, consistency, bias, hallucinations, and compliance with business requirements and existing processes.
  • Execute prompt testing, response validation, and scenario-based testing for Generative AI solutions.
  • Monitor test execution results, analyse outcomes, and produce accurate and comprehensive test reports.
  • Identify, document, track, and support resolution of defects, model performance issues, and data quality concerns.
  • Collaborate with business analysts, developers, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver high-quality AI solutions.
  • Support test data preparation, environment validation, and model release verification activities.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance AI testing frameworks, processes, and automation capabilities.
  • Provide knowledge sharing and support to project teams regarding AI testing approaches, tools, and best practices.
Governance & Risk
  • Identify quality, model, data, security, privacy, ethical, and compliance risks associated with AI solutions and proactively support mitigation activities.
  • Validate adherence to Responsible AI principles, regulatory requirements, organizational policies, and governance standards.
  • Support the assessment and reporting of AI-related risks, including model bias, explainability, fairness, and data quality concerns.
  • Maintain appropriate test evidence, validation reports, defect records, and audit documentation to support governance and compliance requirements.
  • Escalate risks, issues, and control gaps that may impact AI solution quality, regulatory compliance, or business outcomes.
The above list of key accountabilities is not an exhaustive list and may change from time-to-time based on business needs.

Experience & Personal Attributes
Experience
  • 3+ years of experience in Quality Engineering, Test Automation, and AI-driven testing, with preference for candidates having 2+ years of experience in Retirement Solutions, Financial Services, or BFSI domains.
  • Strong experience in designing, developing, and executing test automation solutions using tools such as Selenium, Appium, UFT/OpenText (at least one mandatory), Python, Maven, Postman, REST APIs, SoapUI, Cortex, and Snowflake.
  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted testing tools and technologies for test case generation, test optimization, defect prediction, intelligent test execution, quality analytics, and test automation.
  • Experience in validating AI/ML-enabled applications, including model testing, data quality validation, prompt testing, response evaluation, hallucination detection, bias and fairness testing, explainability validation, adversarial testing, and assessment of AI model accuracy, reliability, and performance.
  • Strong understanding of software testing principles, methodologies, and best practices, including test planning, test design, test execution, defect management, reporting, governance, and quality assurance processes.
  • Solid understanding of SDLC and SQA processes across Agile, Waterfall, and DevOps delivery models.
  • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices using Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Azure Repos, Bitbucket, Git, Docker, and Kubernetes.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to define quality standards, automate validation processes, and ensure reliable, scalable, and secure AI-driven applications.
  • Experience with cloud platforms, data validation, API testing, integration testing, and end-to-end testing across complex enterprise environments.
  • Design, develop, and execute comprehensive test strategies, test plans, and test cases for functional, integration, system, regression, API, and end-to-end testing across applications, data, and reporting layers.
  • Collaborate closely with Business Analysts, Developers, Product Owners, and other stakeholders to define test scenarios, automate test cases, and ensure quality throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Develop and maintain automated testing solutions leveraging both traditional and AI-powered testing tools to improve testing efficiency, coverage, and quality.
  • Validate AI-powered applications, intelligent agents, and machine learning models by assessing model accuracy, reliability, performance, fairness, explainability, and compliance with Responsible AI principles.
  • Perform prompt testing, response validation, hallucination detection, adversarial testing, and evaluation of AI outputs against business requirements and expected outcomes.
  • Execute API, data, integration, and end-to-end testing to ensure data integrity, system interoperability, and reliable business process outcomes.
  • Manage defects and quality issues using tools such as JIRA and Azure DevOps, including defect tracking, root-cause analysis, reporting, and resolution support.
  • Produce test evidence, quality metrics, and test execution reports to support audit, compliance, and governance requirements.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of testing frameworks, methodologies, and automation practices, identifying cost-effective solutions and opportunities for innovation.
  • Provide guidance, support, and training to team members on AI-enabled testing tools, automation technologies, and quality engineering best practices.
Personal Attributes
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Attention to detail and quality-driven mindset
  • Good communication and teamwork skills
  • Proactive and eager to learn

title: Reproduction & Cryogenics Technician
description:
At Guiding Eyes for the Blind, we are passionate about connecting exceptional dogs with individuals seeking greater independence. We are dedicated to creating and supporting life-changing partnerships between people and dogs.

At our facilities, we breed, raise, and train exceptional guide dogs – and match them with individuals ready to embrace a life of greater freedom, confidence, and possibility. Together, they embark on incredible life adventures. As the Director of Genetics, you will play a part in making that happen! Join us and help be a part of transforming lives.

Our incredible dogs make our mission possible – and working with them will inspire you! We put our clients first, striving to exceed their expectations by providing exceptional dogs trained to meet their unique needs and empower them to live the lives they choose.

The Reproduction & Cryogenics Technician plays a key role in supporting Guiding Eyes' breeding and genetics programs and the long-term success of future guide dogs. Through specialized reproductive, cryogenic, and laboratory expertise, this position helps advance genetic stewardship, reproductive health, and biological resource management while contributing to a sustainable breeding colony that meets the organization's current and future needs.

Working collaboratively with internal teams and external partners, this role supports the continuous improvement of breeding program outcomes and helps advance best practices in canine reproduction, genetics, and biobanking in support of the organization's mission.

At Guiding Eyes, you'll work alongside passionate, caring professionals who are united by a love of dogs and a shared commitment to our mission. Together, we help provide each dog with the foundation needed to succeed while supporting the individuals whose lives will be changed by their partnership.

If you're looking for meaningful work in a collaborative and purpose-driven environment, we'd love to hear from you.

The Role

Canine Reproduction & Breeding Support

  • Perform canine reproductive procedures to support optimal conception rates and litter outcomes, including vaginal cytology, blood collection, progesterone testing, semen collection and evaluation, natural breeding, vaginal insemination, and transcervical insemination (TCI).
  • Analyze and interpret semen quality parameters, including motility, morphology, concentration, and viability.
  • Maintain accurate and complete breeding and reproductive records.
  • Provide occasional weekend breeding and reproductive support as needed.
  • Safely handle and restrain dogs while following animal welfare and safety protocols.

Cryogenics & Biobank Management

  • Support operation of the frozen semen cryobank through semen collection, processing, cryopreservation, extender preparation, and post-thaw evaluation.
  • Monitor cryogenic storage tanks daily and measure liquid nitrogen levels weekly to ensure proper storage conditions.
  • Maintain accurate records of semen analyses, cryogenic storage locations, inventory status, and quality control assessments.
  • Maintain the DNA Biobank by coordinating sample collection, cataloging specimens, managing freezer inventory, and ensuring accurate tracking and documentation of all samples.

Genetics & Breeder Screening

  • Assist with breeder candidate screening and evaluation activities.
  • Collect and prepare blood and cheek swab samples for genetic testing.
  • Organize testing materials, coordinate sample shipment, and ensure accurate data entry and recordkeeping.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and external partner organizations to support genetic diversity and reproductive health initiatives.

Laboratory Operations & Quality Management

  • Maintain laboratory equipment through routine preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, vendor coordination, and timely escalation of repair needs.
  • Clean, disinfect, and prepare reusable laboratory equipment and supplies according to established protocols.
  • Manage inventory and procurement activities, including ordering supplies, gathering vendor quotes, processing invoices, and maintaining inventory levels within budget guidelines.
  • Develop, maintain, and update standard operating procedures (SOPs) for reproductive, cryogenic, and laboratory processes.
  • Ensure new procedures are properly documented, validated, and communicated to relevant staff.

Research, Training & Program Support

  • Support canine health and breeding program research projects as assigned.
  • Cross-train designated staff on reproductive procedures and laboratory processes to ensure consistent program coverage.
  • Support Health Survey initiatives through record review, correspondence management, volunteer coordination, data entry, and record organization.
  • Assist with additional genetics, reproduction, and departmental projects as assigned.

Qualifications You Will Need

Required Qualifications

  • Undergraduate degree in Animal Science or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Valid driver's license

Professional Skills

  • Minimum of two (2) years of experience in animal care, veterinary medicine, animal reproduction, laboratory sciences, genetics, or a related field. Experience working with canine reproductive procedures, biological sample collection, or laboratory operations preferred.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, reliable, and capable of maintaining accurate records and documentation.
  • Experience collecting biological samples and working with medical or scientific terminology.
  • Experience handling dogs in a clinical, veterinary, breeding, research, or similar professional environment.
  • Demonstrated flexibility and adaptability, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a dynamic, mission-driven environment.
  • Commitment to continuous improvement and operational excellence.

Communication & Collaboration

  • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a collaborative team environment.
  • Strong relationship-building skills with the ability to find a common purpose, build consensus, and foster collaboration across teams.
  • Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Experience partnering with cross-functional teams to achieve organizational goals.
  • Ability to engage effectively with employees, volunteers, donors, and other community stakeholders.

Technical & Physical Requirements

  • Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office programs; Salesforce savvy a plus.
  • Ability to safely handle and restrain dogs weighing up to 80 pounds.
  • Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Licensed Veterinary Technician (LVT).
  • Knowledge of canine reproductive practices and reproductive laboratory procedures.
  • Experience working in animal reproduction, genetics, cryogenics, biobanking, veterinary medicine, or a related field.
  • Experience supporting canine, working dog, service dog, livestock, or companion animal breeding programs, with an understanding of breeding program management, genetic diversity, and population sustainability.

Better Together: Why In-Person Matters at GEB

At Guiding Eyes, we believe our best work happens when we’re together. In-person collaboration strengthens relationships, sparks meaningful conversations, and helps us achieve greater impact – bringing our core values to life every day. Being on campus fosters a true sense of community and shared purpose, reminding us that we’re all part of something bigger as we work side by side toward our mission.

While we appreciate your interest and application, only candidates under consideration will be contacted.

description:
ZACHRY is currently seeking an experienced Industrial Journeyman Millwright at CHENIERE SABINE PASS, Cameron LA. No per diem offered. MUST HAVE TWIC & CURRENT DRIVER LICENSE.

Position Summary

A Millwright will install, assemble, dismantle, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair machinery to specifications. Millwrights use precision tools and processes to ensure that the machinery is installed and working correctly.

Qualification Highlights

  • Must have experience with industrial machinery installation, repair, and maintenance.
  • Must know how to read blueprints, schematic drawings and engineering specifications and understand how to read and interpret technical manuals in order to determine work procedures
  • Must have experience using industrial hand tools and power tools
  • Must have all Journeyman Precision Millwright hand tools – see tool list attachment
  • Minimum 4-5 years industrial construction/maintenance experience
  • Minimum of 3 years Millwright experience in Power Generation Plants
  • Must have reliable transportation and be able to work 7 days as needed

Position Responsibilities

  • Works with industry-specific and high complex precision machines including but not limited to ball mills, ID fans, lube coil skids, turbines, conveyors, generators, hydraulic systems, pumps, gears, bearings, compressors etc.
  • Will plan, inspect, verify and document scope of work
  • Uses precision leveling and alignment tools in order to measure angles, material thickness and small distances with calipers, squares, micrometers, optical instruments and other tools.
  • Will fit bearings, align gears and wheels, attach motors and connect belts according to manufacturer’s blueprints and drawings
  • Will dismantle machines using hammers, wrenches, crowbars and other hand tools
  • Assembles and installs equipment such as shafting, conveyors and tram rails
  • Assembles machines and bolts, welds, rivets and fastens machinery to foundations or other structures using hand tools and power tools.
  • Operates engine lathes, grinders and files.
  • May construct foundations for machinery
  • Fabricates and installs parts, equipment and machinery by measuring, cutting, drilling and/or welding
  • Turns machine parts to dimensional specifications
  • Will unload, inspect, move and set equipment into position using cranes, hoists, dollies, rollers and trucks
  • Uses rigging and hoisting devices such as chokers, chain falls and come along to move equipment / materials into place
  • Conducts preventative maintenance such as lubrication and fixing or repairing worn parts.
  • Follows direction from supervisor.
  • Must be willing to perform other duties as assigned

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Demonstrated industrial construction/maintenance history experience
  • Knowledge of hand tools, power tools and layout tools such as lasers, ultrasonic measuring and alignment tools, plumb bobs, cutting torches, welding machines, hydraulic torch wrenches, hydraulic stud tensioners, soldering guns and metal working equipment that includes lathes and grinding machines.
  • Knowledge of industrial machinery and equipment
  • Understand load properties of cables, ropes, hoists and chains
  • Demonstrated ability to use certified hand signals
  • Organization and time management.
  • Good problem-solving abilities
  • Good aptitude and manual dexterity
  • Knowledge of math concepts, geometry and layout
  • Demonstrated ability to lead others and provide detailed instructions
  • Good reading comprehension
  • Ability to work with others – team player
  • Ability to work independently – minimal supervision
  • Good communication skills with co-workers and supervisors
  • Commitment to Zachry values and safety rules and regulations

Preferred Qualifications

  • National Center for Construction Education and Research’s (NCCER) Certification for Journeyman Industrial Millwright.
  • Zachry ROF’ed employee.
  • Former Zachry Employee.
  • Basic Computer efficiency
  • Formal/technical education.

Reports to Position

  • This position does not have any direct reports; however, the position will work closely with and oversee on occasion of helper and labor positions. The position will hold a positional and expertise authority of the helper and laborer positions.

Physical Requirements

  • Employee will be required to adhere to large amounts of standing, walking, bending, squatting and lifting.
  • Will talk and hear to communicate.
  • Must have good dexterity with hands and fingers to perform the precision adjustments of machinery parts and controls.
  • Will use arms and hands to signal, grab, hold, turn, push, pull: objects, materials, controls and tools.
  • May be required to lift, carry and move up to 50lbs.
  • Will occasionally work at heights, climb ladders and stairways and work off of platforms.
  • Will use vision abilities to focus, see short and long distances, colors, depth perception and peripheral vision.
  • Must be capable of working out side in the elements including but not limited to the heat, cold, rain, snow and wind; and must be able to work for long period of times up to 12 hours a day.
  • Will be required to wear personal protective equipment (PPE) including but not limited to: hard hat, safety glasses/goggles, ear plugs/muffs, masks/respirators, safety vests, gloves and steel-toe boots.

title: Sr eCommerce Platform Product Manager-Marketplace
description:
The Marketplace team is building the platform capabilities that power scalable, multi-channel commerce experiences across Staples. As part of Merchandising, this team partners closely with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Data, AI, Operations, and business stakeholders to create reusable platform services, improve operational efficiency, and support marketplace growth. This is an opportunity to help shape how commerce platforms evolve—bringing strategy, technology, and business outcomes together in a highly visible role.

Staples is seeking a Sr eCommerce Platform Product Manager-Marketplace to define and drive the strategic vision, roadmap, and evolution of the Marketplace Commerce Platform. In this role, you will lead platform product strategy for capabilities that enable scalable multi-tenant and multi-channel commerce, improve platform adoption, and deliver measurable business value. You will translate complex business and technical needs into actionable platform strategies, product investments, governance models, and reusable capabilities that support current and future growth.

This role is ideal for a product leader who thrives at the intersection of commerce, platform architecture, data, automation, and stakeholder influence. You will work across senior leaders and cross-functional teams to shape platform direction, prioritize investments, and ensure technology decisions translate into stronger customer, associate, and business outcomes.

This role will require the incumbent to work out of our Framingham, MA HQ facility on a 4-day/week hybrid schedule. We are open to considering candidates willing to relocate to within a commutable distance to our facility and may be able to assist with relocation costs.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Develop and drive the long-term product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Marketplace Commerce Platform, aligning platform investments with business objectives and growth priorities.
  • Define platform capabilities, priorities, and investment trade-offs that support scalable multi-tenant and multi-channel commerce operations.
  • Establish governance frameworks for platform configuration, tenant management, role-based access controls, and reusable service development.
  • Lead the evolution of APIs, integrations, data contracts, and extensibility frameworks as strategic platform products that enable growth and interoperability.
  • Partner with Engineering, Architecture, Data, AI, and business teams to translate complex business needs into scalable platform solutions and product requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and intelligent workflow capabilities to improve operational efficiency, user productivity, and business outcomes.
  • Define adoption strategies, success metrics, governance standards, and performance expectations for emerging platform capabilities and technologies.
  • Build and maintain measurement frameworks, KPIs, service-level objectives, and operational metrics to evaluate platform performance and business value.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance platform scalability, reliability, adoption, and cost efficiency across channels, tenants, and business units.
  • Lead highly visible cross-functional programs and strategic initiatives, influencing priorities and outcomes across matrixed stakeholder groups.
  • Provide platform expertise and strategic recommendations to senior leadership to support technology investment decisions and long-term business planning.
  • Mentor product managers and key stakeholders while fostering best practices in product strategy, platform management, innovation, and customer-centric decision-making.

What you bring to the table:

  • Platform product leadership with the ability to define strategy, prioritize investments, and drive execution across complex ecosystems.
  • Strategic thinking and business acumen to connect platform decisions to growth opportunities, operational efficiency, customer outcomes, and measurable business value.
  • Strong cross-functional influence, with the ability to build alignment across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Data, Operations, Commercial, and senior leadership stakeholders.
  • Technical and systems thinking, including an understanding of platform architecture, integrations, APIs, data flows, scalability considerations, and reusable service models.
  • Innovation mindset, with curiosity around emerging technologies, AI, automation, and intelligent workflows that can improve business performance.
  • Analytical problem-solving skills, with the ability to use data, business insights, and structured thinking to evaluate trade-offs and guide product decisions.
  • Clear written, verbal, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to communicate complex business and technical concepts to executive and cross-functional audiences.
  • Ability to lead through influence in a matrixed environment where direct reporting relationships may not exist.

What’s needed- Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Information Systems, a related field, or an equivalent work experience.
  • 10+ years of progressively responsible experience in product management, platform product management, software product strategy, solutions architecture, enterprise technology, or a related discipline.
  • Experience defining and managing product roadmaps, platform strategies, and cross-functional priorities.
  • Experience working with platform architectures, APIs, integrations, event-driven systems, data contracts, or scalability models.
  • Experience supporting multi-channel commerce, marketplace platforms or digital commerce solutions.
  • Experience using data, KPIs, and business metrics to guide product decisions and measure outcomes.
  • Experience leading complex initiatives across matrixed organizations and driving outcomes through influence.

What’s needed- Desired Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree, MBA, or equivalent advanced degree.
  • Experience leading product strategy within large-scale marketplace, SaaS, or platform businesses.
  • Experience with multi-tenant architectures, role-based access control models, configuration frameworks, or platform governance.
  • Familiarity with marketplace APIs and integrations, including Amazon, Walmart, Target Plus, Best Buy, or similar ecosystems.
  • Experience embedding AI, machine learning, automation, or agentic capabilities into production business workflows.
  • Background in solutions architecture, software engineering, enterprise integration, or technical leadership prior to product management.
  • Experience developing platform measurement frameworks, operational intelligence solutions, or cost-to-serve models across multiple business units.

We Offer:

  • Inclusive culture with associate-led Business Resource Groups
  • 22 days of PTO and Holiday Schedule (7 observed paid holidays + 1 floating holiday)
  • Online and Retail Discounts, Company Match 401(k), Physical and Mental Health Wellness programs, and more!

The salary range represents the expected compensation for this role at the time of posting. The specific base pay may be influenced by a variety of factors to include the candidate's experience, skill set, education, geography, business considerations, and internal equity. In addition to base pay, this role may be eligible for bonuses, or other forms of variable compensation.

title: Infrastructure Engineer

  • Experience implementing complex deployments using: AWS CloudFormation Terraform Ansible

  • Strong knowledge of Infrastructure Automation tools such as: Ansible Chef Puppet

  • Good understanding of Git and source code repository management.

  • Hands-on experience with at least one CI/CD platform such as Jenkins.

Able to use electronic circuits, transducer, pressure, torque, optics, flow, dimensional, hardness, vibration measuring equipment, etc, to measure parameters to determine the performance characteristics and accuracy of other instruments and test equipment.

title: 13873 - Supervisor Maintenance
description:
Oversee and perform a variety of simple to complex roadway maintenance activities. Supervise a crew and provide technical guidance to crew members performing maintenance activities and equipment operation.

How you will contribute:
  • Communication: Effectively communicate with citizens, public officials, state employees and business people demonstrating sensitivity for their opinions and suggestions. Respond with accurate and complete information to inquiries and requests. Communicate effectively, courteously, and professionally with customers. Provide customers with Information related to the status of their work requests as required. May require travel and work outside of the traditional district boundaries which may cause a temporary change to the work schedule.
  • Emergency Operations: Supervise emergency operations to ensure the safe operation of roadways. Support emergency operations including storm damage repairs, clearing roadways of snow, ice and debris, accident clean-up, and providing traffic control during and after normal working hours.
  • Leadership: Assist the Area Superintendent in planning for the maintenance program, special projects, and personnel needs. Investigate and recommend solutions to operations and maintenance complaints. Estimate repair, construction and materials costs. Assist in ordering, storing and utilizing AHQ materials. Assist and advise crew on difficult and unusual problems when necessary.
  • Provide Leadership in Traffic Control Devices: Work with supervisors and managers at assigned locations to plan, schedule, supervise and perform the placement, maintenance and removal of traffic control devices for work zones, detours, lane closures, etc., according to the MUTCD. Receive and respond to work orders. Order and track inventory and maintain records.
  • Records Preparation and Management: Prepare and maintain program and project documentation. Assist in the preparation of budget reports, data and records. Assist in forecasting additional funds needed for staffing, equipment, materials and supplies. Monitor expenditures and recommend adjustments as needed.

Maintain current knowledge of safety rules, regulations, laws and procedures (OSHA and VOSHA, etc.). Ensure equipment is used properly and safely. Assign daily work and monitor work performed; provide onsite direction and guidance; complete daily work reports including time, equipment and materials. Work with others to provide new ideas and improvements. Perform an IMS analysis related to ordering road stock to determine the best quantity to order.

Apply specialized knowledge of equipment operation and maintenance techniques. Perform maintenance repair, replacement and preventive maintenance. Complete pre-trips inspections for vehicles and equipment operated.

title: Supervisor Workforce Development - Reading PA
description:
FirstEnergy at a Glance

We are a forward-thinking electric utility powered by a diverse team of employees committed to making customers’ lives brighter, the environment better and our communities stronger.

FirstEnergy (NYSE: FE) is dedicated to safety, reliability, and operational excellence. Headquartered in Akron, Ohio, FirstEnergy includes one of the nation's largest investor-owned electric systems, more than 24,500 miles of transmission lines that connect the Midwest and Mid-Atlantic regions, and a regulated generating fleet with a total capacity of 3,780 megawatts.

About the Opportunity

This is an open position with FirstEnergy Service Co., a subsidiary of FirstEnergy Corp. [SC00

Supervisor, Operations Skills Training – Enterprise Learning

The Supervisor, Operations Skills Training, is responsible for leading the planning, delivery, evaluation, and continuous improvement of high-quality technical training for FirstEnergy’s physical workforce across the company. This position provides direct leadership to instructors and training staff who support field-based skilled craft disciplines, including line, substation, transmission, relay, network, and other operational training programs. The role ensures training is delivered safely, consistently, and with the rigor necessary to build employee capability, support operational readiness, meet compliance obligations, and

reinforce high-performance expectations across Enterprise Learning.

Responsibilities include:

  • Provide leadership and oversight for the new apprenticeship program by ensuring all associated safety expectations, training requirements, instructor assignments, schedules, resources, and program activities are planned, communicated, and executed in alignment with Enterprise Learning standards, operational needs, and company safety practices.

  • Lead, coach, and develop direct reports by conducting meaningful performance evaluations, regular check-ins, observation feedback, and development planning that promote accountability, technical excellence, and high-performance work behaviors.

  • Participate in recruiting, interviewing, selection, onboarding, and retention efforts for instructors and training personnel, ensuring candidates meet the technical, instructional, safety, and leadership expectations required to support enterprise-wide training needs.

  • Establish clear priorities, develop effective schedules, manage workload across instructors and locations, and adjust plans as needed to meet changing operational priorities, staffing constraints, emergency response needs, and business requirements.

  • Ensure instructor qualifications, certifications, technical proficiency, and required instructional competencies are obtained, maintained, documented, and aligned with program requirements and company expectations.

  • Communicate, reinforce, and model department policies, Enterprise Learning standards, safety expectations, learning governance requirements, and professional conduct expectations for all training activities.

  • Drive continuous improvement efforts that strengthen training rigor, increase

consistency across the company, improve trainee readiness, and add measurable value to Operations and Enterprise Learning.

  • Coordinate the analysis, design, development, implementation, and evaluation of effective training materials, practical exercises, assessments, evaluations, and programs that support field-realistic skill development and operational performance.

  • Manage budget considerations when planning instructor development, training delivery, travel, equipment, materials, contract support, and training center activities; promote responsible stewardship of company resources while maintaining training quality and safety.

  • Through direct observation, performance data, student evaluations, and business feedback, ensure training programs and instructors meet established expectations for:

    • Clear, effective, and engaging classroom, field, lab, and hands-on instruction

    • Accurate application of company policies, work methods, technical standards, and program requirements

    • Strict adherence to safety practices, procedures, hazard recognition, and safe work behaviors

    • A professional learning environment that promotes accountability, preparation, participation, respect, and successful skill demonstration

  • Communicate with leadership, business partners, and Operations supervision regarding instructor observations, trainee performance, program effectiveness, safety concerns, and opportunities to improve training quality and workforce readiness.

  • Administer training section activities by:

    • Partnering with Operations, Enterprise Learning leadership, Human Resources, Labor Relations, Safety, and other departments to identify training needs, evaluate business impacts, and recommend practical solutions

    • Analyzing training requests to determine scope, audience, learning objectives, resource needs, costs, scheduling impacts, and alignment with Enterprise Learning governance expectations

    • Communicating budget limits, project timelines, training standards, delivery expectations, and workload priorities to direct reports

    • Developing and maintaining workload schedules, annual training plans, training center calendars, instructor assignments, and contingency plans to support company-wide operational training demand

    • Ensuring accurate and timely submission of attendance, completion, evaluation, qualification, observation, budget, and month-end reporting information in approved systems

  • Keep the manager informed of training requests, schedule risks, staffing needs, budget considerations, management discussions, meeting outcomes, program performance, and emerging issues that may affect delivery commitments or operational readiness.

  • Identify future training opportunities, emerging workforce needs, technology

  • enhancements, field performance gaps, and process improvements that strengthen the capability of the physical workforce and support long-term business objectives.

  • Participate in the exit interview process and use feedback, trends, and lessons learned to support employee retention, improve leadership practices, and strengthen the overall training organization.

  • Assist in work of a higher classification and perform other duties as assigned, including support for enterprise initiatives, storm response training needs, special projects, and cross-functional workforce development efforts.

Qualifications and expectations:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Education, Personnel Administration, English, Communications, or a similar discipline with six years of related experience or an Associate degree with training experience with eight years of related experience, including training and technical supervisory experience, is highly preferred

  • In lieu of a Bachelor or Associate degree, a minimum of a High School Diploma or GED, along with ten years of related experience, including, technical supervisory and training experience, and working experience in distribution lines, transmission lines, substation, relay, and ducted network craft disciplines is required

  • Demonstrated leadership ability with a record of setting clear expectations, holding employees accountable, developing talent, resolving barriers, and leading teams through change.

  • Strong oral and written communication skills, including the ability to keep direct reports, peer leaders, Operations partners, and senior leadership informed of issues affecting training programs, schedules, performance, and employee development.

  • Ability to coordinate the proper use, care, availability, and readiness of training equipment, vehicles, tools, technology, hardware, audio-visual resources, training yards, and facilities needed to support safe and effective instruction.

  • Experience evaluating emerging technologies, instructional methods, data tools, and technical resources that can improve training delivery, learner engagement, assessment quality, and operational performance.

  • Commitment to continuous professional development through training seminars, industry benchmarking, professional resources, and ongoing learning related to adult education, technical instruction, safety, workforce development, and utility operations.

  • Sound leadership and decision-making skills for guiding the design,

  • implementation, evaluation, and improvement of training programs that require consistent standards, measurable outcomes, and high levels of trainee performance.

  • Demonstrated ability to ensure training materials, lesson plans, assessments,

  • practical evaluations, field exercises, and documentation meet department quality standards, technical accuracy expectations, safety requirements, and business needs.

  • Effective verbal communication skills to impart information and convey ideas clearly and persuasively

  • Leadership and decision-making abilities that demonstrate commitment to

  • customer service, workforce readiness, safety, operational excellence, and

  • responsible use of company resources.

  • Understands how strategies and decisions affect employees, the organization, and customers

  • Ability to accept and promote change

  • Ability to oversee the implementation of changes for direct reports

  • Ability to foster an environment that recognizes success and positively promotes improvement Human relations skills to:

    • Serve as a role model for direct reports

    • Exercise flexibility in working with people at all levels through written and verbal communication that provides clear and concise instructions

  • Ability to support budget planning, monitor spending, evaluate cost-effective training solutions, manage travel and resource decisions, and communicate financial considerations in a clear and responsible manner.

  • Ability to motivate and lead by example

  • Sound judgment to evaluate employee performance, identify strengths and

  • development needs, communicate expectations clearly, address performance gaps promptly, and recognize high-quality results.

  • Ability to lead in a high-performance environment by establishing rigorous standards, measuring results, following through on commitments, and promoting a culture of preparation, accountability, professionalism, and continuous improvement.

  • Willingness to travel overnight when necessary

  • Possession of a valid driver's license and/or CDL, as necessary

Benefits, Compensation & Workforce Diversity

At FirstEnergy, employees are key to our success. We depend on their talents to meet the challenges of our changing business environment. We are committed to rewarding individual and team efforts through our total rewards philosophy which includes competitive pay plus incentive compensation, a company-sponsored pension plan, 401(k) savings plan with matching employer contribution, a choice of medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, and life insurance programs, as well as skills development training with tuition reimbursement. Please visit our website at www.firstenergycorp.com to learn more about all of our employee rewards programs. FirstEnergy proudly supports workforce diversity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, or status as a qualified individual with a disability. No recruiters or agencies without a previously signed contract. Unable to sponsor or transfer H-1B visas at this time.

Safety

Safety is a core value for FirstEnergy and is essential to all of our business activities. We ensure employees have the tools, information, and processes to perform their duties in a manner that assures safety for themselves, their co-workers, our customers and the public. Our goals are to provide a safe work environment, to maintain an accident-free, injury-free workplace, and to promote and maintain public safety. To meet these goals, we dedicate ourselves to achieving world-class safety standards.

title: Advanced R&D Engr/Scientist
description:

An excellent career opportunity is currently available for an Advanced R&D Engineer/ Scientist - MPT, within Honeywell India Technology Center located in Gurugram, India. MPT (Manufacturing & Product Technology) supports prototype development for catalysts and adsorbents, scale-up of new products, commercial trial runs, manufacturing robustness, manufacturing flexibility, capital planning, and raw material procurement issues. MPT is a key interface between R&D, Business, and Manufacturing. This position requires a strong fundamental understanding of catalyst and adsorbent synthesis, manufacturing, scale-up, characterization techniques, pilot plant testing, and broad understanding of catalysts applicable to the Oil & Gas Industry.

Key Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Lead/support new product development projects from MPT group in catalyst/adsorbent space supporting Refinery, Petrochemicals, Renewables, and Natural Gas processing industries
  • Advanced understanding and skills in catalyst/adsorbent manufacturing processes and scale-up, such as, mulling, forming, extrusion, finishing, etc.
  • Advanced understanding of catalyst and adsorbent characterization and analytical techniques needed to troubleshoot manufacturing and scale-up risks
  • Identify and develop innovative solutions, authoring invention disclosures to contribute significantly to UOP’s innovation initiatives
  • Ensure alignment and synergy with other UOP R&D centers and manufacturing locations to drive successful delivery of projects
  • Stay informed about competition, monitor advancements in catalyst/ adsorbent manufacturing technologies, and lead projects designed to address gaps
  • Act as a mentor for less experienced scientists and engineers, fostering their growth and professional development
  • Lead/support in MPT capability building
  • Maintain compliance with Health Safety & Environment (HSE) policies and procedures and adopt HSE requirements for safe laboratory operations

Must Haves:

  • Ph.D. in Chemistry or Chemical Engineering with 5 years of relevant industrial experience, OR
  • M.Sc. or B.Tech. in Chemistry or Chemical Engineering with 10 years of relevant industrial experience

We Value:

  • Experience in a commercial catalyst/adsorbent manufacturing plant is highly desirable
  • A self-driven, results-oriented professional with a proactive mindset, strong learning agility, and the ability to thrive under minimal supervision
  • Entrepreneurial mindset to drive technology development in a fast-paced environment
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to deliver impactful presentations to diverse audiences and effectively manage customer relationships
  • Knowledge of UOP technologies: Refining/Petrochemicals/Gas Processing applications
  • Familiar with Six-Sigma tools and their applications
  • Fundamental knowledge of materials (zeolite, alumina, clay, etc.)

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Staff Software Engineer

Join our team in a senior technical leadership role

Do the work that matters

CommBank invests in the latest AI technology stack across our ecosystems, giving our engineers modern tooling, platforms, and AI-enabled workflows to build with. You will work in an environment where AI-assisted engineering is part of how we design, deliver, and support software at scale.

See yourself in the team

CommBank invests in the latest AI technology stack across our ecosystems, giving our engineers modern tooling, platforms, and AI-enabled workflows to build with.

We are seeking an experienced engineer to join the Secure Desktop and Identity Services domain within our End User Experience (EUX) division — a team focused on enabling safe, seamless access for every employee. You will set the technical direction for our platform ecosystem and guide a squad delivering reliable, secure, and cost-effective end-user computing solutions.

As the most senior engineer in the squad, you will balance hands-on engineering with high-level design and mentoring, showcasing what good looks like in the code you write, the designs you produce, and the standards you hold.

This role offers hybrid working flexibility — talk to us about what might work for you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic and Technical Leadership: Shape the roadmap and strategy for your squad's products and services, and provide technical leadership and mentorship across the team.

  • Engineering Excellence: Demonstrate exemplary code, design, testing, and documentation, lifting the standard of engineering craft across the squad and wider domain.

  • Delivery and Implementation: Design and implement platform services and support tools that deliver measurable business value, leading the transition from current to target architectures.

  • Automation and Operations: Build CI/CD pipelines and automation tooling that make changes safe, repeatable, and observable, and provide expert-level support aligned to SLAs and incident management processes.

  • Innovation and Enablement: Identify emerging technologies — including AI-enabled tooling — aligned to the Group's strategic direction, and improve the Standard Operating Environment (SOE) and related tooling.

  • Collaboration and Standards: Work with squads across the domain to define engineering standards and patterns, fostering a culture of learning and problem solving.

Technical Skills

We don't expect you to know them all — exposure to several of these (or their equivalents) will set you up for success:

  • Full lifecycle platform engineering — design, build, run — across Windows and macOS environments.

  • Backend development in .NET, Java, or TypeScript, with scripting in PowerShell, Bash, or Python.

  • CI/CD and automation tooling (GitHub, GitHub Actions) and DevSecOps practices.

  • Microservices, RESTful APIs, and domain-driven design.

  • AWS, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible), and containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Identity and access management platforms, similar to Microsoft Active Directory and Entra ID, SailPoint IIQ, CyberArk, or Ping.

Leadership Competencies

  • Raising the Bar: Model best-practice engineering and hold a high standard for quality, simplicity, and maintainability.

  • Technical Influence: Set and communicate technical direction, and influence positive outcomes across teams.

  • Coaching and Development: Provide effective feedback and mentoring to lift the capability of engineers around you.

  • Flexibility and Adaptability: Manage multiple priorities across squads and geographies in a changing environment.

  • Risk Management: Integrate risk, security, and resilience principles into design and delivery decisions.

Working with Us

At CommBank, we are passionate about customer service, driven by data, and inspired by creativity. Our people bring diverse backgrounds and unique perspectives, creating a respectful, inclusive, and flexible workplace. We are driven by our values and supported to share ideas, initiatives, and energy. Here, you will thrive, be supported when faced with challenges, and be empowered to tackle new opportunities. We are hiring engineers from across all of Australia, and you will be empowered to do your best work, with the flexibility to choose when and where that work happens.

If this sounds like the role for you, we would love to hear from you. Apply today!

If you're already part of the Commonwealth Bank Group (including Bankwest, x15ventures), you'll need to apply through Sidekick to submit a valid application. We’re keen to support you with the next step in your career.

Dit doe je met online peilingen en met hulp van veldwerkers die op straat mensen interviewen.

Jij bent in staat om de rode draad te zien in grote hoeveelheden data en hieruit heldere conclusies te trekken. title: Software Engineer L5 - AI Observability & Agent Evaluation
description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

AI and ML power innovation in all areas of the business, including helping members choose the right title for them through personalization, better understanding our audience and our content slate, creating high-quality subtitles, dubbings, images, trailers, and other assets, optimizing our payment processing, and much more. AI Platform (AIP) organization builds highly scalable, differentiated AI infrastructure to maximize the business impact of all AI/ML practitioners at Netflix, which is key to accelerating this innovation.

The Opportunity

The AI Observability team makes AI, ML, and Agentic systems transparent, reliable, and production-ready at scale. We build end-to-end observability for ML and GenAI workloads, capturing model inputs, features, predictions, outcomes, and behavior across online and batch systems. Our platform enables teams to monitor model performance, data quality, drift, latency, and failures, turning the ML system from a black box into an explainable, debuggable system. We provide developer-friendly libraries, dashboards, and alerts so teams can debug issues, respond to incidents, and ship AI-powered products with confidence.

We're looking for a hands-on senior engineer to build the frameworks behind Netflix's AI Observability platform, model performance, evaluation, and vendor integration surfaces. You will design reusable infrastructure that enables ML/AI practitioners across domains to monitor model quality in production, evaluate LLM and agentic systems, and adopt vendor tooling through a consistent, self-serve platform. AIP owns the generic, reusable infrastructure; domain teams own their domain-specific evals and remediation. You will partner closely with engineering, product, machine learning, and data teams to turn their needs into reusable platform capabilities. To succeed, you will bring a strong background in AI or ML infrastructure and a passion for building scalable, robust systems.

In this role, you will:

  • Build the observability framework and platform capabilities that give ML and GenAI systems metrics, logs, and distributed traces across online inference, batch scoring, feature pipelines, and agent orchestration, so teams can instrument their systems consistently.

  • Build the primitives that let teams monitor model performance (accuracy, calibration, error rates), data quality, drift, and degradation on their own systems, rather than monitoring individual models yourself.

  • Build and extend evaluation frameworks for LLM and agentic systems that support response quality, grounding and hallucination, task success, tool-use and trajectory correctness, and LLM-as-a-judge and human-in-the-loop scoring, giving teams reusable building blocks to define and run their own evals.

  • Lead build-vs-buy evaluations for observability and eval tooling, and own the SDKs, connectors, and APIs that integrate vendor platforms into a consistent, well-supported interface, so ML and product teams can onboard models and agents with minimal friction.

  • Build reusable libraries, SDKs, and templates that make observability and evaluation the default for new systems ("observability-by-default"), lowering the barrier for teams to instrument and evaluate their work.

  • Provide the dashboarding, alerting, and SLO/SLI building blocks (plus sensible out-of-the-box templates) that teams use to track model performance, latency, cost, and reliability.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

  • Experience in software, AI/ML, or platform engineering, with hands-on time in production observability, monitoring, or ML/LLM evaluation

  • Proven track record of designing standards, libraries, SDKs, or frameworks that other teams build on and adopt, reflecting a platform and enablement mindset rather than shipping features for a single use case.

  • Strong coding skills in Python and at least one of Java, Go, or Scala, with experience building production services

  • Practical experience operating ML models in production (online serving and/or batch), including drift, model performance, and data quality.

  • Hands-on experience with modern observability stacks (e.g., Prometheus/Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry, ELK/OpenSearch, Jaeger/Tempo, or similar).

  • Solid understanding of distributed systems, microservices, and at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

  • Ability to work cross-functionally with ML, data, infra, and product teams, and to communicate clearly about system behavior, quality, and risk.

  • Experience with vendor integration and VPC deployment.

  • AI-Native Engineering Mindset who uses AI tools as a core part of their own workflow to accelerate design, development, testing, and code review.

Nice to have:

  • Hands-on experience with ML/LLM observability and evaluation tools (e.g., Arize, Braintrust, LangFuse, Weights & Biases, Galileo, Vertex AI Model Monitoring, SageMaker Model Monitor).

  • Experience building or shipping LLM/GenAI applications and evaluating them: prompt/result logging, evaluation metrics, LLM-as-a-judge, and human-in-the-loop review.

  • Experience evaluating agentic systems: tool use, multi-step reasoning, and trajectory/task-success measurement.

To learn more about our AI Platform, you can review the relevant talks/blog posts on the Netflix AI Platform Research website.

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $388,000.00 - $619,000.00.

Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here.

Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here.

Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. title: Major Gift Specialist
description:
The Major Gifts Specialist is responsible for managing a portfolio of 75–125 major gift prospects and donors while systematically advancing individuals through the donor cultivation cycle to secure philanthropic investments of $10,000 and above in support of Mosaic Life Care. The Major Gifts Specialist is accountable for achieving established activity, solicitation and revenue goals through strategic relationship-building, personalized donor engagement and effective portfolio management. This position develops strong, collaborative relationships with organizational leadership, department directors, managers, clinicians and affiliated physicians to identify philanthropic opportunities, engage donors and align fundraising efforts with institutional priorities.

  • High energy, creativity and an ability to inspire performance and commitment to goals from key volunteers

  • Participate in a rigorous moves management process, maintaining accurate and timely documentation of all donor interactions, next steps and outcomes within the donor database while adhering to prospect management and clearance policies
  • Identify, qualify and strategically advance new major gift prospects to build and sustain a robust pipeline of future donors
  • Generate and execute comprehensive stewardship plans for major donors to strengthen relationships, demonstrate impact and encourage ongoing philanthropic investment
  • Partner with the President of Philanthropy, physician and operational leaders to engage grateful patients and families, facilitating meaningful opportunities for philanthropy that support organizational priorities
  • Collaborate with the President of Philanthropy to identify and implement blended and complex giving opportunities, including planned gifts, current gifts and other tax-advantaged charitable vehicles
  • Engage health system executives, clinical leaders, board members and volunteers, as appropriate, in donor cultivation, solicitation and stewardship activities to maximize philanthropic outcomes
  • Develop compelling gift proposals, cases for support and donor presentations that align donor interests with organizational priorities and funding opportunities
  • Work collaboratively with clinical, operational and executive leaders to identify philanthropic funding opportunities that advance strategic organizational priorities and improve patient care, education, research and community health

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree - business finance, healthcare administration, or related field - Required


Work Experience

  • 5-7+ Years - in fund development, at least 3 years' experience of proven major gifts experience, in a healthcare organization - Preferred
  • Direct experience with a constituent relationship management (CRM) donor database system required (e.g., Blackbaud Raiser’s Edge NXT, Salesforce); healthcare foundation experience - Preferred
  • Ability and proven track record in soliciting, cultivating and closing major gifts ranging from $10,000 to $1,000,000 - Required

Licenses and Certifications

  • Certified Fund-Raising Executive (CFRE) - Preferred

Travel Requirements

  • Regular travel outside of the office - Required
  • Demonstrated ability to identify, cultivate, solicit and steward major gift prospects and donors through all stages of the donor lifecycle
  • Strong relationship-building and interpersonal skills with the ability to establish credibility and trust with donors, physicians, executives, board members, volunteers and colleagues
  • Excellent verbal, written and presentation communication skills, including the ability to develop compelling cases for support, proposals and donor correspondence
  • Strong strategic thinking and planning skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, establish goals and execute long-term cultivation and solicitation plans
  • Ability to assess donor interests, motivations and philanthropic capacity and align giving opportunities with organizational priorities
  • Knowledge of major gift fundraising principles, moves management, donor stewardship, prospect research and portfolio management best practices
  • Familiarity with planned giving concepts and the ability to recognize and refer complex gift opportunities
  • Ability to analyze fundraising data, interpret donor information and use metrics to guide decision-making and measure performance
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail with the ability to maintain accurate donor records and manage confidential information
  • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively as part of a collaborative team environment
  • Demonstrated professionalism, sound judgment and discretion when working with sensitive donor, patient and organizational information

title: AI Developer
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. Do you thrive working across the stack — AI/LLM integration, backend services, modern frontend frameworks, and cloud deployment — while staying curious about what GenAI can unlock next?

If so, Tech@Lilly is looking for an AI Full Stack Engineer to design, build, and scale AI-powered applications and full stack solutions across the enterprise.

As an AI Full Stack Engineer, you will design and develop AI-powered applications using Large Language Models, build Agentic AI workflows leveraging tools, reasoning, memory, and orchestration patterns, and develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using enterprise knowledge sources. You will work across the full stack — building responsive frontend applications, scalable backend services and APIs, and cloud-native deployments on AWS — while integrating AI services with business applications and ensuring systems are secure, reliable, and production-ready.

  • Independently drives features from design through deployment.
  • Builds reusable and scalable solutions that can support multiple business teams.
  • Improves developer productivity through automation and engineering best practices.

  • 6-8 years of software engineering experience.
  • At least 1-2 years of practical Generative AI experience.
  • Strong Python + React + Cloud background. Proven deployments to production.

  • Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and AI tool integrations.
