title: C2C4C Rides and Corporate Affairs Strategy & Operations
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.



Position Summary

The Director, C2C4C Rides and Corporate Affairs Strategy & Operations is responsible for leading the integrated strategy, program management (in partnership with the current global program lead), and external/internal communications for one of the company’s most prominent enterprise programs, “C2C4C” (Coast 2 Coast/Country 2 Country/Continent to Continent 4 Cancer), a signature global initiative that plays a critical role in shaping employee engagement, corporate reputation and trust, and showcases the company’s mission in action.

In close partnership with the Global C2C4C program lead, this role will collaborate to drive both program execution and integrated storytelling across internal communications, external media, digital and social channels, executive engagement, and live events while helping translate program priorities into coordinated execution. The Director contributes to strategic vision, establishes operating discipline, and is accountable for the program’s visibility, credibility, communications readiness, and impact globally. This role serves as a strategic and program partner to C2C4C program leadership and executive stakeholders, including BMS LT members, as well as advocacy organizations with whom BMS partners.

The scope is broad, highly visible, and fast-moving. The role demands strong creative instincts, flawless execution, strong program management, multi-million dollar budget management, governance discipline, and the ability to operate with confidence and independence while collaborating across a matrixed organization.

The role reports to the Senior Director, Strategy & Business Operations, Corporate Affairs, with a dotted-line relationship to the Corporate Communications team.

Responsibilities

Program Management & Operational Execution

  • Work in close partnership with the current C2C4C program management lead to translate C2C4C strategic priorities into integrated communications plans, project timelines, deliverables, owners, and execution milestones.
  • Coordinate across Corporate Affairs, market teams, agencies, event partners, rider leads, patient advocacy partners, and business stakeholders to ensure communications planning is fully integrated with broader program planning and execution.
  • Support program governance through clear communications inputs, leadership updates, agenda development, action tracking, issue escalation, and alignment across workstreams.
  • Partner with the Global C2C4C Program lead on multi-million dollar program budget planning, with accountability for communication-related budget planning and vendor/agency coordination for communications-related program activities, ensuring resources are aligned to highest-impact priorities and coordinated with the broader program budget.

Development of Global Toolkits

  • Develop and own the global messaging strategy and narrative architecture for C2C4C, including executive positioning, messaging frameworks, FAQs and global communication toolkits to drive consistent storytelling at scale.
  • Ensure materials are audience-centric, globally relevant, and adaptable for local markets.

Story Architecture & Content Development

  • Lead the integrated communications strategy across all U.S. and global markets where C2C4C takes place, ensuring storytelling, executive engagement, media, digital, internal communications, and live moments are connected to the program’s strategic priorities.
  • Contribute to program planning and governance by bringing communications strategy, stakeholder insight, narrative priorities, and reputation considerations into decision-making forums.
  • Define and execute the content strategy for patient, rider and employee storytelling that drives measurable engagement and amplifies business impact.
  • Own the creative vision and production strategy for video and multimedia content, directing internal teams and/or agency partners to deliver best-in-class storytelling assets.
  • Ensure storytelling reflects the company’s values, purpose, and commitment to patients and communities.

Media & External Engagement

  • Develop and execute local and national media strategies that position C2C4C as a flagship corporate program with measurable reputational impact, in partnership with Corporate Communications leadership team.
  • Lead development of strategic media narratives, proactive story angles, and spokesperson platforms that drive sustained media coverage and external credibility.
  • Accountable for spokesperson strategy—partnering with the Global C2C4C program lead to identify, vet and prepare riders, employee advocates, and senior executives for high-profile media and speaking opportunities, in close partnership with the Corporate Affairs media team.

Internal Communications

  • Collaborate with Internal Communications leadership to design and execute employee engagement strategies that drive participation, pride, and cultural impact.
  • Drive clear and compelling internal narratives that reinforce purpose, pride, and participation.
  • Execute internal communication cadence and campaigns, ensuring strategic alignment between operational updates (e.g., rider application, update, training and other announcement emails) and broader narrative/branding priorities.

Digital & Social Communications

  • Partner with omnichannel team to define social and digital strategies that maximize reach, engagement, and brand impact across owned and earned channels
  • Drive integrated paid and organic digital strategies, allocating $ resources to optimize performance and return on investment
  • Own executive communications strategy for social media, positioning senior leaders as authentic voices for the program and crafting high-impact content

Events & Live Moments

  • Define and lead the integrated strategy and execution plan for signature C2C4C moments, to ensure communications plans are aligned with operational plans, timing, logistics operations, and leadership engagement.
  • Serve as communications counsel to executives participating in C2C4C events, shaping their engagement strategy and preparing them for high-visibility moments.
  • Partner with C2C4C program lead to ensure ride-related milestones and logistics are reflected in participant communications, leadership touchpoints, and live-moment communications through a disciplined execution plan.

Measurement & Continuous Improvement

  • Partner with the Global C2C4C program lead to establish the measurement framework and KPIs for C2C4C, with ownership of communications and reputational impact measures.
  • Drive continuous innovation in the communications approach, leveraging insights, emerging platforms, and industry best practices to maintain program leadership.
  • Use insights, stakeholder feedback, and post-event learnings to improve program design and future ride planning in partnership with the Global C2C4C Program lead, and to continuously improve communications effectiveness

Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree a plus.
  • Demonstrated success managing communications and multi-million $ program budgets, leading cross-functional teams, and driving complex workstreams from strategy through execution.
  • 15+ years of experience in communications, corporate affairs, program management, public relations, or related fields.
  • Proven track record designing and executing global, multi-stakeholder communications strategies that deliver measurable business and reputational impact
  • Strong program management capability, including governance support, planning, stakeholder management, budget coordination, and execution across complex global initiatives.
  • Strong writing and storytelling capabilities across formats and audiences.
  • Experience working across media, digital, internal communications, and events.
  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced, highly matrixed environment with multiple stakeholders.
  • Experience working with senior executives

We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway.

title: Procurement Project Manager
description:
As a Direct Materials Productivity Manager here at Honeywell, you will be responsible for driving productivity improvements and cost efficiencies in the direct materials supply chain. Your role will focus on optimizing procurement strategies, enhancing supplier performance, and ensuring the seamless flow of materials to support manufacturing and operational objectives. You will leverage your expertise in supply chain management and data analytics to identify opportunities for cost reduction and process enhancement, contributing directly to Honeywell’s competitive advantage and profitability.

You will report directly to the Senior Director Procurement for Process Automation and you’ll work out from one our India locations (Bangalore/Hyderabed/Pune) on a Hybrid work schedule.

In this role, you will impact Honeywell’s operational efficiency by leading initiatives that improve material cost productivity, reduce waste, and strengthen supplier partnerships. Your leadership will ensure that material availability aligns with production demands while maintaining cost targets and quality standards, thereby supporting the company’s overall business goals.

Your role also include overseeing, supervising and reviewing tasks performed by team members to ensure effective execution of work; managing end to end processes and project for both internal and external clients with responsibility for timely accurate delivery; issuing clear instructions and directions to team members on task to be performed; and monitoring and guiding junior colleagues to support their skills development, professional growth, and overall success.

  • Develop and implement direct materials productivity strategies aligned with business objectives to drive cost savings and operational efficiencies.
  • Responsible for execution of productivity projects and achieving Gross Productivity and Net Productivity Annual Operating Plan (AOP) targets
  • Responsible for developing a pipeline of productivity projects working cross-functionally with strategic sourcing, factory operations, engineering, offering management and suppliers globally
  • Responsible for achieving the productivity targets for all the levers i.e. Negotiations, Value Engineering, Component Engineering, Rebates and Deflation with the objective of achieving Gross Productivity and Net Productivity targets
  • Analyze procurement data and supplier performance metrics to identify areas for improvement and cost reduction opportunities.
  • Analyze spend receipts data and find opportunities for cost savings working closely with supplier sourcing leaders and procurement operations
  • Collaborate closely with procurement, engineering, manufacturing, and quality teams to optimize material specifications, sourcing strategies, and inventory management.
  • Lead supplier engagement initiatives to improve cost competitiveness.
  • Manage cross-functional projects focused on waste reduction, process improvements, and supply chain optimization.
  • Monitor and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) related to direct materials productivity and cost savings to senior leadership.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, or other methodologies to enhance supply chain processes.
  • Support the development and deployment of procurement tools and technologies to improve data visibility and decision-making.
  • Mentor and develop team members to build capabilities in materials productivity and supply chain excellence.

YOU MUST HAVE

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in direct materials productivity or supply chain management roles.
  • Familiarity with Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to driving change.
  • Ability to work effectively in a global, cross-functional team environment.

WE VALUE

  • Proven experience in managing direct materials procurement and productivity within a manufacturing or industrial environment.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and drive actionable insights.
  • Expertise in supplier management, contract negotiation, and cost reduction strategies.
  • Proficiency with ERP systems, procurement software, and data analysis tools.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing projects that deliver measurable productivity improvements.

title: Materials Project Manager
description:
We are seeking a Materials Project Manager to lead small to medium-sized construction materials engineering projects from planning through closeout. This role is responsible for safe, timely delivery within contracted scope and budget and brings together project controls, field operations, construction materials testing, procurement, forecasting, change management, quality oversight, and client coordination. The successful candidate will direct internal and external resources, resolve operational issues, maintain project documentation and financial visibility, and coordinate appropriate Authorized Project Reviewer (APR) involvement at project onset and critical junctures.

Work Environment

This role requires coordination across office, field, laboratory, and client environments. Travel to project sites may be required based on assignment needs. Responsibilities may include work around active construction operations and construction materials testing activities, with adherence to applicable safety requirements.

  • Manage project scope, schedules, budgets, forecasts, risk, quality, and project controls for construction materials engineering assignments.

  • Partner with the client or NAM to define scope, schedule, budget, deliverables, and success criteria, then develop and communicate the project execution plan.

  • Monitor progress and performance, identify emerging issues, and implement timely corrective actions to minimize delays and cost impacts.

  • Lead safety planning and compliance, including pre-task planning, hazard awareness, field coordination, inspections, and reinforcement of project-specific requirements.

  • Coordinate owners, architects, engineers, subcontractors, laboratories, field technicians, and other project personnel throughout delivery.

  • Direct and support construction materials testing and inspection activities involving soils, concrete, asphalt, reinforcing steel, anchors, deep foundations, and related field or laboratory documentation, as applicable.

  • Manage RFIs, submittals, procurement, change orders, contract administration, project documentation, turnover, and closeout.

  • Identify and secure the staff, equipment, laboratories, specialty resources, and external contractors required to complete the work.

  • Set priorities, assign tasks, coordinate field and office resources, and track progress toward project targets and milestones.

  • Lead project meetings and prepare clear reports on status, financial performance, risks, quality issues, decisions, and required actions.

  • Coordinate with the APR to establish appropriate oversight and allow sufficient review time at critical junctures.

  • Coordinate with accounting on financial reporting, invoicing, cost control, change management, collections, budgets, and forecasts.

  • Maintain awareness of project-related risk and company risk policies, including conditions that could affect safety, quality, schedule, cost, or client commitments.

  • Promote continuous quality improvement and consistent standards in field services, technical documentation, project delivery, and proposals.

  • Communicate proactively with clients and stakeholders and deliver work products that satisfy contracted requirements.

  • Bachelor’s degree in technical discipline practices by the Firm including Engineering, Environmental Science or Geology and a minimum of 5 years’ related experience. Or, in lieu of a degree, a minimum of 9 years’ related experience.

  • Demonstrated experience with project controls, scheduling, budgeting, forecasting, procurement, change management, contract administration, and project closeout.

  • Ability to coordinate multidisciplinary stakeholders, subcontractors, field personnel, and technical resources.

  • Working knowledge of construction safety, quality practices, field documentation, and risk management.

  • A valid driver’s license with acceptable violation history may be required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on construction materials testing or inspection experience involving soils, concrete, asphalt, reinforcing steel, anchors, foundations, or related services.

  • Project leadership experience on commercial, industrial, education, federal, infrastructure, public works, or renovation projects.

  • Project Management Professional (PMP), Construction Manager in Training (CMIT), Professional Engineer (PE), Professional Geologist (PG), or another relevant credential.

  • OSHA 30-Hour Construction Safety, CPR/First Aid, excavation safety, or comparable safety training.

  • Experience with project and financial management platforms such as Procore, Viewpoint Financials, Bluebeam Revu, Microsoft Project, and Microsoft 365.

Core Capabilities

  • Project planning and controls

  • Construction materials testing and inspection

  • Safety leadership and field coordination

  • Budgeting, forecasting, and cost control

  • Procurement and change management

  • Risk and quality management

  • Client and stakeholder communication

  • Team and subcontractor coordination

title: Director-IT Systems & Databases
description:
Baptist Server Services Manager in this scope is responsible for overseeing a broad range of enterprise IT infrastructure, including VMware virtualization, Windows and Linux server environments, SQL database administration, and Cisco UCS hardware. The role blends systems administration, database management, and networking to ensure high availability, performance, and security of critical systems

Key Responsibilities

Infrastructure & Virtualization

  • Manage VMware vSphere/ESXi environments, including VM creation, cloning, templates, vMotion, Storage vMotion, HA, DRS, and cluster configurations
  • Manage a team that Installs, configures, and maintains Cisco UCS servers, service profiles, and firmware upgrades
  • Manage a team that performs server consolidations using VMware Converter (P2V/P2P) and patch management via VMware Update Manager
  • Manage the deployment and configuration of vCenter and related tools (e.g., vSphere Replication, SRM) for disaster recovery

Operating Systems

  • Manage the team that Administers Windows Server (2016/2019/2022/2025) and Linux/UNIX systems, including OS installation, patching, and performance tuning
  • Manage the team that maintains Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, IIS, and other Windows services
  • Manage the team that installs and configures Red Hat Linux/UNIX in both physical and virtual environments

Database Administration

  • Manage SQL Server (2016/2019) in clustered and standalone environments, including backup/restore, performance tuning, and query optimization
  • Implement and maintain SQL coding standards, naming conventions, and data access policies
  • Troubleshoot and resolve SQL performance issues, including index and statistics optimization

Storage

  • Manage SAN/NAS environments (e.g., EMC, NetApp, PURE) for storage provisioning and performance
  • Monitor and maintain server/storage plaform security and traffic utilization

Support & Operations

  • Troubleshoot end-user and system issues, including incident ticket resolution and after-hours support
  • Create and maintain SOPs, documentation, and service requests for hardware/software purchases related to servers, storage, and data center
  • Interface with vendors and clients to resolve issues and meet expectations

Qualifications & Skills

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Proven experience as a System Administrator with VMware, Windows, Linux, SQL, and Cisco UCS
  • 7+ years in related roles within large enterprise IT environments .

Technical Skills

  • VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter, vMotion, HA, DRS, SRM, vSphere Replication
  • Cisco UCS Manager, UCS Central, service profile management
  • Windows Server administration, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, IIS
  • Linux/UNIX administration, shell scripting, automation (PowerShell, VBScript)
  • SQL Server administration, clustering, backup/restore, performance tuning
  • Networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN)
  • SAN/NAS storage management

Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills for cross-functional teams

Certifications (commonly desired)

  • VMware Certified Professional (VCP)
  • Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) or UCS certification
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator or SQL Server DBA
  • ITIL or CompTIA Security+

 Assists with interviewing and hiring of checkers, courtesy clerks, customer service counter clerks and office/bookkeepers.

 Ability to professionally handle difficult situations while projecting a positive image.

 Ability to stand or walk for long periods of time and ability to move quickly.

 Ability to operate and troubleshoot store computers and checkstand equipment such as printers, scales, public announcement equipment, scanners and cash registers.

 Knowledge of interviewing techniques, basic employment law, computer software and the analytic ability to handle administrative details such as planning and scheduling.

 Ability to supervise others, analyze and gather facts for recommending disciplinary action.

 Good understanding of company practices and in-depth understanding of Front End policies and procedures, and the ability to judge and react to business activities.

 Exposure to potential hazards exists with respect to equipment and work aids necessary to perform job duties.

 Knowledge of basic mathematics and weights and measures.

Work Environment:

Working conditions consist of a temperature-controlled store environment. Occasional exposure to outdoor environment with varying temperatures.

Job responsibilities include tasks or duties that could affect the safety or health of the employee performing the task or others.

Dependent on length of service, hours worked and any applicable collective bargaining agreement, benefits include medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance, sick pay (accrued based on hours worked), PTO/Vacation pay (accrued based on hours worked), paid holidays (9 days annually), bereavement pay, and retirement benefits (pension and/or 401k eligibility).”

title: Project Coordinator
description:
The Project Coordinator (PC) supports project management team in organizing project documentation, facilitating communication, and maintaining systems to ensure smooth execution of construction projects. The PC plays an essential role in maintaining schedule and document control and supporting job closeout and reporting.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

Demonstrate Company Values and Culture

  • Represent the company’s core values: integrity, grit, family (teamwork), quality, and growth.
  • Maintain professionalism, reliability, and consistency in all internal and external communications.
  • Exhibit emotional intelligence, adaptability, and a commitment to learning and continuous improvement.

Project Planning and Document Control

  • Assist with job setup and startup meeting documentation.
  • Upload documents and organize digital project folders in systems such as Procore or E-Builder.
  • Set up and maintain submittal logs and cost code structure in coordination with the PM/APM.
  • Prepare and distribute subcontracts and other project startup materials.
  • Maintain organized and current files, drawings, and specs on shared drives and project management platforms.

Project Execution Support

  • Collect information from subcontractors and field personnel to help generate look-ahead schedules or updates.
  • Attend jobsite and progress meetings as requested; take and distribute meeting minutes.
  • Draft and distribute RFIs, purchase orders, permits, and other project documentation.
  • Track daily reports, subcontractor deliverables, and contract requirements via E-Builder or other systems.
  • Manage bid solicitation documentation for small business and diversity participation (SBE/MBE/DBE/etc.).
  • Upload and maintain current permit records and drawing revisions.

Financial Documentation (under supervision of the Project Manager)

  • Assist in submitting job budgets and schedules of value for upload to internal systems (e.g., Sage).
  • Initiate and track Request for Quotes (RFQs) and Package Change Orders (PCOs) for approval.
  • Log and track subcontractor commitments and approved change orders.
  • Support preparation for monthly Work-In-Progress (WIP) meetings by updating job financial status.

Job Closeout

  • Assist in compiling and submitting closeout packages including warranties, inspection documents, and training materials.
  • Support coordination of punch lists and owner training schedules.
  • Ensure all closeout documentation is complete and submitted according to contract requirements.

Qualifications (Including Education and Experience)

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; associate or bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • 3+ years of experience in an administrative or construction-related support role preferred.
  • Strong computer proficiency, especially in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook).
  • Familiarity with project management platforms such as Procore or E-Builder is a plus.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and work collaboratively across project teams.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and time-management skills.

title: Vocational Instructor (Assembly Operations)
description:
Bring your industry knowledge to the next generation — step out of the tools and into teaching!

We are looking for an experienced and enthusiastic Construction Assembly and Installation Instructor to join our team at NCC East, Bircham Newton, delivering high-quality training to apprentices following the Relocatable, Modular and Portable Buildings pathway.

Hours of Work: Full-time (35 hours per week)

Working Pattern: Monday to Thursday, 8am – 4:30pm, and Fridays 8am – 11am

Contract: Permanent

Grade: SC3

Target Salary: £47,973 per annum

Location: National Construction College East, Bircham Newton, Norfolk, PE31 6RH

Provisional Interview Dates: w/c 12th October

About the Role

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced construction professional to share their practical knowledge and industry expertise, helping to develop the next generation of skilled construction workers. We are particularly interested in hearing from candidates currently working, or with recent experience, in the modular, relocatable or portable buildings sector, or from those with strong practical experience in construction assembly, installation, fit-out and site-based construction activities.

Our delivery model is 80% practical and 20% theory, with underpinning knowledge and technical understanding embedded directly into practical activities. You will use your industry experience to demonstrate real-world construction techniques, explain the principles behind the work and help apprentices understand how theory applies to the tasks they are carrying out. This hands-on approach will give apprentices the opportunity to develop the confidence, competence and workplace behaviours needed to succeed in the modular and relocatable construction sector.

You will support apprentices in developing the practical skills, knowledge and behaviours required to work safely and effectively within the industry.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Plan and deliver engaging, interactive lessons aligned to industry practices and organisational teaching strategies

  • Develop high-quality, inclusive teaching and assessment resources

  • Provide individualised support based on initial assessments and prior learning

  • Offer regular, constructive feedback to support learner progress and achievement

  • Monitor and track progress using a Learner Management System

  • Support learners to develop their English, maths, digital and employability skills

  • Work collaboratively with Apprenticeship Development Coaches and contribute to learner reviews

  • Identify learners at risk and implement effective intervention strategies

  • Promote a safe, inclusive learning environment, adhering to safeguarding and health & safety policies

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with employers, industry professionals and stakeholders

  • Stay up to date with developments in both construction and teaching methodologies

What we’re looking for:

You will ideally bring hands-on industry experience in areas such as modular building assembly, installation, positioning and connection of units, structural components, external and internal fit-out, reading and interpreting drawings, working to specifications, and working safely within a construction site environment. Experience of supervising or mentoring apprentices, trainees or junior members of a construction team would also be highly valued.

You do not need previous teaching experience. If you have the right industry background, practical skills and enthusiasm to pass your knowledge on to others, we would like to hear from you. Full support will be provided to help you develop your teaching, training and assessment skills.

Essential:

  • Minimum of Level 2 vocational qualification directly related to the role applied for

  • Relevant industry experience in the construction industry in a related role

  • Excellent knowledge of current industry practices

  • Minimum of Level 3 teaching qualification (or commitment to achieve within one year of commencing role)

  • Assessor Awards (or commitment to achieve within one year of commencing)

  • Evidence of continuous professional development

  • Excellent verbal and written skills

  • Hold a Level 2 qualification or higher in English and maths or demonstrate proficiency at Level 2 or above through a recognised assessment in both subjects

  • Excellent organisational skills

  • Knowledge, skills, and experience in Microsoft Office 365

Desirable

  • Level 3 vocational qualification directly related to the role applied for

  • Higher level construction related qualification

  • Level 5 teaching qualification

  • Experience of apprenticeship delivery

Why join CITB?

  • Free onsite lunch at NCC sites

  • Subsidised Costa Coffee on site at NCC Bircham

  • Free onsite parking

  • Free onsite gym at Bircham Newton

  • 25 days holiday + bank holidays

  • 3 additional days Christmas shutdown

  • Generous pension scheme (up to 9% employer contribution)

  • Life assurance (4x salary)

  • 2 paid volunteering days per year

  • Professional development & funded training qualifications

  • Employee Assistance Programme

  • Be part of a respected organisation shaping the future of UK construction

Closing Date

Please note that we reserve the right to close the vacancy prior to the stated closing date. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, therefore early applications are encouraged to avoid disappointment.

Safer Recruitment

CITB is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of vulnerable adults, children and young people. Candidates must be willing to undergo the requisite pre-employment vetting checks and procedures, including checks with past employers and the Disclosure and Barring Service. An enhanced DBS with child barring check is required for this post.

This role is exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974. Applicants are required to declare all criminal convictions, cautions, and warnings, including those that are spent, unless they are protected under current DBS filtering rules.

During the shortlisting process, CITB may consider carrying out an online search on shortlisted candidates as part of its due diligence.

Please note: It is a criminal offence for an individual who is barred from working in regulated activity with children or vulnerable adults to apply for this position.

Artificial Intelligence

Artificial Intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action.

We are committed to equal opportunities and recruit based on merit, skills and experience.

title: Intern Technology & Data Winter 2027
description:

Joining CPP Investments means joining one of the world’s most admired and respected institutional investors to drive a single mandate: to deliver strong, sustainable returns for generations of Canadians.

With a long-term horizon and global reach, we deploy capital at scale across public and private markets. Our size, stability, and disciplined investment philosophy allow us to pursue complex opportunities and build enduring partnerships worldwide.

We encourage you to bring your authentic self to work and take every opportunity to excel in your role to build your career at CPP Investments.

You will join us as a Junior Engineer Intern for the Fall 2026 and/or Winter 2027 in the Technology & Data Department for a 4-month, 8-month or 12-month internship based on your availability. Upon completion of your term, you will be considered for a fulltime role.

Accountabilities:

  • Designing, coding, testing, delivering, and supporting systems, applications, or solutions to meet the evolving needs of business teams following an Agile delivery approach.

  • You’ll also have the opportunity to learn and apply Java, Python, Angular, AWS and low code code/no code solutions.

You can consider the following roles:

  • Software Engineering: business aligned engineering teams that build systems and applications for front and back-office teams.

  • Data Engineering: are known as the institutional subject matter experts. The team is the center of data, technology, and business, assisting teams across the fund with data stacks, proof of concepts, logic, and analytics work bench.

  • Cloud Engineering: enables foundational cloud & AI services and shared capabilities for software engineering and business teams, driving cloud maturity and compliance.

  • Quality Engineering: are involved in the design and development of test automation in support of continuously monitoring application quality and to ensure rapid and reliable software delivery.

  • You must have a strong interest in learning new technologies and finance, as well as possessing good communication, interpersonal and relationship-building skills.

  • In addition, you will combine energy, enthusiasm, and intellectual curiosity, with a demonstrated interest in investing.


You are motivated to contribute to something larger than yourself, approach complex challenges with rigor, and hold yourself to high standards in a collaborative, performance-driven environment.


We provide colleagues with cutting-edge AI tools, dedicated learning time, and practical support to help them deliver with greater impact.

Inclusion & Accessibility

CPP Investments is committed to equitable access to employment and building a workforce that reflects diverse talent and perspectives. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

All legitimate opportunities are posted on our careers page, and communications will come from our applicant tracking system, Workday.

title: Sr Estimator
description:
Senior Estimator

Position Summary

The Senior Estimator is responsible for leading the development, estimation, and delivery of high-quality technical and commercial proposals for strategic Integrated Control & Safety System (ICSS) projects. The role provides end-to-end ownership of the proposal process, including solution development, cost estimation, risk assessment, stakeholder coordination, vendor engagement, governance approvals, proposal submission, and post-bid support.

Working closely with Sales, Operations, Engineering, Procurement, Finance, and external partners, the Senior Estimator develops competitive, compliant, and profitable solutions that maximize customer value while supporting Honeywell's strategic growth objectives. The role requires strong technical expertise, commercial acumen, leadership capability, and the ability to manage complex bid activities across multiple stakeholders and regions.

Key Responsibilities

Proposal Leadership and Strategy

  • Lead and coordinate cross-functional proposal teams to develop accurate, compliant, and commercially competitive proposals within established timelines.
  • Own the end-to-end proposal development process, from opportunity qualification through submission and post-bid support.
  • Participate in bid/no-bid reviews and contribute to proposal strategy, risk mitigation, and win themes.
  • Prepare and maintain comprehensive Proposal Execution Plans, including resource allocation, deliverables, responsibilities, milestones, and submission schedules.
  • Lead the preparation and successful submission of large-scale, complex proposals and tenders, including multi-country and international projects.

Technical Solution Development

  • Analyze customer requirements, requests for quotation, specifications, and supporting documents to develop technically compliant and commercially viable solutions.
  • Analyze, design, and develop end-to-end ICSS solutions, with a primary focus on Distributed Control Systems (DCS), SCADA, Process Safety Systems, PLCs, and associated automation technologies.
  • Develop innovative technical and commercial alternatives that optimize competitiveness, profitability, risk profile, and customer value.
  • Ensure proposed solutions align with customer requirements and Honeywell strategic initiatives, including market verticalization, new product introduction, and other growth priorities.

Estimating and Commercial Management

  • Prepare accurate cost estimates and commercial proposals for greenfield, brownfield, modernization, and service projects using approved methodologies, tools, and procedures.
  • Conduct commercial reviews to identify risks, opportunities, cost drivers, and margin improvement initiatives.
  • Develop pricing strategies that balance market competitiveness, customer value, and business profitability objectives.
  • Use applicable systems and tools to maintain accurate documentation of estimates, proposals, assumptions, exclusions, and supporting information.

Vendor and Stakeholder Management

  • Coordinate with Procurement and supporting functions to obtain technical and commercial quotations from suppliers, subcontractors, and third-party vendors.
  • Establish and maintain effective working relationships with Sales, Operations, Engineering, Finance, Procurement, suppliers, and customers to support proposal success.
  • Collaborate with regional and global teams to develop optimized technical and commercial solutions.

Proposal Governance and Compliance

  • Ensure complete and compliant responses to customer bid packages, including all required technical submissions, commercial documents, scope of supply, and supporting information.
  • Prepare and submit required approval documentation in accordance with Honeywell governance requirements.
  • Ensure proposals comply with customer specifications, company standards, contractual requirements, and applicable regulations.

Post-Bid Support and Continuous Improvement

  • Support customer technical and commercial clarification activities following proposal submission and update proposals as required.
  • Continuously enhance knowledge of Honeywell solutions, industry trends, competitor offerings, and market developments.
  • Drive standardization, process improvement, estimating best practices, and continuous improvement initiatives across the estimating community.
  • Provide coaching, guidance, and mentoring to junior estimators and proposal engineers.

Key Skills and Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline.

Experience

  • 10+ years of experience in Process Automation, Industrial Control Systems, or related engineering solutions.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in estimating, proposal management, bid execution, or commercial engineering roles.
  • Proven experience successfully delivering complete proposals for large and complex projects, including international opportunities.

Technical Competencies

  • Strong understanding of process industries, including Oil & Gas, Refining, Petrochemicals, LNG, Power, Mining, Metals, and Minerals.
  • Demonstrated technical expertise in Industrial Control Systems, including DCS, SCADA, PLC, and Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS).
  • Experience with Honeywell automation solutions, including Experion, Safety Manager, FSC, and related technologies, is highly desirable.

Leadership and Commercial Skills

  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams in a matrix organization.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, including project costing, pricing strategy, margin analysis, and risk assessment.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, negotiation, and decision-making skills.
  • Strong technical and integrative thinking skills, with the ability to develop innovative, customer-focused solutions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at all organizational levels.

We Value

  • Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering exceptional value and service.
  • Strategic thinking and strong business acumen.
  • Strong technical aptitude and systems-thinking capability.
  • Knowledge of Honeywell's automation portfolio and competitive industry solutions.
  • Ability to drive results and perform effectively in a fast-paced bid environment.
  • Strong planning, organization, and prioritization skills.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Ability to work independently with limited direction while effectively leading project teams.
  • Continuous learning mindset and commitment to professional development.
  • Mentoring and coaching capability to support team development.
  • Strong presentation and communication skills.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and related

title: Sr. Director of Strategic Partnerships, TuneLab Platform
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


Organization Overview

Lilly Catalyze360 is a comprehensive approach to enabling the early-stage biotech ecosystem by democratizing access to infrastructure, expertise, and resources. Through its interconnected pillars - Lilly Ventures, Lilly Gateway Labs, Lilly ExploR&D, and Lilly TuneLab - Catalyze360 strategically removes barriers that traditionally block bold science from becoming life-changing medicines, providing biotechs with flexible combinations of capital, physical lab space, R&D capabilities, AI/ML tools, and decades of enterprise learning.

Lilly TuneLab is an artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) platform that provides biotech companies access to drug discovery models trained on years of Lilly's research data. Lilly estimates that this first release of AI models includes proprietary data obtained at a cost of over $1 billion, representing one of the industry's most valuable datasets used to train an AI system available to biotechnology companies. By integrating advanced in silico modelling and federated learning, we connect pioneering machine learning algorithms, substantial computational power, exclusive datasets, and Lilly’s domain-specific knowledge to drive innovation in drug discovery and facilitate access to optimal therapies for patients.

Job Summary

Help transform drug discovery by building the strategic partnerships that power TuneLab's AI/ML platform.

This role is essential in supporting the growth and evolution of the Lilly TuneLab platform’s business model, and resulting partnership strategy, to ensure its success in transforming drug discovery and development.

The ideal individual will thrive at the creation of novel strategic partnerships at the intersection of AI/ML and drug discovery, and be able to operate effectively across the end-to-end strategic partnership ideation, development and execution process across a wide range of partner companies by both size and sector (e.g. tech, biotech, pharma, AI/ML startups, and service providers) collaborating with internal and external stakeholders to drive these transactions to completion.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partnership Strategy & Development

    • Evaluate and advance partnership opportunities across multiple domains as we develop the TuneLab ecosystem. Examples include:
      • AI/ML leaders: Engage with market leading AI/ML companies of all sizes to access and build next-generation AI/ML models for drug discovery.
      • Biotech: Identify data contributions that fit specific use cases, facilitating collaborations that align with platform needs.
      • Service Providers (e.g. CROs): Develop standardized and streamlined services for platform participants to ensure seamless integration into their workflows.
      • Data Acquisition and Generation: Identify and evaluate opportunities to acquire or generate data that supports the platform's AI/ML models and use cases. Establish partnerships to ensure access to high-quality data necessary for driving drug discovery outcomes.
    • Continuously evolve the platform’s strategy by understanding how AI/ML capabilities are being developed, both in commercial and open-source environments, to ensure differentiation of our offering.

  • Deal Execution and Operational Excellence

    • Own the process of continually driving deal progress, including efficiently coordinating complex multi-stakeholder internal and external review processes, while maintaining momentum, ensuring strategic partnerships progress smoothly from initial discussion through close.
    • Develop and run operational systems and processes to manage timelines, workflows, and cross-functional threads required to keep multiple transactions moving forward simultaneously.

  • Market Intelligence and Analysis

    • Monitor the competitive landscape, keeping track of technological advances and trends across the full range of current and potential future AI/ML applications in drug development, and assessing their impact on Lilly’s strategy.

  • Deal Structuring and Financial Analysis

    • Propose deal financials, backed by analysis to demonstrate the rationale and return on investment across a range of novel deal types.
    • Ensure resources are allocated to support the highest-impact initiatives aligned with our platform’s business goals.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration and Communication

    • Coordinate effectively with internal teams, including R&D, engineering, product, legal, finance, and technology to meet your objectives.
    • Communicate partnership strategy, progress, and impact to leadership and other stakeholders..

Minimum Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Biology, Chemistry or related fields.
  • Experience: 5+ years of strategic partnership experience in AI/ML, technology, biotech, life sciences, pharma, or adjacent supporting sectors.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree (Master’s, PhD, JD, or similar) with at least 8 years of strategic partnership experience in AI/ML, technology, biotech, life sciences, pharma, or adjacent supporting sectors.
  • Experience operating at the intersection of AI/ML and its application to improve all aspects of the drug discovery process, or background in biotech/pharma or technology/ tech startup environment involving complex enterprise deal structures.
  • Strong legal grounding - you are comfortable being in the details partnering with internal and external counsel drafting, reviewing and solving complex contracting challenges.
  • Demonstrated ability to run multi-step deals end-to-end, managing many simultaneous conversations, legal processes, and cross-functional threads.
  • Detail-oriented, highly reliable and intellectually sharp, with strong judgment and the ability to spot risks, implications, and structural issues early.
  • Ownership and startup mentality, for example from operating in small team, high-impact environments whether in a startup or within new initiatives or a new business unit within a corporate setting.

Personal Characteristics

  • Highly motivated by the impact our work can have on drug discovery
  • Low-ego collaborator who builds trust quickly with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders
  • A smart and thoughtful force multiplier, with strong judgment and the ability to reason clearly across legal, commercial, and operational dimensions
  • You’ve worked and thrived in environments where the roadmap wasn’t fully defined, may change regularly, and the team was small
  • Proactive and resourceful, able to anticipate needs, identify gaps, and implement solutions without being asked
  • Strategic and systematic in how you prioritize your time and resources across the many potential projects we could take on, in order to best accomplish our objectives

Additional Information

  • Lilly may provide support for or sponsor work authorization or visas for this role for internal applicants only.

description:
At MetaPhase, we believe Quirky is Cool and being authentic is the only way to be! We take the work we do very seriously and do a lot of important mission-focused work for our clients. We are individuals with different passions and strengths who take as much joy in the work we do as from those we work with. Today, we have a team that is invested in creating new solutions that lean forward, challenge the status quo, but also reflect our intimate knowledge of our customers’ business. Over the years we have fostered a culture in which we are united by shared values—passion, solidarity, generosity, curiosity, and boldness—and these come alive in the work we do and how we do it.

Together, we know our people are our difference—for our clients and our colleagues.

Are you ready to:

  • Work alongside a dedicated and diverse set of people to offer honest advice and practical guidance to our clients?

  • Learn and grow by taking advantage of every opportunity available to you?

  • Join a company which prides itself on its shared values and inclusive culture?

  • Be the difference and make it happen?

Role Summary

MetaPhase is looking for a Jr-Software Engineer, a sharp, motivated engineer who thrives at the intersection of customer mission needs, modern software engineering, and cloud-native delivery. As a Software Engineer, you will be forward deployed and work directly with customers and mission users to rapidly understand challenges, translate needs into working solutions, and deliver capabilities that can evolve with the mission. You will build across cloud infrastructure, application services, APIs, data, automation, and user experiences using modern engineering practices.

This is not a passive support role. You will engage customers, prototype and build solutions, deploy and operate production capabilities, and continuously refine them based on real-world feedback. You will use AI-assisted tools daily to accelerate development, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, analysis, and operational workflows, while applying human judgment, secure engineering practices, and automated quality checks. You will also explore and apply generative and agentic AI patterns where they can improve mission outcomes, engineering productivity, and user experience.

The environment may include AWS or Azure, cloud-native services, APIs, containers, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, modern web applications, data platforms, and automation frameworks. Experience with React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, PostgreSQL, GitHub Actions, Terraform, or similar technologies is valuable. You do not need to be an expert in every technology. You need to be capable, curious, customer-oriented, and willing to learn and adapt quickly.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Work directly with customers and mission users to understand operational challenges, clarify needs, and translate them into practical technical solutions

  • Rapidly prototype, build, test, and deploy working capabilities using cloud-native architectures, reusable components, APIs, automation, and modern development frameworks

  • Design, develop, integrate, troubleshoot, and improve application functionality across front-end, back-end, data, API, and cloud service layers

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, automated tests, observability, security controls, and deployment workflows that support frequent, reliable delivery

  • Use AI-assisted tools daily to accelerate development, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and operational workflows; apply generative and agentic AI thoughtfully with human review and quality controls

  • Partner with customers throughout delivery, demonstrating working software early, incorporating feedback quickly, and refining solutions as mission needs evolve

  • Participate in code reviews, pull requests, architecture discussions, technical discovery, and release coordination within a modern Git-based engineering workflow

What We Need From You (Required)

  • 2 to 4 years of experience in software engineering, application development, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, platform engineering, or a related technical discipline

  • Hands-on experience building, deploying, integrating, or supporting modern applications in a cloud environment

  • Working knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure, including compute, networking, identity and access management, storage, monitoring, logging, and security fundamentals

  • Experience with Git, GitHub, CI/CD, automated testing, and modern software development practices

  • Ability to debug across application, API, database, cloud, and deployment layers; comfortable connecting technical issues to user and mission outcomes

  • Genuine enthusiasm for generative AI, agentic AI, and AI-assisted software engineering, with curiosity about how these capabilities can improve the way teams design, build, test, and operate software

  • Must be located in the Washington, DC metro area and available to work from MetaPhase headquarters in Reston, Virginia four days a week.

  • U.S. Citizenship is required

What Sets You Apart (Preferred)

  • Experience with AWS or Azure certifications, or active pursuit of one

  • Experience with modern programming languages and frameworks such as Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, React, .NET, or similar technologies

  • Familiarity with cloud-native architectures, containers, APIs, serverless services, infrastructure as code, DevSecOps, or SRE practices

  • A GitHub profile, portfolio, personal project, or demo that shows you build, experiment, and ship real things

  • Experience working directly with customers, product owners, mission users, or cross-functional teams to discover needs and shape technical solutions

  • Experience applying generative AI, agentic workflows, AI coding assistants, or automated engineering tools in a software delivery environment

Work Location

  • MetaPhase headquarters in Reston, Virginia and requires 4 days a week onsite in Reston.

Travel

  • Less than 10%

Clearance Level

  • U.S. Citizenship required (NO EXCEPTIONS)

Compensation

  • Compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range for this role in the U.S. is $75,000 - $100,000.

MetaPhase Consulting is different with a purpose - demonstrating a new approach to the industry that puts employees and culture first! title: Technical Sales Engineer
description:
Cable Components Group LLC

As a part of the global industrial organization Marmon Holdings—which is backed by Berkshire Hathaway—you’ll be doing things that matter, leading at every level, and winning a better way. We’re committed to making a positive impact on the world, providing you with diverse learning and working opportunities, and fostering a culture where everyone’s empowered to be their best.

The Field Engineer serves as the technical interface between the company and its customers, providing expertise in polymer materials, plastics processing, and application development. This role supports customers in resolving technical challenges, optimizing manufacturing processes, evaluating new material technologies, and ensuring successful implementation of the company's products in the field. Field Engineer works closely with customers, engineering, operations, sales, and quality teams to deliver practical solutions and drive customer success.

Marmon Aerospace & Defense Group delivers high‑performance wire, cable, and connectivity solutions engineered for the demanding needs of aerospace, defense, space, and advanced industrial applications.

Cable Components Group, LLC (CCG) is a leading provider of components and compounds for the wire & cable and optical fiber industries, as well as yarn and nonwovens for high- temperature filtration, textiles and other uses. With 25 extrusion lines and four compounding lines, CCG growth can be attributed to its ability to produce crosswebs, tubes, insulation, jacketing and other materials. CCG holds 26 patents and five registered trademarks.

Benefits

We offer a competitive and well-rounded benefits package, including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match

  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) and paid holidays

  • Short-term and long-term disability (STD/LTD) coverage

  • Life insurance

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • Tuition reimbursement

  • Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA)

  • Employee discounts

  • And more

  • Salary Range: $100,000.00 - $120,000.00
    (Depends on industry specific and overall years of experience)

Key Responsibilities in the Role:

  • Develop a strong understanding of polymer and plastic materials, including material selection, formulation, processing, and end-use performance.
  • Provide technical support to customers by troubleshooting processing, manufacturing, and product performance issues related to polymer compounds and cable materials.
  • Collaborate with customers to identify root causes of material and processing challenges and implement effective corrective actions.
  • Support qualification and commercialization of new materials through plant trials, process optimization, small-scale wire extrusion trials, and performance evaluations.
  • Assist customers with extrusion, compounding, and cable manufacturing processes to improve productivity, quality, and product consistency.
  • Evaluate field performance data and customer feedback to drive continuous improvement and new product development initiatives.
  • Work closely with engineering, operations, sales, and quality teams to ensure successful implementation of new technologies and products.
  • Conduct on-site customer visits, technical presentations, and training sessions related to material performance, processing, and application development.
  • Provide recommendations on material selection, processing conditions, and product design based on application requirements and industry standards.
  • Prepare technical reports documenting trial results, troubleshooting activities, customer interactions, and recommendations.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Materials Science, Polymer Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Plastics Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • Minimum of 5 years of Technical Sales Engineering Experience
  • Strong understanding of polymer science, plastics engineering, and material characterization.
  • Knowledge of polymer processing technologies including extrusion, compounding, and wire & cable manufacturing.
  • Experience troubleshooting manufacturing and product performance issues.
  • Ability to analyze technical data and identify root causes of material and process-related problems.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to customers and cross-functional teams.
  • Familiarity with fluoropolymers, HFFR compounds, polyolefins, engineering thermoplastics, and thermoset materials is preferred.
  • Understanding of wire and cable industry standards and applications is an asset.
  • Ability and willingness to travel 50% of the time throughout North America, including the United States, Canada, and Mexico, to support customer visits, technical troubleshooting, product trials, and business development activities.

title: Advanced Software Engr
description:

title: Loyalty & Promotions Lead
description:
Your Style, Your Career


Harry Rosen is a proudly Canadian born and raised retailer of fine quality menswear with store locations across the nation. We have been specializing in luxury menswear for over 70 years and have been officially recognized as one of Canada’s Best Managed Companies. We are committed to developing retail professionals who love retail and have the passion and ability to inspire exceptional service.


Loyalty & Promotions Lead

Full Time

Reporting to: Director of CRM & Loyalty

Toronto, Ontario

Harry Rosen Inc. Central Office (77 Bloor St. West)

Hybrid Work Environment

Your Style, Your Career

Harry Rosen is a proudly Canadian born and raised retailer of fine quality menswear with store locations across the nation. We have been specializing in luxury menswear for over 70 years and have been officially recognized as one of Canada’s Best Managed Companies. We are committed to developing retail professionals who love retail and have the passion and ability to inspire exceptional service.

We are seeking an organized, detail-oriented, and proactive Loyalty & Promotions Lead to execution of loyalty programming, promotional campaigns, and marketing technology platform management across Harry Rosen and Final Cut. This role will help drive customer retention and engagement by executing best-in-class loyalty and promotional campaigns, while owning key platforms including Talon.One and CommerceTools.

The ideal candidate is a strong project manager with sharp attention to detail and a natural collaborator, who enjoys working across multiple platforms and priorities at once — from campaign execution and QA to performance reporting — in a fast-moving retail environment.

Key Responsibilities

Loyalty Program Strategy Support

  • Execute the CLUB HARRY loyalty program strategy, supporting retention, engagement, and lifecycle objectives across tiers.
  • Own the design and execution of loyalty-led initiatives, including points- and tier-based incentives and personalized member experiences.
  • Translate strategic priorities into loyalty mechanics that drive repeat purchase, frequency, and long-term member value.
  • Partner with Retail teams to identify, design, and execute in-store and cross-channel loyalty activations.
  • Partner cross-functionally to embed loyalty into broader brand and commercial initiatives.
  • Surface opportunities to evolve earn and burn mechanics, tier engagement, experiential benefits, and overall program performance, feeding recommendations into the loyalty roadmap.

Loyalty & Promotions Budget Management

  • Support planning, tracking, and forecasting of the loyalty and promotions budget in alignment with business priorities.
  • Monitor in-season budget consumption to ensure effective allocation, ROI, and optimization.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to provide budget insights that inform campaign prioritization and investment decisions.
  • Provide budget insights that inform campaign prioritization, and escalating investment decisions to the Director.

Campaign Platforms & Marketing Technology

  • Serve as the primary business owner for Talon.One, managing configuration, use cases, and operational issues within business operations.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for CommerceTools, promotions, and overseeing configurations for all promotional activity.
  • Oversee loyalty and promotions integrations across Talon.One, CommerceTools, and Braze, ensuring consistency and best practice application
  • Collaborate with platform vendors and internal stakeholders to unlock new capabilities and features, as well as day-to-day capability requests.
  • Lead platform enablement and documentation to ensure platforms are scalable and well understood cross-functionally
  • Act as the go-to resource for troubleshooting Talon.One and CommerceTools issues related to all promotional activity, providing guidance, working with relevant teams or escalating as needed.

Campaign Development, Personalization & Execution

  • Own design and execution of loyalty and promotional campaigns within Talon.One and CommerceTools, delivering against retention, engagement, and commercial objectives
  • Act as the Loyalty and promotions Channel Owner, partnering with Marketing teams to deliver on-brand execution across channels.
  • Drive personalization and testing initiatives, including experimentation and A/B testing, using segmentation strategy, applying customer behavior, lifecycle stage, spend patterns, and tier status
  • Own campaign QA, troubleshooting, and deployment timelines to ensure accurate and timely execution
  • Lead set up of promotions and cart discounts for Final Cut initiatives in CommerceTools and oversee integration into Talon.One
  • Ensure advisor-facing assets and marketing campaigns are set up within the CRM platform to support customer-facing teams in delivering loyalty and promotional offers.

Data & Analytics

  • Advocate on behalf of the loyalty team for required data stewardship.
  • Identify data needs and enhancements that improve the effectiveness of loyalty and promotional strategies.
  • Monitor and report on campaign performance, including revenue and results, and extract insights to share with the Director and relevant stakeholders.
  • Partner with Analytics to deliver post-campaign insights that inform future loyalty and promotional strategy, translating into actionable recommendations.
  • Use data to recommend optimizations that improve long-term customer value and program effectiveness.
  • Provide timely, actionable feedback on offer performance and loyalty campaigns, sharing debriefs and suggested changes with relevant stakeholders.

Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of experience in loyalty, CRM, or promotions marketing, ideally within retail or a related customer-focused industry
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience managing marketing technology platforms and vendor relationships (e.g., Talon.One, CommerceTools, Braze, or similar tools).
  • Experience tracking budgets, workback schedules, collaborating and organizing teams cross functionally.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and project management tools such as Asana.
  • Willingness to work occasional evenings and weekends during peak campaign or promotional periods (e.g., major sales events, Final Cut launches).

What You'll Bring

  • A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset.
  • Ability to pivot quickly and voice creative suggestions to business scenarios.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to remain calm and adaptable in fast-paced environments.
  • Passion for creating seamless, on-brand loyalty and promotional experiences for our clients.
  • A collaborative approach and willingness to roll up your sleeves when needed.

What are the perks of the job?

  • Competitive pay program – there is no limit on your earnings at Harry Rosen and the more you sell, the more you will earn.
  • Opportunities to additionally earn monthly and annual Team bonuses
  • Best in industry discounts and special purchase opportunities
  • A comprehensive flexible benefits package
  • Pension and Group RRSP Programs that grow with you
  • A modern, digitally advanced workplace
  • A coach committed to supporting the achievement of your personal career goals
  • A culture that is rich and diverse fostered through an internal Inclusivity Council
  • An employer that values internal growth and promotion and is committed to succession planning for your future

** Compensation for this role will be dependent on skills, experience, and seniority. The starting compensation range for this role is $72K - $85K annually.

We thank you for your interest in this opportunity.


Harry Rosen Inc. is committed to ensuring that our environment is barrier-free to all persons, employees, and clients alike, as we believe in equal opportunity and fostering a diverse and inclusive environment. In the spirit of this philosophy, we are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to all applicants with accommodation needs in the interview and assessment process. If you need assistance during the selection process, please contact us at careers@harryrosen.com with details.

description:

We are privately held, debt-free, and partnered with thousands of national and regional carriers across LTL, truckload, and expedited freight. We are a rapidly growing company, with offices and sales teams expanding across the country.



Job Description


Summary:

The Credit Analyst role provides analytical and credit evaluation support for the Financial Services team including an independent analysis of creditworthiness for new and existing customers. Responsibilities include: Approving and controlling extension of credit to customers, validating billing requirements and promoting efficient payment processes, maintaining professional relationships with internal and external contacts, including support, sales and customers. Description:

• Communicate with Internal partners on credit decisions and ensure timely review of pending credit requests

• Review and approve extended terms requests per LOA guidelines

• Participates in periodic reviews with financial services leadership and take necessary action to improve performance.

• Prepare narrative analysis of findings and recommendations for any credit request which exceeds their LOA.

• Review accounts on credit hold by assessing credit worthiness of customers, including financial ratings, open invoices, in-process payments and backlog, and make recommendations for order release to supervisor.

• Provides administrative support for financial services leadership, Credit reviews, ad-hoc reporting, routine tasks for top accounts, etc.

Job Requirements:

• Credit, Accounts Receivable, accounting, finance or general business; 3+ years required; 5+ years preferred.

• Willingness to accommodate temporary changes in the normal working hours as required by workflow; required.

Requires extended periods of sitting, normal walking, bending, twisting, and stretching. Capability of sight and hearing required. Responsibilities:

Develop and implement field education programs in accordance with CSWE accreditation standards including assessment of learning and agency setting, development and oversight of policies and procedures, orientation for students and field instructors, contract management, compliance with oversite bodies for field placement, and oversite of field placements.
