title: Medieprofil, Svenska Yle Humor
description:
Drömmer du om att bli en medieprofil för Yle Humor? Vill du synas och höras på Yle Arenan och våra TikTok- och Instagramkonton – och göra innehåll som folk snackar om? Då är det dig vi söker till Svenska Yle Humor!

Mer om jobbet

Som profil är du Yle Humors ansikte utåt på våra digitala plattformar. Du skapar och medverkar på Yle Arenan, Yle appen, Yle X3M, TikTok, Instagram och Youtube där vi utvecklar nya format och innehållsidéer. Du är snabb på att snappa upp trender och vet hur man gör innehåll som får publiken att skratta, dela och kommentera.

Till dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter hör att du:

  • Planerar, spelar in och medverkar i videor. Bidrar med kreativa idéer och är med i hela processen från koncept till publicering.

  • Interagerar aktivt med följarna i kommentarsfält och DM:s och deltar i communitybyggandet kring vårt innehåll.

  • Samarbetar med videoredaktörer, producenter och programledare för att skapa unikt och engagerande innehåll.

  • Medverkar i Yle Humors specialprojekt, livesändningar och evenemang.

  • Medverkar i Yle X3M:s sändningar.

Anställningen är en tillsvidareanställning. Placeringsorten är Helsingfors eller Vasa.

Om du är intresserad av att samarbeta med oss via din firma eller på projektbasis får du gärna nämna det i din ansökan.

Vad förväntar vi oss av dig?

  • Du har fingertoppskänsla för trender bland unga och älskar att scrolla TikTok, Instagram och YouTube.

  • Du är bekväm och naturlig framför kameran – du kan både improvisera och planera.

  • Du har humor, energi och personlighet som märks och smittar av sig.

  • Du har erfarenhet av att skapa innehåll för sociala medier, gärna för en ung målgrupp.

  • Du är kreativ, initiativrik och van att jobba både självständigt och i team.

  • Du behärskar svenska flytande – övriga språk är ett plus.

  • Du är kommunikativ och gillar att bygga relationer med publiken.

Varför jobba hos oss?

Svenska Yle Humor är en dynamisk arbetsplats med stor vilja att skapa underhållande innehåll. Det finns mycket utrymme för kreativitet och innovativa sätt att nå ut till vår publik.

Vi är en humorredaktion som skapar dagligt audio- och videoinnehåll för en ung svensktalande publik. Vare sig det är liveradio, serier på Yle Arenan, sketcher på some eller uppträdanden på evenemang så vill vi leverera det bästa Svenskfinland har att erbjuda.

Intresserad?

Skicka din ansökan med personligt brev, CV och gärna ett urval av dina bästa inlägg på sociala media senast 30.09.2026 kl 23.59.

Bifoga en video där du berättar varför du vill bli Svenska Yle Humors nästa profil! Lägg videon i en moln- eller videotjänst och bifoga länken till videon i ansökningsblanketten. Se till att alla med länken kan se videon.

Mångfalden i arbetsgemenskapen är viktig för oss och vi välkomnar sökande med olika bakgrund.

Intervjuer kan inledas redan innan ansökningstiden gått ut.

Frågor?

Kontakta innehållsproducenterna Simon Karlsson (simppa.karlsson@yle.fi, kontorstid 0504910275), Mathias Jylhä(mathias.jylha@yle.fi) eller ansvarig producent Dan Granqvist (dan.granqvist@yle.fi, kontorstid 0401909161)

Ansök och bli en del av vårt kreativa team!

title: Learning & Development Coordinator
description:
About Four Seasons:

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

Four Seasons Resort and Residences Dominican Republic at Tropicalia will feature 95 keys and 25 branded residential homes, 8 distinct F&B outlets, all thoughtfully designed to reflect a contemporary interpretation of the Dominican Republic’s natural beauty. Wellness will be a defining pillar of the property, delivering a holistic experience that harmonizes with the natural environment while enhancing overall wellbeing through the restorative power of nature. The sustainable luxury destination is located on a 60-acre (24 hectare) site along the pristine beachfront of Playa Esmeralda in northeastern Dominican Republic, along the southern shores of Samaná Bay. A site of breathtaking natural beauty, Tropicalia is home to a diverse ecosystem of white-sand beaches; crystalline, aquamarine water and coral reefs; mountains, forests, mangroves, lagoons and rivers; a working coconut plantation; and an organic farm.

About the Role

Four Seasons Resort and Residences Dominican Republic at Tropicalia is seeking a Learning and Development Coordinator to join our pre-opening team. Reporting to the Learning and Development Manager, this position will coordinate and support learning programs that bring the Four Seasons culture, service standards and Golden Rule to life while creating an organized, engaging and welcoming learning experience for every employee.

What You Will Do

  • Coordinate the logistics, materials, schedules, attendance and communications for all property learning and development programs.
  • Support the delivery of the Four Seasons induction and onboarding programs, including Embark, cultural orientation and Tropicalia immersion experiences.
  • Participate in pre-opening activities by coordinating high-volume orientation, onboarding and service-culture training for newly hired employees.
  • Facilitate selected orientation, culture, service and compliance-training sessions in English and Spanish.
  • Maintain the annual and monthly training calendars and coordinate learning activities with department leaders and departmental trainers.
  • Schedule training rooms, audiovisual equipment, transportation, meals, printed materials and other resources required for each learning experience.
  • Maintain accurate employee learning records, attendance reports, completion status, certifications and training documentation in the applicable learning-management systems.
  • Monitor completion of mandatory corporate and local training and follow up with employees and department leaders regarding outstanding requirements.
  • Prepare training reports, presentations, surveys, certificates and communications and support the evaluation of program effectiveness.
  • Assist with the development, adaptation and translation of training materials, presentations, facilitator guides, job aids and digital-learning content.
  • Support the coordination and development of departmental trainers, ensuring they have the materials, guidance and resources required to deliver effective skills training.
  • Partner with People and Culture and operational departments to identify learning needs, service gaps and opportunities to strengthen employee performance.
  • Support employee-development initiatives, leadership programs, cross-training, internships, school partnerships and career-development activities.
  • Maintain an organized and welcoming learning environment and ensure that all training materials, supplies and equipment are properly stored and available.
  • Support learning events, recognition activities and other People and Culture initiatives as required.

What You Bring

  • University degree or technical qualification in Education, Psychology, Human Resources, Hospitality Management, Communications or a related field.
  • One to three years of experience in Learning and Development, training coordination, Human Resources or hospitality operations. Previous luxury-hospitality experience is preferred.
  • Strong organizational and administrative skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple programs, schedules and participants simultaneously.
  • Confident presentation and facilitation skills, creativity and a genuine passion for helping others learn and grow.
  • Fluency in Spanish and English is required, along with proficiency in Microsoft Office. Experience with learning-management systems, digital content or instructional-design tools is preferred.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package.
  • Excellent training and professional-development opportunities.
  • Opportunities for career growth within Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts.
  • Employee travel program, including complimentary and discounted stays at Four Seasons properties worldwide, subject to program eligibility.
  • Complimentary dry cleaning for employee uniforms.
  • Complimentary employee meals while on duty.
  • A supportive and inclusive work environment built on mutual respect, collaboration and the Golden Rule.

Schedule & Hours

  • This is a full-time position.
  • The primary schedule will be during regular business hours; however, flexibility to work early mornings, evenings, weekends or public holidays may be required based on orientation schedules, training programs, employee events and operational needs.

Work Authorization

Candidates must be legally eligible to work in the Dominican Republic.

Four Seasons Resort and Residences Dominican Republic at Tropicalia is committed to providing an inclusive workplace in which all individuals are treated with dignity and respect. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, experience and business requirements, without discrimination on any basis protected by applicable law.

title: IT Help Desk Specialist
description:
Job Description Summary

The IT Help Desk Specialist is responsible for assisting employees with the setup and support of a variety of equipment, systems and applications. This includes, but is not limited to, workstations, computers, tablets, phones, Windows, networking and iOS.

This position is on-site at our Cudahy, WI location.



Job Description:

Role & Responsibilities

  • Install, maintain, and upgrade computer hardware and software.
  • Provide support on laptop computers, tablets, smart phones, printers, networks, phone systems, etc.
  • Provide support on Windows and iOS based applications.
  • Support cloud-based solutions (i.e. Office 365).
  • Monitor status of systems and applications – responding to reported events and issues.
  • Track and document support issues and projects.
  • Maintain inventory and document systems, and applications.
  • Follow safe work practices and accident prevention procedures.
  • Communicate directly and indirectly with staff and other support resources.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications and Education Requirements

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • 3+ years of experience or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Windows Operating Systems and iOS experience.
  • Experience with Microsoft Office and Office 365 applications/services
  • High proficiency in technology, systems, tools and applications.
  • Maintain a high degree of confidentiality.
  • Excellent planning and organizational skills.
  • Strong customer service skills.
  • Ability to work independently.
  • Strong attention to detail and problem solving.
  • Strong verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Willingness to learn and use training options when available.

Physical Requirements

  • This job operates in an office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, filing cabinets, photocopiers and fax machines.
  • Employees are frequently required to sit, and occasionally required to kneel, reach, stoop, crouch or crawl.
  • This position requires the ability to lift files, open file cabinets, and bend or stand as necessary.
  • This position may occasionally lift up to 25 pounds.

title: Production Technician
description:
As a Production Technician, you operate equipment to manufacture plastic containers for leading consumer brands. At our company, we take pride in maintaining our high standards for quality products & a positive team culture. We’re also proud to be recognized as an America’s Safest Companies by EHS Today.

We Offer:

  • Set Schedules: 12-hour shifts & a rotating 2-week standard schedule of 3 days, then 4 days is 15 working days a month as a full-time associate!
  • Stability & Growth: We follow a strong promote-from-within business practice and offer a stable job through current market uncertainty!
  • Comfort: Our food-grade facility is exceptionally clean & climate-controlled!
  • State-of-the-Art Equipment: Work with our top of the line blow molding & extrusion equipment from industry leaders, such as Sidel and Husky, as well as our own proprietary technologies!

As a Production Technician, You Will:

  • Operate a variety of top-of-the-line extrusion & blow-molding manufacturing equipment in a clean, safe & climate-controlled environment
  • Monitor equipment, making adjustments to settings (heat control, water cooling temperatures, hydraulic pressure, etc.) to produce high-quality rigid plastic containers
  • Troubleshoot equipment & perform routine preventative maintenance
  • Assure Plastipak customer requirements are met by performing quality checks for specifications, such as bottle weights & dimensions

This Is A Great Fit If You Have:

  • High School Diploma, GED or equivalent
  • A minimum of one (1) year of experience as a Manufacturing Process Technician working with equipment used for high-volume production
  • Working knowledge of extrusion or blow molding equipment is preferred
  • Hydraulics, pneumatics & electrical mechanical basic knowledge
  • Ability to troubleshoot & problem solve

Pay & Shift

  • Days: 6:30am-7:00pm (3-2-2-3 Schedule)
  • $25+/hr.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Innovation Hub Overview

Jefferies is creating a Technology Innovation Hub in Pune, a greenfield opportunity to build the systems that power global markets. As our first India technology center, this hub brings together hands on builders who engineer the platforms behind Jefferies’ growth across capital markets, investment banking, and institutional securities. We’re scaling toward an elite team of 500 engineers while maintaining the agility, ownership, and meritocratic spirit that defines Jefferies. From cloud and data to AI, risk, and core business technologies, teams in Pune will lead high impact work with a global mandate.

IT Corporate Technology

Corporate Technology powers Jefferies’ enterprise operations, enabling front-, middle-, and back-office teams to run efficiently, securely, and in compliance at scale. The group delivers and supports integrated platforms across HR, Finance, Compliance & Legal, Treasury, Client Onboarding, Operations, Centralized Data Services, Regulatory Reporting, Loan Operations, and FX Trading, while also leading firmwide digitalization initiatives focused on automation and process efficiency.

The team uses modern technology stack—including AWS and Azure, Snowflake, Qlik Sense, and best-in-class vendor solutions—to build next-generation capabilities in AI/ML, enterprise analytics, and process automation (RPA and low-code/no-code). Roles in Corporate Technology offer hands-on work with cloud, data, and automation platforms, close collaboration with engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders, and end-to-end exposure to how a global financial services firm operates

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Full Stack Developer to join our cross-functional Agile team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable end-to-end applications, developing responsive user interfaces with React, backend services in Python, and real-time data pipelines using Kafka. The role requires strong system design skills and close collaboration across frontend, backend, and platform teams. You will collaborate closely with backend and frontend engineers, product managers, and analysts to create analytics-ready data models that power application features, reporting, and strategic insights. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who values clean data design, modern tooling, and working at the intersection of engineering and business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop responsive, high-performance UIs using React
  • Build reusable components and manage application state
  • Integrate REST and/or GraphQL APIs
  • Ensure accessibility, usability, and cross-browser compatibility
  • Design and develop backend services and APIs using Python
  • Implement business logic, authentication, and authorization
  • Work with cloud databases (Snowflake)
  • Write clean, testable, and maintainable code
  • Design and maintain Kafka producers and consumers
  • Build event-driven architectures and real-time data pipelines
  • Ensure message reliability, ordering, and fault tolerance
  • Monitor and troubleshoot Kafka clusters and streams
  • Work closely with analysts and stakeholders to gather data requirements and translate them into reliable data models.
  • Participate in system design and architecture discussions
  • Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
  • Optimize application performance and scalability
  • Support CI/CD pipelines and deployments
  • Maintain documentation and coding standards
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies (e.g., stand-ups, sprint planning)

Mandatory Qualifications & Skills

  • Strong experience with React (hooks, component lifecycle, state management)
  • Strong experience with Python (FastAPI, Flask, or Django)
  • Hands-on experience with Apache Kafka
  • Experience building RESTful APIs
  • Proficiency with SQL and relational databases
  • Familiarity with Git-based version control workflows.
  • Event-driven and microservices architectures
  • Asynchronous processing and messaging patterns
  • API design and versioning
  • Performance tuning and scalability
  • Experience with TypeScript
  • Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes
  • Cloud experience (AWS)
  • Experience with schema registries and stream processing (Kafka Streams)
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools (Grafana)
  • Exposure to security best practices (OAuth, JWT)
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across engineering and business teams.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments and managing work using Jira.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field.
  • A strong sense of ownership, documentation habits, and attention to data quality and performance.

Please review the following job description:

Performs analytics, reporting, dashboard development, and process automation on technology-driven data sets to support business decision making. Defines data requirements; collects, processes, cleans, analyzes, and visualizes data to identify patterns and trends; and provides actionable insights that inform business strategies. Creates and maintains dashboards, scorecards, recurring and ad hoc reporting, executive reporting, and automated workflows that improve operational efficiency, strengthen data quality, and support complex data science initiatives.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Following is a summary of the essential functions for this job. Other duties may be performed, both major and minor, which are not mentioned below. Specific activities may change from time to time.

  • Collects, processes, cleans, validates, and reconciles large technology-related data sets to ensure accuracy and reliability.
  • Analyzes data to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and business impacts that support informed business decisions.
  • Designs, develops, and maintains dashboards, scorecards, and data visualizations that communicate actionable insights to leadership and stakeholders.
  • Provides support for building custom dashboards and ad hoc reports.
  • Creates, manages, and delivers all recurring and ad hoc operational, risk, financial, governance, and executive reporting, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and timely distribution.
  • Develops automated reporting, data collection, data transformation, and workflow solutions to reduce manual effort, improve efficiency, and strengthen data quality.
  • Builds and maintains data pipelines, queries, models, and reporting solutions using analytics, automation, and business intelligence tools.
  • Collaborates with cross-functional teams to define reporting requirements and establish key performance indicators, key risk indicators, and other performance metrics.
  • Develops and apply statistical models and algorithms to support predictive analytics and business forecasting.
  • Identifies opportunities to streamline, standardize, and automate reporting and analytics processes.
  • Supports complex data science and big data initiatives by providing expert analytics input.
  • Works independently on moderately complex projects with limited supervision.
  • May provide guidance to junior analytics professionals within project contexts.
  • Ensures compliance with data governance and security standards in all analytics activities.

Qualifications
Required Qualifications
The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or related discipline.
  • Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in analytics or data science roles.
  • Proficiency in statistical analysis tools and programming languages such as SQL, Python, or R.
  • Strong knowledge of data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree (Master’s) in Data Science, Analytics, or related field.
  • Experience with big data technologies and platforms (e.g., Hadoop, Spark).
  • Certifications in analytics or data science (e.g., Certified Analytics Professional).
  • Experience in the enterprise technology sector or related industry.
  • Familiarity with machine learning techniques and tools.
  • Experience developing production dashboards, comprehensive reporting, and automated workflows using business intelligence and automation platforms.

The annual base salary for this position is $110,000 to $140,000.

title: Tooling Coordinator
description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Production Worker / Technician is responsible for assembling, testing, and inspecting products to ensure they meet quality and safety standards. This role supports the manufacturing process by identifying defects, maintaining equipment, and following production protocols.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously.


Key Responsibilities
Assemble and test products according to specifications.
Inspect finished goods for defects and report issues.
Maintain and clean production equipment.
Follow safety and quality standards.
Document production activities and test results.

title: Senior Data Engineer - Data Science & AI Enablement
description:
Make banking a Fifth Third better®
We connect great people to great opportunities. Are you ready to take the next step? Discover a career in banking at Fifth Third Bank.

GENERAL FUNCTION:

The data engineer designs and builds platforms, tools, and solutions that help the bank manage, secure, and generate value from its data. The person in this role creates scalable and reusable solutions for gathering, collecting, storing, processing, and serving data on both small and very large (i.e. Big Data) scales. These solutions can include on-premise and cloud-based data platforms, and solutions in any of the following domains ETL, business intelligence, analytics, persistence (relational, NoSQL, data lakes), search, messaging, data warehousing, stream processing, and machine learning.

Responsible and accountable for risk by openly exchanging ideas and opinions, elevating concerns, and personally following policies and procedures as defined. Accountable for always doing the right thing for customers and colleagues, and ensures that actions and behaviors drive a positive customer experience. While operating within the Bank's risk appetite, achieves results by consistently identifying, assessing, managing, monitoring, and reporting risks of all types.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Work closely with IT application teams, Enterprise architecture, infrastructure, information security, and LOB stakeholders to translate business and technical strategies into data-driven solutions for the Bank.
- Act as a technical Expert addressing problems related to system and application design, performance, integration, security, etc.

- Provide Support and troubleshooting for data platforms. Must be willing to Provide escalated on-call Support for complicated and/or critical incidents.

title: Import Compliance Senior Analyst
description:
R286431 Import Compliance Senior Analyst (Open)

Dell's Global Trade Compliance organization enables seamless, compliant, efficient trade of technologies and services across borders by defining Dell's Trade Compliance Policy, utilizing controls, driving accountability, using measures of success and mitigating risk, establishing Dell as a reliable and trusted trading partner. We’re experts in what we do, from assessing global trade risk and providing mitigation strategies, to delivering strategic and tactical support in developing international supply chains, to implementing strategies to reduce import expenses and auditing all documentation.

Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as a Import Compliance Senior Analyst on our Trade team in Bangalore, India.


What you’ll achieve

Import compliance has never been more critical or more complex. Customs enforcement is intensifying globally, with authorities increasing audits, tightening classification and valuation scrutiny, and modernizing their regulatory frameworks at an unprecedented pace

At Dell Technologies, our import compliance team is at the heart of keeping our global services supply chain moving — accurately, efficiently, and in full regulatory compliance.

Reporting to the EMEA Trade Compliance Director, you will be part of a team that manages both import and export compliance activities across EMEA. You will work in a fast-paced, rapidly changing regulatory environment collaborating with internal teams such as Legal, Logistics, and Tax, as well as external partners, customs brokers, and government agencies to support and enable growth while maintaining an exceptional level of compliance.


You will:

  • Support end-to-end customs operations for Dell's Services organisation across EMEA, ensuring all import activities are processed accurately, efficiently, and in full compliance with local and regional customs regulations.
  • Manage and resolve documentation issues within Dell's Oracle Global Trade Management (GTM) system
  • Prepare, review, and maintain import documentation including commercial invoices, certificates of origin, customs declarations, and transport documents, ensuring a clear, auditable trail between declarations and accounting records.
  • Respond to information requests from customs authorities, internal stakeholders, and customs brokers, providing accurate and timely compliance guidance.
  • Analyse and recommend optimal customs processing methods for Dell products, balancing cost efficiency with full regulatory compliance.
  • Support the maintenance and enhancement of Dell's Authorised Economic Operator (AEO) status, a trusted trader designation that provides benefits including reduced inspections and expedited clearance.
  • Monitor and maintain operating reporting metrics, providing data-driven insights to support compliance decision-making.
  • Contribute to HTS classification reviews and country of origin determinations, helping ensure classification accuracy is maintained as products and regulations evolve.
  • Participate in cross-functional trade and supply chain projects designed to strengthen and enhance both regional and global compliance programmes.


Take the first step towards your dream career
Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here’s what we are looking for with this role:

Essential Requirements

  • 3+ years' experience in an import trade compliance role with demonstrable knowledge of key customs processes and the practical application of customs regulations.
  • Knowledge of customs valuation methods, Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) classification, and country of origin determination
  • Practical experience with import documentation requirements, including commercial invoices, certificates of origin, customs declarations, and transport documents.
  • Familiarity with Authorised Economic Operator (AEO) or equivalent trusted trader programmes (e.g., C-TPAT) and the compliance standards required to maintain such status.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to convey complex customs requirements to diverse audiences, including non-specialist stakeholders.
  • Good analytical, problem-solving, and risk management abilities, with a collaborative, team-oriented working style.
  • A strong focus on modernisation and process improvement.


Desirable Requirements

  • Experience with Oracle Global Trade Management (GTM) or comparable trade management systems
  • Good product, technology, or industry knowledge
  • Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, Logistics, Customs & Trade, International Business, or a related field — or equivalent professional experience.
  • Relevant professional certifications
  • Confident presentation skills and strong attention to detail

Here’s our story; now tell us yours

Dell Technologies helps organizations and individuals build a brighter digital tomorrow. Our company is made up of more than 150,000 people, located in over 180 locations around the world. We’re proud to be a diverse and inclusive team and have an endless passion for our mission to drive human progress.

What’s most important to us is that you are respected, feel like you can be yourself and have the opportunity to do the best work of your life -- while still having a life. We offer excellent benefits, bonus programs, flexible work arrangements, a variety of career development opportunities, employee resource groups, and much more.

We started with computers, but we didn’t stop there. We are helping customers move into the future with multi-cloud, AI and machine learning through the most innovative technology and services portfolio for the data era. Join us and become a part of what’s next in technology, starting today.

You can also learn more about us by reading our latest Diversity and Inclusion Report and our plan to make the world a better place by 2030 here.

All employment decisions at Dell are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national, social or ethnic origin, sex (including pregnancy), age, physical, mental or sensory disability, HIV Status, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital, civil union or domestic partnership status, past or present military service, family medical history or genetic information, family or parental status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. description:

About Chubb India

We are proud to share that we have been officially certified as a Great Place to Work® for the third consecutive year, reflecting the culture at Chubb, where we believe in fostering an environment where everyone can thrive, innovate, and grow. With a team of over 2500 talented professionals, we encourage a start-up mindset that promotes collaboration, diverse perspectives, and a solution-driven attitude. We offer an environment where you will be part of an organisation that is dedicated to solving real-world challenges in the insurance industry. Role Overview

  • Familiarity with Redux or similar state management libraries.

  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.

  • Familiarity with Azure DevOps.

  • Understanding of microservices and distributed systems.

  • Experience with unit testing and automated testing frameworks.

  • Exposure to Agile / Scrum methodologies.

  • Experience in the Insurance domain is a plus.

  • Familiarity with insurance business processes such as policy administration, underwriting, claims, billing, renewals, and endorsements is preferred.

Nice to Have

title: Managing Director, Strategy and Transformation
description:
Who We Are


FTI Consulting is the leading global expert firm for organizations facing crisis and transformation. We work with many of the world’s top multinational corporations, law firms, banks and private equity firms on their most important issues to deliver impact that makes a difference. From resolving disputes, navigating crises, managing risk and optimizing performance, our teams respond rapidly to dynamic and complex situations.

At FTI Consulting, you’ll work side-by side with leaders who have shaped history, helping solve the biggest challenges making headlines today. From day one, you’ll be an integral part of a focused team where you can make a real impact. You’ll be surrounded by an open, collaborative culture that embraces diversity, recognition, professional development and, most importantly, you.

Are you ready to make your impact?

About The Role

This is a unique opportunity to be in the center of a major transformation of a ~$2B company, with tremendous opportunity for growth and upside either within the corporate team or in line roles within our business segments.

We have built a strong corporate center to drive the transformation, and we are looking for top performers to join the Strategy & Transformation team. The team at FTI directly supports the CEO, FTI’s Executive Committee, and other senior leaders within FTI’s corporate infrastructure teams on strategic and change initiatives including:

  • Defining the overall corporate strategy across FTI’s portfolio of businesses

  • Identifying and driving organic growth opportunities within the segments

  • Supporting M&A / business development activity (due diligence, valuation, integration)

  • Improving processes within internal corporate functions (e.g., Finance, HR, IT, Real Estate)

  • Maintaining the firm’s world-class client service and go-to-market practices

What You’ll Do

  • Leads project strategy for multiple projects simultaneously from beginning to end supporting the senior business leader, along with providing expertise and support to other initiatives the S&T team has underway.

  • Leads and mentors project teams, including mentoring and coaching other MDs and junior staff on leading projects.

  • Drives innovative thinking on strategy development and problem solving based on own experience and others' expertise; supports risk-taking by others.

  • Uses deep expertise in Strategy/Finance to structure approaches to address complex projects and ambiguous problems, understands and articulates the potential paths to solutions, and aligns the right people/resources against the right work streams.

  • Helps the team to prioritize analyses, develop work plans and eliminate roadblocks; "manages upward" to avoid overloading the team, and "manages downward" to ensure timely delivery of quality work product.

  • Manages and conducts objective analysis/research on current and emerging market trends, firm competitors, project/staff management, financial performance, key operating metrics, and other related topics to inform strategic options.

  • Translates strategies into actionable plans with clear owners, timing/milestones and deliverables.

  • Clearly summarizes gathered data and facts, develops logical and compelling storylines and presentations, confidently communicates/presents findings to Executive Committee and to other senior management; Expresses own opinion supported by data/facts.

  • Develops various business scenarios and financial models based on changing economic, regulatory and other trends; effectively communicates financial implications to senior management.

  • Understands the budgeting/forecast processes, e.g., linking with business strategy, projecting revenue and expense from both a top-down and bottoms-up approach, assessing risks and opportunities.

  • Influences optimal allocation of resources through budgeting, forecasting, planning, variance analysis, and in co-ordination with corporate and line functions.

  • Assists in the development, consistent definition, tracking and reporting of key financial and operational performance indicators.

  • Understands key business drivers and how to translate business problems into relevant/understandable financial analysis that can be used for decision making

  • Understands GAAP accounting principles and is familiar with reporting requirements for a publicly traded company, e.g., quarterly filings (particularly MD&A), investor relations.

  • Proactively manages team, restructuring where necessary, to deliver optimal output

  • Develops deep, trusted advisor relationships with Executive Committee members and senior management.

  • Writes in compelling ways in both vertical and horizontal formats; creatively conveys analyses, data, insights and recommendations.

  • Demonstrates a high tolerance for ambiguity; deals well with unexpected and adverse situations.

  • Strives for high-quality deliverables; drives projects to deliver impact for the firm.

  • Understands how his/her efforts/projects fits into the broader business context/strategy.

  • Travels (~10%) to other FTI offices as needed.

The ideal candidate will:

  • Serve as an inspiring model of the firm's value to the team; able to influence others to behave with integrity.

  • Exhibit a strong sense of ownership towards own work and the team's; holds her/himself accountable for mistakes and learns from them.

  • Cultivate deep, continuing partnerships with internal and external stakeholders (“clients”), who seek him/ her out for advice, build trusted advisor relationships over time.

  • Communicate honestly and directly with clients and team; challenge established thinking; raise bold yet practical ideas with the team and business leaders and welcomes dissent.

  • Demonstrate self-awareness and proactively seek opportunities to improve self, the team and the Firm; is responsive to, and regularly offers, 360-degree coaching/feedback.

  • Understand how own and team's work relate to each other and to the broader business context before developing actionable recommendations; able to concurrently drill down to the details and draw salient, big-picture implications/insights.

  • Speak with confidence, clarity and impact; use a range of interaction styles to probe key issues and influence outcomes.

  • Act with empathy and compassion; regularly offer to step-in to help solve others' problems and spread workload; demonstrate high emotional intelligence allowing her/him to understand interpersonal dynamics and/or issues, offer the right solutions and build trust.

How You’ll Grow

We are committed to investing and supporting you in your professional development and we have developed a range of programs focused on fostering leadership, growth and development opportunities. We aim to promote continuous learning and individual skills development through on-the-job learning, self-guided professional development courses and certifications. You’ll be assigned a dedicated coach to mentor, guide and support you through regular coaching sessions and serve as an advocate for your professional growth.

What You Will Need to Succeed

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field

  • Minimum of 10+ years of experience

  • Ability to travel to FTI office(s) as needed

  • Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis; this position will not sponsor applicant for work visas.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree, e.g., MBA

  • CFA/CPA desirable

  • Experience in strategic planning, budgeting and forecasting

  • Strong quantitative, analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Strong Microsoft Office skills, especially Excel and PowerPoint

  • Proven ability to structure, analyze and develop options to address complex issues using a hypothesis driven approach

  • Excellent interpersonal skills, including flexibility to work/collaborate effectively with a range of personalities

  • Experience with analyzing financial statements, operations and management reporting processes and systems

  • Experience performing variance and trend financial analysis

  • Familiarity with reporting/analytical requirements for publicly traded companies

  • Familiarity with financial systems, e.g., TM1, Oracle, SAP, Hyperion, database or other query or reporting writing tools

  • Ability to effectively work in a team under tight deadlines to deliver quality output

  • Ability to prepare and deliver compelling and high-quality presentations for senior management/stakeholders

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple stakeholders with common and/or conflicting interests

  • Self-aware and proactively seeks out opportunities to address development areas; is open to and responsive to coaching/ feedback

  • Project planning and management

  • Executive-level communication and influence

  • Seeks out challenges; resilient

  • Detail oriented and dependable

  • High degree of ethical responsibility

  • Passion for driving lasting change

  • Strong leadership skills

title: Chief Baker
description:
About Four Seasons:

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

Four Seasons Resort and Residences Dominican Republic at Tropicalia will feature 95 keys and 25 branded residential homes, 8 distinct F&B outlets, all thoughtfully designed to reflect a contemporary interpretation of the Dominican Republic’s natural beauty. Wellness will be a defining pillar of the property, delivering a holistic experience that harmonizes with the natural environment while enhancing overall wellbeing through the restorative power of nature. The sustainable luxury destination is located on a 60-acre (24 hectare) site along the pristine beachfront of Playa Esmeralda in northeastern Dominican Republic, along the southern shores of Samaná Bay. A site of breathtaking natural beauty, Tropicalia is home to a diverse ecosystem of white-sand beaches; crystalline, aquamarine water and coral reefs; mountains, forests, mangroves, lagoons and rivers; a working coconut plantation; and an organic farm.

About the Role

Four Seasons Resort and Residences Dominican Republic at Tropicalia is seeking a Chief Baker to join our pre-opening team. Reporting to the Executive Pastry Chef, this position will lead the resort’s bakery operation, creating exceptional breads, viennoiserie and baked products while ensuring consistency, creativity and the highest standards of quality across all restaurants, banquets and culinary experiences.

What You Will Do

  • Lead and supervise the daily bakery operation, ensuring consistent production and timely delivery of all breads, rolls, viennoiserie and specialty baked products.
  • Participate in pre-opening activities, including bakery inspections, equipment testing and commissioning, recipe development, product tastings and establishment of operating procedures.
  • Develop and standardize a distinctive selection of artisan breads, sourdoughs, breakfast pastries, laminated doughs and regional specialties for the resort’s culinary concepts.
  • Partner with the Executive Pastry Chef and culinary leadership to create innovative bakery offerings that reflect the identity of each outlet and incorporate seasonal and local ingredients.
  • Recruit, onboard, train, schedule, coach and develop the Bakery team, fostering creativity, discipline, teamwork and the Golden Rule.
  • Maintain standardized recipes, preparation methods, production schedules, photographs, yield calculations and presentation guidelines.
  • Ensure the proper preparation, fermentation, proofing, baking, cooling, storage and presentation of all bakery products.
  • Monitor daily production levels according to occupancy, restaurant covers, banquet requirements and business forecasts to ensure availability while minimizing waste.
  • Maintain strict quality control over taste, texture, appearance, freshness, consistency and portioning.
  • Ensure full compliance with food-safety, sanitation, hygiene, allergen-management, occupational health and safety, and HACCP requirements.
  • Monitor food costs, ingredient usage, inventory levels, labor productivity and waste while maintaining exceptional product quality.
  • Work closely with Purchasing to evaluate flour, yeast, chocolate, dairy products and other specialty ingredients and establish clear product specifications.
  • Conduct regular inspections of bakery equipment, refrigeration and production areas and coordinate preventive maintenance and repairs with Engineering.
  • Support customized requests, dietary requirements, VIP amenities, banquets, celebrations and other special culinary experiences.

What You Bring

  • Culinary diploma, professional bakery qualification or equivalent specialized training in Baking and Pastry Arts.
  • A minimum of five years of progressive bakery experience within a luxury hotel, resort, artisan bakery or high-volume culinary operation, including previous supervisory responsibility.
  • Advanced technical knowledge of artisan bread production, natural fermentation, sourdough, laminated doughs, viennoiserie and international baking techniques.
  • Strong leadership, organization and production-planning skills, with creativity, precision and exceptional attention to detail.
  • Fluency in Spanish is required; working proficiency in English and previous luxury-hospitality or pre-opening experience are preferred.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package.
  • Excellent training and professional-development opportunities.
  • Opportunities for career growth within Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts.
  • Employee travel program, including complimentary and discounted stays at Four Seasons properties worldwide, subject to program eligibility.
  • Complimentary dry cleaning for employee uniforms.
  • Complimentary employee meals while on duty.
  • A supportive and inclusive work environment built on mutual respect, collaboration and the Golden Rule.

Schedule & Hours

  • This is a full-time position.
  • The successful candidate must be flexible to work early mornings, days, evenings, overnight shifts, weekends and public holidays based on production and operational needs.
  • As the resort operates 24 hours a day, seven days a week, scheduled days and hours may vary.

Work Authorization

Candidates must be legally eligible to work in the Dominican Republic or able to meet the applicable immigration and work-permit requirements.

Four Seasons Resort and Residences Dominican Republic at Tropicalia is committed to providing an inclusive workplace in which all individuals are treated with dignity and respect. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, experience and business requirements, without discrimination on any basis protected by applicable law.

title: Analyst | Competition Practice | Brussels
description:
Who We Are:

We are one of the world’s leading economic consulting firms. We strive to recruit and develop talented people to work together to produce meaningful economic analysis of exceptional quality, and to create a positive impact on our clients and society.

Our Competition Practice provides expert economic advice on competition policy, economic and financial regulation, public policy and the assessment of damages in complex disputes.

We are looking to hire junior economists to help us to provide advice to our clients on some of the most high-profile cases before the European Commission, the General Court and national competition authorities, regulators and courts.

We believe that working in diverse teams, where everybody’s views are considered and respected, helps us to deliver work of the highest standards of quality and integrity.

About the role:

We pride ourselves on providing Analysts with an opportunity to make a significant impact from day one. As an Analyst you will become an integral part of the team with the crucial role of helping clients understand how competition works in their industry. You will contribute to cases in a variety of ways, working closely with senior staff to understand the issues that face the client, relating those issues to relevant economic theory, and supporting the analysis with solid and persuasive empirical evidence. You are also guaranteed to be closely supervised by senior staff, both within the scope of projects and via our internal mentoring programme.

Analysts typically join us after completing their Master’s degree in economics.

Applications for this position close on 29th January 2027.

Key responsibilities:

  • Analysing qualitative and quantitative client data to better understand how competition works in their industry

  • Reviewing literature and contributing to discussions about the theoretical and empirical approach

  • Conducting empirical analysis using Excel and Stata

  • Drafting reports summarising analysis

  • Participating in client meetings and conference calls

Skills/profile sought:

  • Master’s degree in economics, ideally with focus on microeconomics, industrial organisation and/or econometrics

  • Highly analytical

  • Excellent organisational skills with an ability to multi-task

  • Ability to communicate effectively with colleagues and clients

  • Accuracy and attention to detail

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team

  • Basic Stata and Excel skills

  • Fluency in written and spoken English

Benefits of working at Compass Lexecon:

  • Competitive salary and benefits

  • A wide variety of interesting and challenging projects

  • An international team with a broad range of backgrounds and experience

  • A blend of professional and academic environments

  • The opportunity to work with top law firms, corporations, government bodies and academics

  • A steep learning curve, coupled with a supportive and collaborative team

  • Opportunities for training such as secondments, office rotations, internal seminars, and conferences

  • The opportunity to take on a lot of responsibility and contribute from day one

When drafting your application:

We ask all applicants to provide their most up to date CV, cover letter and transcripts.

We acknowledge that AI is now commonly used for drafting, however we emphasize the importance of personalization to truly reflect your unique experiences. We are able to recognise applications that are solely created using AI and those that demonstrate individuality.

What happens next?

Once your application has been submitted, you will receive an email confirmation outlining next steps.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. We encourage interested candidates to apply as soon as possible.

What does our interview process look like?

Our interview process for Analysts involves two stages. The first stage is one 60-minute interview with both motivational and technical questions. The second stage includes a written case study and a technical interview. All interviews are currently being conducted virtually.

Compass Lexecon is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We appreciate that recruitment agencies may have speculative CVs that they wish to submit to Compass Lexecon. To avoid any ambiguity around fees, please note that speculative CVs received by Compass Lexecon, that have not been authorised in advance by the Recruitment team, will be ineligible for an agency fee.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analysing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Operator- Cut to Length Line (CTL)
description:
To ensure that product processed on the Cut to Length Line (CTL) has been performed in a safe, efficient and quality manner. This position has the overall responsibility of the CTL and how it operates /runs, but primarily, or specifically, the function of the leveler, product covering, shear operations and the respective paperwork involved with processing product. This position either assists, or provides the guidance and direction for all the other functions of the line, coil transfer, un-coiler, stacker and packaging areas.

Schedule: 1st Shift! Monday - Friday 6:00am - 2:30pm with possible OT (on Saturdays)

At Samuel, we believe every team member brings unique and valuable skills, experiences and knowledge to our thriving business – enabling us to build on over 167 years of success in the metals industry.

Here are some of the great benefits that we offer:

· Competitive wages

· Company paid health and dental benefits

· Paid vacation

· Defined 401(k) Plan with company match

· Opportunity for career stability and growth

· Tuition reimbursement program

Summary & Scope

To ensure that product processed on the Cut to Length Line (CTL) has been performed in a safe, efficient and quality manner. This position has the overall responsibility of the CTL and how it operates /runs, but primarily, or specifically, the function of the leveler, product covering, shear operations and the respective paperwork involved with processing product. This position either assists, or provides the guidance and direction for all the other functions of the line, coil transfer, un-coiler, stacker and packaging areas.

Responsibilities:

  • Review material processing paperwork and oversee the retrieval and staging of material to be ran on the CTL; this same paperwork will also generate the required PVC / covering and pallets (paperwork system based on AS400)
  • Starting with coils, ensure their staging is in order, coils are transferred to the scale for weight/ thickness confirmation, loaded on the transfer cart and then mounted onto the un-coiler mandrel (to this point a separate control stand is used for the coil mounting)
  • Coordinate material feed into the leveler for flattening, then the PVC or paper interleaf (as required) are started and the material is fed into the shear. (all of these functions through the shear and then the exit conveyors to the stacker are all controlled with a second, main, control panel)
  • Based on the material order paperwork, process material through the leveler and shear constantly observing for any irregularities, both functional and from a quality perspective.
  • On a coil by coil basis, the CTL machine operator will measure length and squareness of product as dictated by either customer requirements and or standards (the thickness of the material, at this point, has already been measured, confirmed and recorded via the coil mounting process)
  • As part of the material processing, the leading edge of the coil and again with the trailing edge will be evaluated for flatness and processed accordingly for scrap as will other issues encountered as the material is being processed
  • Oversee the pallet build list and that the proper pallets are either staged and or built (as required) to enable the material to be palletized based on customer orders (Currently several customers have special requirements for their material and those requirements must be reviewed and adhered to with no deviation unless approved prior to processing)
  • Once the material has been processed and palletized, the CTL machine operator is responsible to adhere the appropriate labels on the pallets as generated by the paperwork from the AS400 and update the material / order information in AS400
  • Based on needs of the business, will be requested to work in other areas of the facility to support customer demand issues
  • Any and all non-conformances with material / packaging items, or abnormalities with equipment function(s) are to be reported immediately to Supervision
  • Ensure a safe, clean working environment
  • Support other operator(s) with general duties associated with the line / equipment
  • Maintain a good work atmosphere
  • Adhere to all health and safety rules / regulations

Role Requirements:

  • Basic, general understanding of company and customer specific requirements for material quality and ISO certification. Must be proficient in the use of tape measures and taper / feeler gauges.
  • Minimum of 2 years’ experience running a cut to length line.
  • High School education and or equivalent (GED).
  • 2-5 years’ experience in a manufacturing environment (minimum of 2 years required)

Equipment Knowledge:

  • Forklift certification, utility knife, strapping tool, hand shear, nailer, hammer, circular saw, saws-all, miter / chop saw
  • Experience with one of the following machine configurations: Andritz, HerrVoss, Redbud, Rowe, Stamco, and or Vigano

Physical Demands:

Standing for long periods of time.

  • Bending, stooping, and pushing
  • Ability to lift 50 lbs (22.7kg) maximum occasionally with frequent lifting and/or carrying of objects weighing up to 25 lbs (11.3kg).

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Work Environment:

  • Varies including indoor and outdoor settings such as warehouses, storage yards, or production areas

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job.

title: QA QC Inspector
description:
To perform Quality Assurance and Quality Control activities at various stages of service realization in accordance with API Q1, API Q2, international standards, regulatory requirements, customer expectations, and internal procedures, ensuring all products and services meet the highest quality standards before delivery to the end user.

  • Ensure inspection and verification activities align with API Q2 requirements for Risk Assessment, Service Quality Plans (SQP) and Contingency Planning.
  • Perform in-process and final inspections as per drawings, work orders, route cards, specifications and OEM requirements.
  • Conduct and maintain accurate calibration and verification records for measuring and test equipment in compliance with API Q1 and API standards.
  • Support API Q1 requirements related to product realization planning, risk assessment, management of change (MOC) and control of production processes.
  • Identify, monitor and document critical-to-quality (CTQ) characteristics as required by API Q1 and API Q2.
  • Support the development and implementation of Service Quality Plans (SQPs), ensuring inspection checkpoints, acceptance criteria and objective evidence are documented.
  • Ensure all temporary and permanent changes are processed in accordance with API Q1 and API Q2 change management requirements.
  • Ensure compliance with competency, procedure adherence, equipment qualification and other controls defined under API Q1 and Q2.
  • Inspect purchased items, repaired tools and outsourced processed materials.
  • Maintain product identification, traceability and inspection status throughout all stages of operations.
  • Report nonconformities promptly to the QA/QC Supervisor or Manager and support Corrective Action (CA) per API Q1/Q2 processes.
  • Ensure preventive maintenance and calibration activities for critical equipment comply with API Q1 and API Q2 documentation and control requirements.
  • Participate in internal audits covering API Q1 and API Q2 elements and support timely closure of audit findings.
  • Verify all process documents—Call Out (Customer PO), Work Instructions, NDT Inspection reports, Service / test reports, Work Orders, Dimensional Inspection Reports, Drawings, Route Cards and Certificates of Conformity (COC) prior to product release.
  • Ensure documented information and records meet API Q1 and Q2 requirements for accuracy, completeness, retention, and control.
  • Authorized to stop unsafe, non-compliant, or high-risk operations.
  • Communicate product, process, or service risks to the QA/QC Supervisor as part of API Q1 and Q2 risk communication processes.
  • Perform any additional tasks assigned, provided they are reasonable and aligned with competency.
  • The employee is responsible for performing duties in accordance with the company’s policies, procedures, and quality objectives
  • The employee has the necessary authority to make decisions within their scope of work and escalate issues as needed and collaborate with relevant stakeholders to ensure operational effectiveness.
  • The employee is accountable for the quality, accuracy, and timeliness of their work, as well as for reporting any nonconformities or risks that may impact quality, legal compliances, safety, environment, or customer satisfaction.
  • Support and participate in achieving organizational QHSE objectives.

  • Reporting hazards in plant, equipment and other work place, or short comings in the existing controls, to a superior without delay.
  • Attending Toolbox Talks, HSEQ meetings and trainings as and when required.

HSEQ Authority:

  • To report any unsafe behaviors to their immediate Supervisor or Safety representative. Where there may be conflict report directly to facility HSEQ Manager.
  • Authority on HSEQ grounds to stop operations or delivery of product on the existence of an immediate risk of harm to personnel or environmental pollution and damage to property.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in a QA/QC role.
  • Hands-on experience with Inspection, Testing, Measuring, Monitoring & Detection Equipment (TMMDE).
  • Experience in calibration of TMMDE in accordance with API and applicable international standards.
  • Knowledge of quality inspection procedures, measurement techniques, and documentation
  • Effective communication skills; fluent in English reading and speaking.

Mounter and Print Support Operative - About the role:

We are offering an exciting opportunity for a Mounter and Print Support Operative to join our team.

As a Mounter, you will be mounting print plates in preparation for print press operations, ensuring there is no waiting time and that you are always ahead of production demand. You will assist with any plate/registration issues which may occur and be mindful that, together with health and safety, production running time is a critical success factor for the site.

Mounter and Print Support Operative – Responsibilities:

Your key duties will include:

  • Operate in line with site health and safety, environmental and quality standards including BRC, ISO & A2 environmental.
  • Organise your workload in line with the daily print programme, ensuring work is delivered against targets and customer requirements.
  • Locate and Inspect Plates
  • Apply and Strip backing tape to sleeves using Applicator/Demounter
  • Mount printing plates onto the appropriate sleeves, ensuring compliance with the dimensions agreed with the customer, as required
  • Demount Plates
  • Operate Plate Cleaner and ensure plates are cleaned prior to filing, completing and signing the relevant control
  • Operate Parts washer
  • Store and identify printing plates for subsequent use as required.
  • Ensure that all established quality standards are met.
  • Assist with production operations as and when required including the maintenance and upkeep of relevant equipment.
  • Ensure that mounting is organised in line with the production schedule and no more than 48 hours in advance, as the plan is flexible and subject to change.
  • Review stock of Tape, Plate Wash & Anilox cleaner and order as required.
  • Check Orders, plates, process control, paperwork and any required GMG in advance of the plan, to enable production operate effectively. Ensure the Shift Manager is notified immediately of anything missing.

What we need from you:

  • Previous experience in a print manufacturing environment beneficial
  • Previous experience in production environment essential
  • Exposure to quality, health, safety and environmental standards and practices within a production setting
  • Fluent English – ability to communicate effectively with colleagues and understand both written and verbal work instructions

A reasonable level of fitness is required as the role involves some physical activity e.g. lifting & bending.

title: Technical Domain Expert
description:
Weatherford is seeking an experienced and technically credible Domain Expert to act as the subject matter authority for our digital product portfolio across Malaysia and the wider Asia Geozone. This role blends deep oil and gas domain knowledge—production optimization, artificial lift, well and reservoir surveillance, asset integrity and operations— with a practical understanding of digital technologies such as data platforms, analytics, automation, IoT/IIoT, cloud and edge solutions. You will be the trusted technical voice with customers—translating operational challenges into digital solutions, validating technical fit during the sales cycle, and supporting successful deployment and adoption. You will work closely with technical sales, product line management, engineering, and delivery teams to ensure our solutions deliver measurable value to national oil companies, international operators and independents in the region.

  • Act as the recognized domain authority for the digital portfolio in Malaysia, providing expert guidance to customers, technical sales and operations teams.
  • Engage directly with client technical teams to understand production, surveillance, artificial lift and asset integrity challenges, and translate them into digital solution requirements.
  • Lead discovery workshops, value assessments, and proof-of-concept studies with customers, quantifying the operational and financial benefits of proposed solutions.
  • Support the technical sales team throughout the sales cycle with solution design, technical validation, demonstrations, and responses to technical sections of tenders and prequalification submissions.
  • Provide technical oversight during implementation and commissioning, working with delivery teams to ensure solutions are configured correctly and deliver the intended outcomes.
  • Drive customer adoption post-deployment through training, workflow embedding, performance reviews and continuous improvement recommendations.
  • Captured field insight, customer feedback, and competitor intelligence, and feed it back to product management and engineering to influence the product roadmap.
  • Build the technical capability of local teams through coaching, knowledge transfer and the development of reference material and case studies.
  • Bachelor’s degree in petroleum engineering, Production Engineering, Reservoir Engineering or a related technical field.
  • 8+ years of oil and gas experience, with demonstrable depth in one or more domains such as production optimization, artificial lift, well and reservoir surveillance, integrated asset modelling or asset integrity.
  • At least 3 years applying digital or data-driven solutions in an operational setting, such as digital oilfield implementations, real-time monitoring, or production analytics.
  • Working knowledge of digital tools including cloud platforms (Azure, AWS), data management and historian systems, predictive analytics, and industrial automation.
  • Proven experience engaging client technical and operations teams as a subject matter expert, including workshop facilitation and technical presentations.
  • Experience working with operators in Asia and familiarity with local operating conditions and regulatory requirements.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills; professional fluency in English.
  • In line with our commitment to localization, Malaysian nationals are strongly preferred.
  • Domestic and regional travel across Asia up to 40%, including visits to onshore and offshore client sites.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with digital twins, edge computing or AI/ML applications in oil and gas.
  • Familiarity with common industry platforms (e.g. OSIsoft PI, CygNet, Ignition, AVEVA, AspenTech) and artificial lift or nodal analysis modelling tools.
  • Exposure to NOC technical evaluation and prequalification processes in the region (e.g. Pertamina, PETRONAS, PTTEP, PetroVietnam).
  • Track record of publishing technical papers or presenting at industry forums such as SPE or IPA.
  • Consultative, customer-centric mindset with strong problem-solving ability.
  • Comfortable operating in a multicultural, matrixed regional environment.
