title: Executive Director, Oncology DD & Commercialization Communications
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.



Role

The Executive Director, Oncology Drug Development & Commercialization Communications in Corporate Affairs, is responsible for the overall strategy, execution, and measurement of product, pipeline, and therapeutic area communications across BMS's oncology portfolio — spanning both Drug Development and Commercialization. This includes marketed brands, late-stage pipeline assets, new indications, and therapeutic areas including solid tumors, hematologic malignancies, and cell therapy modalities.

Leading a team of communications professionals, the Executive Director will serve as the primary Corporate Affairs advisor to senior leaders across both the Global Drug Development and Oncology Commercialization organizations, as well as their associated leadership teams. This role will partner closely with commercial, medical, regulatory, legal, and development functions, and operate within and across the Corporate Affairs matrix to drive integrated internal and external communications at every stage of the product lifecycle.

The Executive Director will also lead internal communications to engage and inspire employees across oncology and will develop thought leadership programs for senior executives in both the development and commercialization organizations. This leader will guide above-brand oncology communications strategy, reputational issues management, and risk mitigation globally and in the U.S., with the overarching goal of elevating BMS's position as a leader in oncology and cancer care.

What We're Looking For

This individual is a leader with a competitive orientation and an exceptionally high level of competence and comfort interacting with, gaining trust from, and persuading key stakeholders at various levels within the organiztion. This leader is prepared to leverage those skills to advocate on behalf of BMS and position the company at the forefront of oncology innovation.

A strategic thinker with a strong grasp of brand value and stakeholder mobilization, this leader brings deep expertise in corporate and healthcare policy, as well as the complex regulatory environment in the U.S. and other key markets. The ED will be an effective manager of direct and matrix teams, will collaborate closely with international communicators to support global milestone execution, and will have experience implementing large-scale stakeholder initiatives with both internal partners and outside resources. Above all, this is a passionate practitioner with the drive to win on behalf of BMS, the team, and the patients BMS serves.

This leader is expected to manage a team of direct reports while embodying and advancing the company's People Strategy.

The position is based in Princeton, NJ, with time also spent in Lawrenceville, NJ.

Responsibilities

Integrated Communications Strategy

  • Lead global internal and external communications strategy and execution across BMS’s oncology portfolio, spanning marketed brands, new indications, late-stage assets, business development activity, and key therapeutic areas.
  • Create above-brand campaigns and messaging that strengthen understanding of unmet patient needs and confidence in BMS’s oncology strategy and pipeline.

Thought Leadership & Executive Visibility

  • Strengthen BMS’s oncology reputation through integrated thought leadership, media, speaking, social, and digital programs.
  • Develop measurable visibility plans for senior Drug Development and Commercialization leaders, aligned with Corporate Affairs priorities.
  • Partner across commercial, medical, and development teams to advance a consistent BMS oncology narrative across audiences and channels.

Milestone & Pipeline Communications

  • Lead communications for data, regulatory, and medical meeting milestones across the oncology portfolio, including media, digital, employee, and market activation.
  • Advise senior Drug Development and Commercialization leaders and represent Corporate Affairs on relevant leadership teams.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Represent Corporate Affairs in cross-functional and worldwide brand forums, shaping scenarios, messages, stakeholder engagement, and brand initiatives.
  • Build integrated brand communications strategies with Corporate Communications, R&D Communications, Patient Advocacy, Access, Pricing and Policy, GPS Communications, and other partners.
  • Provide communications counsel on manufacturing matters and identify proof points that reinforce confidence in BMS’s capabilities.

Issues Management & Reputation

  • Lead global oncology issues management, aligning portfolio-, brand-, and event-specific messaging across U.S. and international markets to mitigate risk and protect BMS’s reputation.

Digital, Social & Editorial

  • Lead the oncology editorial, social, and digital plan in support of business priorities and enterprise channel strategy.
  • Build awareness of BMS oncology therapies through milestone communications, educational content, branded PR, campaigns, earned media, and appropriate patient, HCP, and advocacy voices.

Global Markets

  • Align global and market communications, providing plans and content early enough for effective local adaptation and execution.

People & Operations

  • Lead, coach, and develop the oncology communications team; clarify priorities, strengthen capabilities, and optimize resources and service models.
  • Manage budgets, contracts, and agency partners to deliver strong performance and financial stewardship.
  • Establish measurement practices to optimize performance and demonstrate impact against objectives.

Requirements

The successful candidate has 15+ years of experience in brand or corporate communications in the pharmaceutical industry, with a demonstrated track record of setting and delivering against integrated global communications strategies. This leader will bring expertise in strategic planning, issues management, internal communications, executive and thought leadership communications, social and digital media, and product communications across the product lifecycle — ideally spanning both development and commercial contexts.

  • Bachelor's degree required, ideally in communications or a related field; Master's degree preferred.
  • Accomplished communications professional with experience in pharmaceutical brand or corporate communications, public relations, or a related field. Pharmaceutical or healthcare experience required; oncology, hematology, cell therapy, or autoimmune experience preferred.
  • Proven ability to drive successful brand and therapeutic area communications strategy in close coordination with commercial and development business partners.
  • Exceptional collaboration skills with the ability to partner effectively within Corporate Affairs and across the business to drive and scale communications strategies worldwide and in the U.S.
  • Demonstrated ability to advise and influence senior leadership in communications and business settings, with strong science acumen and a solid understanding of regulatory policy, R&D, pricing, and access.
  • Strong problem-solving, management, and leadership skills, including direct experience leading teams of communications professionals.
  • Superior written and interpersonal communication skills, with strong presentation and facilitation skills and the ability to engage and persuade a wide range of audiences.
  • Ability to quickly internalize a complex business and operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Deep knowledge of stakeholder engagement, content creation, channel strategy, and digital and social media best practices, including how to optimize content delivery across channels and audiences.

We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway.

title: Growth Associate, Google Implementation Programme (India)
description:
About Datahash

Datahash is a privacy-centric first-party data platform. Our core product, Datahash Signals, gives marketers low-code, no-code integrations between web, app, e-commerce, CRM, marketing automation and data warehouses on one side and the major ad channels on the other: Meta, Google, TikTok, Snap, Amazon and more. We are one of a handful of badged integration partners across these channels and work with them directly on first-party data adoption programmes, where advertisers are moving to server-side integrations, conversions APIs and privacy-safe measurement. We are bootstrapped, profitable, and run across Dubai, Bangalore, Mumbai and London with clients in EMEA, India, Africa, APAC and the US.

The role

Datahash is one of a handful of global Google integration partners. Google's teams nominate advertisers to us to implement Google Tag Gateway, Enhanced Conversions and related first-party data products, and our job is to convert each nomination into a verified, live implementation. You own the India patch of that funnel: first meetings, follow-ups, approvals, implementation kick-offs and verification, working 120 to 140 live deals at a time with a desk agent that never lets a deal age silently. This is conversion at volume with technical substance, not cold outreach.

What you will do

  1. Convert nominations. Run 30 to 35 first meetings a month from Google nominations, explain the implementation and its value, and secure the client's go-ahead and access.
  2. Drive to verified. Carry each deal from approval through implementation with our delivery team to Google's verification, 12 to 15 verified completions a month.
  3. Hold the cadence. Follow-ups, reschedules and approvals on the deadline doctrine (approval inside 30 days of a call, implementation inside four weeks), with the desk agent drafting and you deciding.
  4. Work with Google. Keep Google's regional teams informed on progress and quality; escalate stuck nominations the right way.
  5. Attach. Spot where an implementation should become a services engagement or a Signals subscription and hand the lead to the right seat.

What success looks like

title: Senior Technical Project Manager
description:
# Technical Project Manager

**Resolve Tech Solutions**

## Position Overview

Resolve Tech Solutions is seeking an experienced **Technical Project Manager (TPM)** to lead the planning and delivery of complex technology initiatives across client and internal teams. This role sits at the intersection of **technology, business, and project execution**, requiring someone who can translate business objectives into actionable technical plans while keeping teams aligned, risks managed, and projects on track.

The ideal candidate is a strong project leader who is comfortable working directly with engineers, architects, product teams, business stakeholders, vendors, and executive leadership. They do not need to be a hands-on developer, but they should have the technical fluency to understand system dependencies, integrations, data flows, environments, and implementation challenges.

## Key Responsibilities

* Lead technology projects from initiation and requirements gathering through implementation, deployment, and post-launch support.
* Develop and maintain project plans, milestones, timelines, resource requirements, dependencies, and delivery roadmaps.
* Partner with engineering, architecture, product, QA, infrastructure, security, and business teams to coordinate project execution.
* Translate business requirements and objectives into clear technical requirements, deliverables, and workstreams.
* Facilitate technical discussions and ensure decisions, dependencies, assumptions, and action items are documented and communicated.
* Proactively identify project risks, technical blockers, scope changes, and resource constraints and drive them toward resolution.
* Manage project scope, schedules, budgets, priorities, and stakeholder expectations.
* Track project health using measurable KPIs and provide clear status reporting to leadership and client stakeholders.
* Lead Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, stand-ups, backlog refinement, retrospectives, and release planning when applicable.
* Coordinate testing, deployment readiness, production releases, and implementation activities across technical teams.
* Manage third-party vendors and technology partners when required.
* Establish strong project governance, documentation standards, escalation processes, and communication rhythms.
* Drive accountability across cross-functional teams while maintaining positive and productive working relationships.
* Support continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to improve project delivery processes, tools, and methodologies.

## Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* **5+ years of project or program management experience**, including experience leading technology-focused initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex, cross-functional projects with multiple stakeholders and technical dependencies.
* Strong understanding of the **software development lifecycle (SDLC)** and Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both highly technical teams and non-technical business stakeholders.
* Experience managing project schedules, scope, risks, issues, dependencies, resources, and executive-level reporting.
* Strong organizational, analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Experience with project management and collaboration tools such as **Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, Azure DevOps, Smartsheet, or similar platforms**.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects in a fast-paced, client-focused environment.

## Preferred Qualifications

* PMP, CSM, PMI-ACP, SAFe, or similar project/program management certification.
* Experience working within a technology consulting, professional services, or managed services environment.
* Familiarity with **cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud**.
* Experience managing application development, cloud migration, systems integration, infrastructure, data, cybersecurity, or enterprise technology projects.
* Understanding of APIs, system integrations, databases, cloud architecture, DevOps, CI/CD, and release management concepts.
* Experience working with distributed, offshore, or globally dispersed technical teams.
* Experience managing client-facing implementations and executive stakeholders.

## What Success Looks Like

A successful Technical Project Manager at Resolve Tech Solutions brings structure to complex technical initiatives without creating unnecessary process. You can quickly understand what a technical team is trying to accomplish, identify what could prevent successful delivery, and ensure the right people are aligned to solve problems.

You are comfortable asking technical questions, challenging assumptions, managing difficult conversations, and communicating project realities clearly. Most importantly, you take ownership of delivery and consistently move projects from **planning to execution to successful implementation**.

## Core Competencies

**Technical Fluency | Project Leadership | Agile Delivery | Stakeholder Management | Risk Management | Client Management | Cross-Functional Leadership | SDLC | Executive Communication | Problem Solving | Project Governance | Continuous Improvement**

## About Resolve Tech Solutions

Resolve Tech Solutions helps organizations solve complex technology challenges through strategic consulting, technical expertise, and results-focused execution. Our teams partner with clients to translate business needs into practical technology solutions and deliver initiatives that create measurable value.

title: Data Scientist, Ricochet Anti-Cheat (Call of Duty)
description:
Job Title:

Data Scientist, Ricochet Anti-Cheat (Call of Duty)

Requisition ID:

R028031

Job Description:

Your Mission

Call of Duty is one of the most iconic and successful video game franchises in the world, delivering unforgettable experiences to millions of players every day. At the heart of that experience is fair play, and that is where the Ricochet Anti-Cheat team comes in.

Our mission is to protect the integrity of the online experience, ensuring every player enjoys a level playing field. As a Data Scientist on Ricochet, you will analyze, investigate, and translate complex data into insights that help detect, prevent, and respond to cheating across Call of Duty live titles.

The Role

We are seeking a Data Scientist to help secure the Call of Duty franchise by producing structured insights, experiments, and analyses that improve Ricochet anti-cheat outcomes at scale.

In this role, you will partner with anti-cheat engineers, analysts, operations specialists, game designers, and producers to answer ambiguous questions, evaluate detections, measure model impact, and identify new opportunities for anti-cheat initiatives. You will support the broader Ricochet organization through consultation, data analysis, data engineering, experimentation, dashboards, and executive-level reporting.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong statistical and data science fundamentals with curiosity about adversarial player behavior, a passion for competitive integrity, and the communication skills to make complex findings actionable for technical and non-technical partners.

What you bring to the table

  • Analyze gameplay telemetry, enforcement data, behavioral signals, and other large-scale datasets to investigate cheating patterns and anti-cheat outcomes.
  • Collaborate on the ETL, data analysis, and measurement strategy for machine-learning projects that enhance detection, prevention, and response to cheating.
  • Design and execute experiments and analyses that measure the impact of models, detections, interventions, and enforcement workflows on players and the business.
  • Answer ambiguous questions with practical, evidence-based recommendations that help Ricochet prioritize anti-cheat initiatives.
  • Produce dashboards, recurring reports, and executive-level summaries that clearly communicate results, trends, impediments, and impact.
  • Partner with game designers, engineers, producers, analysts, and operations teams to identify new opportunities for anti-cheat improvements.
  • Support validation of new anti-cheat detections and model changes before broader deployment, with attention to effectiveness and false-positive risk.
  • Help improve the quality, consistency, and transparency of anti-cheat data pipelines, metrics, analysis standards, and reporting practices.
  • Stay current on advances in anti-cheat technology, statistical analysis, experimentation, data science, and adversarial behavior analysis.
  • Learn from senior team members, share knowledge with peers, and contribute to a culture of fairness, accountability, and continuous improvement in game security.

Player Profile

Minimum requirements:

Experience

  • 3+ years of experience using data science to solve real-world problems with measurable impact on users and the business.
  • Experience working with large data volumes for production, analytics, experimentation, or reporting purposes.
  • Working knowledge of experimentation methods, impact measurement, statistical analysis, and metrics development.
  • Experience building or maintaining dashboards, reports, and repeatable analytical workflows for stakeholders.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Master's degree or equivalent work experience in Data Science, Computer Science, Data Analysis, Statistics, or a related field.
  • Competence with Python, SQL, and PySpark for data analysis, data engineering, and production-scale workflows.
  • Strong understanding of data analysis, statistics, experimentation, measurement design, and practical model evaluation.
  • Familiarity with large data lake or warehouse environments such as Databricks, Snowflake, or similar platforms.
  • Ability to synthesize multiple data sources into clear conclusions, recommendations, and decision-ready narratives.
  • Practical understanding of data quality, ETL, schema evolution, and analytical reproducibility in large-scale environments.
  • Ability to prioritize effectively across investigations, analyses, stakeholder requests, and long-term data science initiatives.

Key Attributes

  • Ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including concise documentation and executive-ready reporting.
  • Strong analytical judgment, attention to detail, and ability to work through ambiguous problems with incomplete or noisy data.
  • Ability to learn from senior team members and contribute to the growth and success of others on the team.
  • Passion for multiplayer gaming and preserving competitive integrity.

Extra Points

Minimum requirements:

Experience

  • Experience developing agentic orchestration workflows that result in production outcomes.
  • Experience with machine-learning-assisted detection systems, model monitoring, or adversarial behavior analysis.

title: Supply Technician Lead (AY1) Fort Bliss, TX
description:
Technica LLC seeks to fill the position of Supply Technician Lead (AY1) on a government contract with a place of performance at Ft. Bliss, TX.

Position Responsibilities:

  • This position performs all aspects of technical management work (e.g., inventory management, storage management, shelf-life management, COSIS, remediation packaging, cataloging, property utilization) related to depot, local, or other supply activities.
  • The Lead is the key assistant to the Supervisor with delegated lead person authority to control and oversee employees in the assigning, monitoring, and performance of the daily tasks assigned.
  • The work involves the oversight of various sections within the warehouse while resolving customer issues or supply actions.
  • The Lead acts as the communication bridge between team members and management.
  • This work may require consideration of program requirements, together with specific variations in or from standardized guidelines.
  • Candidate is required to enforce and comply with all SOPs and GCSS-Army system policies, adhere to all Safety policies.
  • Ensure compliance with environmental Laws/Regulations, Army Regulations/Policies and Global Combat Support System - GCSS-Army Regulations/Policies, as it relates to depot, local, or other supply activities.
  • Responsible for daily stock control functions and maintaining communication with all direct and indirect customers, Unit level SSAs and higher, print MROs, process PQDRs and walk ups.
  • Establish work priorities, monthly reconciliations, maintain accountability for sensitive items. Candidate will be responsible for monitoring personnel, all transactions using GCSS-Army, maintaining warehouse filing system and key control.
  • Monitor the Warehouse Monitor to minimize daily system backlog.
  • The ideal candidate must be extremely Leader oriented, customer focused and capable of short-range planning, analysis, and have the following additional requirements traits:
  • A good working knowledge of document flow as it relates to GCSS-Army, Logistic Information System -LIS supply systems, programs, policies, nomenclature, work methods, manuals, or other established guidelines and the Army supply system.
  • An understanding of the needs of the organizations serviced and the overall mission concerns of those units.
  • Candidate must be able to conduct research documents, familiar with all applications within the Logistics Information Warehouse. Must have several years' experience in and with military supply and logistics systems at the Brigade or above levels.
  • Provide customer assistance, when necessary, by resolving their problems or directing them to the proper personnel (i.e. Execution mangers from depots, DLA/GSA) to get correct problem resolution.
  • Complies individual reports of current and projected work order status, section productivity/performance (weekly. Monthly).
  • Processes Supply Discrepancy Reports (SDRs), Product Quality Deficiency Reports (PQDRs) and track such materials until resolved.
  • Monitors each work order for prompt status changes. Informs Supervisor of any delays or unusual circumstances of work order requests.
  • Direct workload assignment based on Supervisor and Assistant Supervisor guidance IAW established guidelines, priorities, governing rules, regulations, and policies.
  • Operates materiel handling equipment (MHE) as required.
  • Maintain workstation and department area in a highly professional manner and appearance
  • Must be able to obtain a license to operate Material Handling Equipment (MHE) such as a forklift, etc.
  • Performs other duties and additional duties assigned.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent 18 years of age
  • Valid state driver's license
  • Must pass pre-employment drug screen and criminal background check
  • Must be a US Citizen or US permanent resident for more than 3 years in order to obtain NACI and CAC Card eligibility.
  • Must have a minimum of 5 yrs of related leadership and team building experience at Technician/NCO level or higher
  • Must have a minimum of 5 yrs of GCSS-Army (plant 2001 warehouse management) experience

Desired Qualifications:

  • Analytical ability to define or recognize the dimension of the problems involved, to quickly research and collect the necessary applicable data, to establish the applicable facts, and to take or recommend action based upon proven applications or interpretation of systematic established guidelines.
  • Demonstrated knowledge to operate and perform required duties using Logistics Information System (LIS), Cargo Movement Operation System (CMOS) and normally approved office computer automation equipment. Ability to produce reports using Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word. Experience maintaining files with Army Record Information System (ARIMS).
  • An associate or higher degree in business, management, logistics or the equivalent military service schools graduations to verify the abilities and competence required to perform in a wide scope of supply related task
  • Former US Army MOS 92A or 920B preferred.
  • Must be able to stand or sit for prolonged periods of time.
  • Must be able to read, write, and speak English.
  • Must be computer literate. Be able to type and use Microsoft Office.
  • Must have a good working knowledge of the governing supply systems, programs, policies, nomenclature, work methods, manuals, or other established guidelines.
  • Must be able to lead a team working in areas that include hot, dusty, windy areas for prolong time periods.
  • Be able to lift at least 49 lbs.
  • Be capable of using and understanding Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)

  • Must be able to pass pre-employment drug screening and background checks related to the position.

description:

The Machine Operator will ensure that product processed on sheet shear, bar saw and sheet polish line has been performed in a safe, efficient and quality manner. This position has the overall responsibility on how the machines operate /runs, but primarily, or specifically, the function of the machines and making sure they operate properly. The respective paperwork involved with processing product must be checked and verified before running product on the machines. This position either assists or provides the guidance and direction for all the other functions on the line that they are running/operating. The operator must coordinate and delegate task for helpers on their line.

Responsibilities:

• Review material processing paperwork and oversee the retrieval and staging of material to be ran on the Sheet, Band Saw and the SPL; this same paperwork will also generate the required PVC / covering and pallets (paperwork system based on AS400)
• Coordinate material feed into the leveler for flattening, then the PVC or paper interleaf (as required) are started, and the material is fed into the shear. (all of these functions through the shear and then the exit conveyors to the stacker are all controlled with a second, main, control panel)
• Based on the material order paperwork, process material through the leveler and shear constantly observing for any irregularities, both functional and from a quality perspective.
• Oversee the pallet build list and that the proper pallets are either staged and or built (as required) to enable the material to be palletized based on customer orders (Currently several customers have special requirements for their material and those requirements must be reviewed and adhered to with no deviation unless approved prior to processing)
• Once the material has been processed and palletized, the machine operator is responsible to adhere the appropriate labels on the pallets as generated by the paperwork from the AS400 and update the material / order information in AS400
• Based on needs of the business, will be requested to work in other areas of the facility to support customer demand issues
• Any and all non-conformances with material / packaging items, or abnormalities with equipment function(s) are to be reported immediately to Supervision
• Ensure a safe, clean working environment
• Support other operator(s) with general duties associated with the line / equipment
• Maintain a good work atmosphere
• Adhere to all health and safety rules / regulations
• Related duties as assigned.

Role Requirements:

  • Basic, general understanding of company and customer specific requirements for material quality and ISO certification. Must be proficient in the use of tape measures and taper / feeler gauges.
  • Minimum of 2 years’ experience running a cut to length line.
  • High School education and or equivalent (GED).
  • 2-5 years’ experience in a manufacturing environment (minimum of 2 years required)

Equipment Knowledge:

  • Forklift certification, utility knife, strapping tool, hand shear, nailer, hammer, circular saw, saws-all, miter / chop saw
  • Saw/Shear experience

Physical Demands:

Standing for long periods of time.

  • Bending, stooping, and pushing
  • Ability to lift 50 lbs (22.7kg) maximum occasionally with frequent lifting and/or carrying of objects weighing up to 25 lbs (11.3kg).

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Work Environment:

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job.

title: Studentermedhjælper til kommunikationsafdelingen på Statens Institut for Folkesundhed
description:
Studentermedhjælper til kommunikationsafdelingen på Statens Institut for Folkesundhed.

Har du flair og interesse for hjemmesideredigering, layout, billedbehandling og formidling? Er du fleksibel, ansvarsfuld og serviceminded? Og har du mod på en travl arbejdsdag med store som små kommunikationsopgaver?

Så er du måske vores nye studentermedhjælper i Kommunikation på Statens Institut for Folkesundhed i København.

Vi forestiller os, at du er i gang med en uddannelse inden for IT, kommunikation, medievidenskab eller lignende, og at du enten har erfaring eller interesse i web, layout og formidling.

En stor del af dit arbejde vil være knyttet til vores hjemmeside, som løbende skal opdateres og udvikles. Dine opgaver spænder blandt andet over redigering og publicering af indhold, behandling af fotos samt udgivelse af videnskabelige rapporter, nyheder og andre tekster på instituttets forskellige platforme – og det bliver også dit ansvar at følge og overvåge vores synlighed i medierne via Retriever.

Samtidig bliver du redaktionssekretær for vores interne nyhedsbrev og vil producere mindre tekster samt stå for layout og udsendelse. Herudover vil der være forskellige ad hoc-opgaver, hvor du bistår instituttets forskere og forskningsprojekter blandt andet med opbygning og opdatering af hjemmesider.

Stillingen er placeret i kommunikationsafdelingen og vores fælles sekretariat.

Dine kvalifikationer

Vi lægger vægt på, at du er en teamplayer, men at du samtidig arbejder selvstændigt. Du er også fleksibel, udadvendt og serviceminded. Erfaring med hjemmesideredigering og billedbehandling er en fordel, men ikke et krav, og vi forventer, at du er nysgerrig på, hvordan AI bidrage til at optimere og kvalificere opgaveløsningen.

Dine primære opgaver

· Udvikling, redigering og opdatering af hjemmeside

· Billedbehandling og redigering

· Grafisk opsætning og layout af forskellige produkter

· Ad hoc-opgaver inden for kommunikation og grafisk design

· Medieovervågning

· Redaktionssekretær for vores interne nyhedsbrev, herunder produktion af mindre tekster

Arbejdstid og ansættelse

Arbejdstiden er omkring 7-8 timer om ugen. Vi foretrækker, at du har mulighed for at arbejde hos os hver tirsdag, men derudover er vi fleksible og tager naturligvis hensyn til dit studie.

Stillingen ønskes besat hurtigst muligt og senest 14. oktober 2026. Ansættelsesperioden er ét år med mulighed for forlængelse. Vi forestiller os derfor, at du er godt i gang med din bacheloruddannelse eller i begyndelsen af din kandidatuddannelse.

Information og kontakt

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte kommunikationsleder Birgitte Hornhaver på 65507711 (biho@sdu.dk) eller sekretariatsleder Nanna Heick Friis på 65507702 (nahf@sdu.dk).

Ansøgningsfristen er mandag den 30. september 2026, kl. 23:59.

Om os

Som studentermedhjælper bliver du en del af Kommunikation og et fælles sekretariat, der løser en bred vifte af opgaver for Statens Institut for Folkesundhed. Du får en hverdag tæt på instituttets forskere og forskningsprojekter og mulighed for at arbejde med kommunikation i en organisation, der beskæftiger sig med folkesundhed og forskning.

Ansættelse finder sted i henhold til overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og PROSA.
Løn fastsættes i henhold til gældende overenskomst og på baggrund af objektive og kønsneutrale kriterier, herunder stillingens indhold, ansvar og krav til kvalifikationer. Du har som ansøger ret til information om startløn og lønspænd for stillingen. Disse oplysninger kan fås i forbindelse med rekrutteringsprocessen. SDU indhenter ikke oplysninger om ansøgeres tidligere løn.
Bemærk: Ved ansættelse som studentermedhjælp er det en forudsætning, at du er indskrevet som studerende på en videregående uddannelse.

Ansøgning skal indeholde følgebrev, CV og eksamensudskrift hvoraf det fremgår, hvor langt du er i dit studium. Såfremt du endnu ikke har været til eksamen, skal ansøgningen i stedet for eksamensudskrift indeholde din indskrivningsbekræftelse. Alle dokumenter i forbindelse med ansøgning bør ikke indeholde CPR-nummer – i så fald skal CPR-nummer overstreges.

Alle vedhæftede filer skal være i Adobe PDF.
Følgebrev og CV må max. fylde 5 Mb.
Vejledning i forbindelse med ansøgning findes her.

Syddansk Universitet ønsker at afspejle det omgivende samfund og opfordrer derfor alle uanset personlig baggrund til at søge stillingen.
Om SDU
Syddansk Universitet er sat i verden for skabe værdi for og med samfundet. Uanset om vores bidrag kommer i form af fremragende forskning, innovative løsninger, uddannelse eller læring, så skal vi gøre en positiv forskel for samfundet og bidrage til en bæredygtig fremtid. Det gør vi ved at dyrke talenter og skabe de bedste miljøer for forskning og læring. Det er derfor afgørende, at SDU fastholder, udvikler og rekrutterer talenter. Samtidig skal vi sikre konstant høj kvalitet i alle vores aktiviteter – det kan vi kun med de rette mennesker. Det er universitetets forskere, undervisere, studerende, ledere og teknisk-administrative personale, der udgør fundamentet for vores succes.

title: Senior Director, Neuroscience Translational Pharmacology
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.



The Neuroscience TRC is committed to the development of transformational therapeutics for patients with neurodegenerative, neuromuscular and neuropsychiatric diseases. A network of internal and external partnerships across neurodegenerative and neuropsychiatric diseases and treatment modalities (small molecules, biologics and genetic medicines) supports our ambition to become leaders in neuroscience. Internal research focuses on causal human biology, matching therapeutic modality to molecular mechanism, and translational discovery enabling a rapid path to clinical proof-of-concept.

Areas of interest include, but are not limited to, the identification of disease modifying and symptomatic therapies for neurodegenerative, neuropsychiatric and neuromuscular diseases; approaches to modulate protein clearance and reduce or eliminate toxic protein production; brain transporter technology and genetic medicines that when matched to underlying causal human biology may deliver a precision medicine portfolio with a high probability of translational success; AI/ML in target identification drug discovery; neuroimaging and fluid biomarkers to track disease progression and target engagement; novel blood brain-barrier technologies to enhance delivery of biotherapeutics and genetic medicines across the blood-brain barrier.

Position Summary:

The Neuroscience Thematic Research Center (Neuro TRC) leverages external collaborations and internal research to establish a portfolio targeting unmet needs in neurodegenerative, neuropsychiatric, neuroinflammatory and neuromuscular, diseases. The Senior Director, Neuroscience Discovery, in collaboration with other members of the Neuroscience TRC, be responsible for the design, conduct, and interpretation of translational pharmacology studies supporting the neuroscience discovery and early development pipeline, with particular emphasis on neurodegenerative and neuromuscular disease programs. This role serves as a key scientific and strategic partner across the Neuroscience TRC and broader BMS Research organization.

This position is based in Cambridge, MA.

Position Responsibilities:

In the role as a Senior Director, Translational Pharmacology, the candidate will:

  • Directly manage, mentor, and develop a team of scientists responsible for designing, executing, and interpreting in vivo and translational pharmacology studies across the neuroscience portfolio.

  • Ensure scientific rigor, reproducibility, and regulatory-appropriate quality in study design, data interpretation, and reporting.

  • Set team priorities, resource plans, and timelines aligned with program and portfolio needs.

  • Work collaboratively to establish, maintain and integrate transgenic and other animal models to evaluate and select drug candidates for further investment

  • Contribute to Neuroscience portfolio governance within the Neuroscience TRC

  • Oversee the design and execution of pharmacology studies (efficacy, target engagement, PK/PD, biomarker) to support IND-enabling activities and entry into early clinical development.

  • Partner with colleagues in Translational Discovery, Translational Medicine and early Clinical Development to ensure alignment between preclinical models and clinical biomarker/endpoint strategy.

  • Play an active role in shaping research strategy across the neuroscience portfolio

  • Identify, recommend, and oversee relationships with academic collaborators and CRO partners; ensure quality, timelines, and scientific integrity of externally generated data.

  • Represent the organization in interactions with external partners, guiding collaborative research activities.

Experience =

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree

    • 15+ years of academic and / or industry experience

Or

  • Master’s Degree

    • 12+ years of academic and / or industry experience

Or

  • Ph.D. or equivalent advanced degree in the Life Sciences

    • 10+ years of academic and / or industry experience

  • 8+ years of leadership experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • PhD with 15+ years of experience in drug discovery research spanning small molecule, biotherapeutics and genetic medicines discovery

  • Experience leading and supervising PhD, MS/MA and BS/BA scientists

  • Experience creating and applying genetically engineered animal models of neurologic disease towards identification an characterization of novel therapeutics

  • Experience leading drug discovery programs from ideation to delivery of a therapeutic candidate

  • Expertise in quantitative analysis of neuropathological endpoints as applied to animal models of neurodegenerative disease

  • Expertise in blood-brain-barrier delivery technologies spanning bi-specific antibodies and genetic medicines

  • Experience leading and contributing to external collaborations and partnerships

  • Experience participating on external diligence teams to identify opportunities for partnering and/or licensing

  • Deep understanding of unmet need and clinical outcome measures used in studies focused on neurodegenerative disorders

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills

  • Ability to work both independently and as an integrated member of multidisciplinary drug development teams

title: Lead Scientist - MOYKOTE(R) Specialty Lubricants
description:
At DuPont, our purpose is to empower the world with essential innovations to thrive. We work on things that matter. Whether it’s providing clean water to more than a billion people on the planet, producing materials that are essential in everyday technology devices from smartphones to electric vehicles, or protecting workers around the world. Discover the many reasons the world’s most talented people are choosing to work at DuPont. Why Join Us | DuPont Careers

The Aerospace & Industrial business of DuPont™ provides high-performance engineering resins, adhesives, and specialty lubricants that enable material systems solutions for some of the world's most demanding applications and operating environments, including aerospace, automotive, mining, and energy production.

The MOLYKOTE® Specialty Lubricants team is seeking an innovative and customer-focused scientist or engineer to support the development and commercialization of advanced lubrication technologies. This role will focus on solid lubricants and anti-friction coatings (AFCs) and will play a key role in helping customers solve wear, friction, and reliability challenges through differentiated tribology solutions.

Working closely with business development, technical service, channel partners, and customers, the successful candidate will translate application needs into innovative product solutions that deliver performance, reliability, and value. This position offers the opportunity to collaborate with regional and global R&D teams to advance new technologies, support product commercialization, and contribute to future innovation pipelines.

The ideal candidate is a self-motivated problem solver with a strong scientific mindset, customer orientation, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while delivering meaningful business results.

What You'll Do

  • Lead or contribute to cross-functional product development and commercialization teams.
  • Develop and evaluate new and modified lubricant technologies to address customer and market needs.
  • Apply scientific methods and data-driven approaches to solve application, quality, and product development challenges.
  • Design, execute, and interpret laboratory testing aligned with industry standards and customer requirements.
  • Develop expertise in specialty lubrication testing equipment and collaborate with global tribology experts to advance technical capabilities.
  • Explore the unique properties of advanced lubricants and low-friction coatings to create differentiated solutions for customers.
  • Collaborate with R&D, Technical Service & Development, Business Development, Marketing, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing teams to deliver business objectives.
  • Provide technical training and product education to customers, channel partners, and internal stakeholders.
  • Engage directly with customers to understand application requirements and translate needs into effective testing and product development strategies.
  • Travel within the Americas region to support customers, training activities, and business meetings (approximately 15%).

Required Qualifications

  • PhD in Chemistry, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, or another relevant technical discipline.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in product development, applications development, technical service, or related technical roles.
  • Ability and willingness to travel throughout the Americas region.
  • Experience collaborating with customers to identify technical challenges and develop practical, application-focused solutions.
  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently while contributing effectively within multidisciplinary teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in lubrication technologies, specialty coatings, silicones, tribology, or related materials technologies.
  • Knowledge of mechanical systems, wear mechanisms, friction behavior, and lubricant performance principles.
  • Experience supporting new product development from concept through commercialization.
  • Familiarity with scientific experimentation, statistical analysis, and structured problem-solving methodologies.
  • Six Sigma Green Belt certification or equivalent continuous improvement experience.
  • Active involvement in industry organizations, professional societies, or technical networks related to lubrication, coatings, or materials science.

title: EHS Specialist

Mini-Circuits’ sells its products to over 20,000 customers globally through our direct sales force, applications engineering staff, sales representatives, as well as through our extensive website.

  • Scoring Framework Development

  • Alerting Framework Configuration

  • Decision Intelligence Workflows

  • Support team members in achieving Quantexa certifications and technical growth goals.

  • Foster a collaborative, high-performance engineering culture.

Engineering Excellence

  • Perform detailed code reviews and design reviews.

  • Champion development best practices, coding standards, testing frameworks and CI/CD processes.

  • Implement reusable frameworks, accelerators and development standards.

  • Ensure appropriate monitoring, logging, alerting and support mechanisms are in place.

  • Drive performance optimisation across Quantexa pipelines and applications.

  • Support root cause analysis and resolution of production issues.

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

Quantexa Experience

  • Proven experience leading multiple Quantexa implementations including Proof of Concept (PoC), Pilot Programmes and Enterprise Implementations.

  • Strong expertise in Quantexa platform architecture and development.

  • Hands-on experience configuring and optimising qModel, qEntity, qElement, qCompound, Scoring Frameworks, Alerting Frameworks, Task Loading Frameworks and Graph Scripts.

  • Expertise in Entity Resolution design and tuning.

  • Expertise in Compound development and optimisation.

  • Strong experience in Quantexa ETL framework implementation and troubleshooting.

  • Experience tuning large-scale Quantexa pipelines for performance and scalability.

  • Strong understanding of Network Generation and Decision Intelligence methodologies.

  • Quantexa Certified Professional or Technical Lead Certification preferred.

Data Engineering & Big Data

  • Strong hands-on experience with Scala, Apache Spark, Hadoop Ecosystem and SQL.

  • Experience designing and building large-scale distributed data processing solutions.

  • Strong understanding of data modelling, data quality, ETL processes, data integration and data validation frameworks.

  • Experience with high-volume data processing environments.

DevOps & Cloud

  • Experience with Git, Jenkins, Azure DevOps and CI/CD Pipelines.

  • Understanding of DevOps principles and release management.

  • Experience deploying applications in cloud environments (Microsoft Azure, AWS, GCP).

  • Knowledge of monitoring, logging, observability and operational support processes.

Preferred Domain Experience

Experience delivering Quantexa solutions within one or more of the following domains:

  • Financial Crime & AML

  • Fraud Detection

  • Customer Intelligence

  • Insurance Analytics

  • Risk & Compliance / KYC / CDD

  • Banking & Financial Services

Technical Skills Summary

  • Quantexa Platform -- ETL, Entity Resolution, Network Generation, Graph Scripting, Scoring Framework, Alerting Framework, Task Loading Framework, Compound Development, Performance Tuning

  • Scala | Apache Spark | Hadoop | SQL | Git | CI/CD

Preferred:

Solution Ownership: Accountable for solution design, build quality, delivery and operational success.

Problem Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to resolve complex business and technical challenges.

Mentorship: Develop technical capabilities within teams through coaching, training and knowledge sharing.

Stakeholder Management: Build strong relationships with Product Owners, Architects, Business Analysts, Delivery Managers and Business Stakeholders.

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS

IDEAL CANDIDATE

    • Equipment/system design
    • Pipeline sizing and evaluation­
    • Pipeline control

    • Policies and procedures

title: Project Manager I – Engineering
description:
#WeAreONEOK – Fortune 500 company. 100+ years in business. Leading midstream service provider. Safety first. Sustainable operations. Environmentally responsible. Employee focused.

JOB SUMMARY


ONEOK is seeking a Project Manager I - Engineering who will be responsible for planning, monitoring and managing engineering projects from initiation through completion, with a focus on small capital and growth projects at the Mont Belvieu facility. This role will support plant and process facility projects, pipeline and related facility work, construction, operations and maintenance activities, measurement and control facilities, gas treating and compressor facilities, product storage, pumping, loading and handling facilities, and related processing equipment and control systems.

The Project Manager I - Engineering will collaborate closely with internal engineering, operations, construction, project controls, supply chain and leadership teams, while also coordinating with external vendors, contractors, customers and other project stakeholders to deliver safe, reliable and cost-effective project outcomes. Candidates for this position should be at the Engineer III or similar level of experience. This position requires strong project management fundamentals, technical engineering knowledge, communication and stakeholder management skills, with an emphasis on safety, accountability, collaboration and sound execution. Ideal candidates will bring at least five years of engineering, operations and/or project management experience, preferably in oil and gas, with strong plant experience; pipeline experience, design or drafting skills, project management software experience and PMP certification are preferred.

This role is based in Mont Belvieu, TX and follows a hybrid 9-4-9 schedule, with nine-hour days Monday through Thursday and a four hour work from home day on Fridays. Occasional overnight travel to support Louisiana assets may be required on an as-needed basis. This position includes 6% profit sharing and a 12.5% short-term incentive plan.

Job Profile Summary

Plans, monitors and manages engineering projects from initiation through completion with support from more experienced resources. Lead project planning, resourcing, staffing, supply and subcontract management, progress reporting, troubleshooting, and people management. Ensure project results meet requirements regarding technical quality, reliability, schedule and cost. Monitor performance and recommend schedule changes, cost adjustments or resource additions. Projects are typically small growth or maintenance capital . Lead internal and external resources and communicate throughout the company as well as with external vendors, contractors and customers. This role requires a blend of interpersonal management and technical skills necessary to achieve the desired project outcome.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities

  • Manage project activities, demonstrating project management fundamentals, to include plant and process facility design, pipeline design, construction, operation and maintenance projects, measurement, regulation and control facilities, gas treating and compressor facilities, product storage, pumping, loading and handling facilities, SCADA, DCS and PLC control systems, processing equipment including pressure vessels, heat exchangers, compressors, pumps, coolers, etc.
  • Collect, review, and disseminate necessary information related to engineering services, scope definition, estimating, scheduling, design, preparation of bid instructions and bidding, procurement, construction, record keeping, right-of-way, and environmental activities to project team members
  • Perform a project risk analysis. Account for how Monte Carlo simulation assists in risk analysis. Provide inputs and critically review results
  • Develop a business case for scope of work. Determine which phase of development a project is in and perform a gap analysis on the number, type and level of definition needed for phase deliverables. Describe the principles of program management and clarify how potential sub-set projects fit into the overall program. Generate program objectives, critical success factors and ensure projects align to these
  • Write scope definition documents and develop scope change management procedures, including formal MOC. Write standard scope definition documents for a typical project using similar documentation from a previous project. Develop project control, interface and scope change management procedures, including a formal Management of Change (MOC) procedure
  • Support development of optimal project solutions that maximize the economic value added of the project over the life of the project within budgetary and resource constraints
  • Create a cost plan considering cost estimating, budgeting and cost control & reporting using prior projects as a basis. Account for the development of cost estimates, contract strategies, construction, quality assurance, including establishing pricing for equipment and materials, and labor productivity for engineering and construction. Assess cost impact of scope changes
  • Support complex project activities to include plant and process facility design, pipeline design, construction, operation and maintenance projects, measurement, regulation and control facilities, gas treating and compressor facilities, product storage, pumping, loading and handling facilities, SCADA, DCS and PLC control systems, processing equipment including pressure vessels, heat exchangers, compressors, pumps, coolers, etc.
  • Develop interface and stakeholder management plans utilizing information from a similar project
  • Develop a project schedule that shows the critical path using similar documentation from a previous project schedule of similar scope and type. Describe and apply for a typical project schedule control procedures. Validate contractor's re-baselined schedules based on agreed criteria
  • Follow techniques to build and improve upon team performance and results. Set challenging objectives based on assigned responsibilities, measuring progress against set targets. Persevere through problems and obstacles, demonstrating accountability of performance and outcomes. Lead project team by creating a clear project vision, obtaining necessary resources to handle projects including the hiring of employees, contractors, and vendors, and purchasing of necessary equipment as well as allocating applicable decision-making authority and responsibility to team members
  • Follow and enhance communication skills. Demonstrate proficient verbal communication skills appropriate to organizational standards. Maintain online platforms for relevance and currency. Participate in meetings and assist in meeting coordination, facilitation and documentation requirements. Interact with direct and indirect reports, corporate personnel, public officials, contractors, customers, and civic organizations on issues including general engineering activities, employee issues, public projects, and project scheduling
  • Demonstrate and develop relationship skills. Demonstrate effective communication and interpretation factors in the development of basic interpersonal relationships. Apply practical methods for influencing others with effective communication
  • Evaluate projects and identify where change is needed. Seek opportunities for different and innovative approaches for project completion and refocus team members if changes are needed
  • Provide technical and engineering assistance to other departments, management, governmental and regulatory agencies, company attorneys, industry groups, and others on matters related to projects and operations, policies, procedures, contracts, material selection, and governmental/regulatory rules, regulations, and activities

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or closely related field and the following job related experience preferred:

Work Experience

  • Experience at the PM I level is typically attained with five or more years of experience in engineering, operations and/or project management
  • Experience and knowledge of engineering and operations of processing facilities, pipeline and related facility design, construction, operation, and maintenance projects; measurement, regulation, and control facilities; gas‑conditioning, processing, and compressor facilities; pressure vessels and process equipment; controls and monitoring systems
  • Experience with all phases of fundamental project management including scoping, estimating, specification, scheduling, contracting and procurement, construction, commissioning and startup, budgeting, financial analyses, and regulatory compliance
  • Experience achieving goals and developing employee/team strengths, exhibiting a positive example and influence that leads to employee and project successes
  • Experience with project management productivity tools and software
  • Experience in coordinating teams from various workgroups, managing relationships with internal and external participants and eliciting cooperation from all resources
  • Experience developing information and making presentations to groups and individuals
  • Experience researching, composing, preparing, and administering contracts, engineering studies, policies, procedures, reports, and technical correspondence
  • Experience reading and interpreting governmental regulations, codes, and standards, manuals, policies, procedures, contracts, specifications, and various reports and correspondence
  • Experience interacting, advising, negotiating, and communicating effectively
  • Experience in use and function of applications such as: Microsoft required and PROCORE preferred

  • Ability to: identify the basic objectives and elements of onshore & offshore project fabrication/ construction, transportation, installation and hookup management plan

  • Ability to: state basic project decommissioning requirements in terms of statutory/regulatory compliance and operational constraints
  • Ability to: identify the basic objectives and elements of project organization plan
  • Ability to: describe the basic objectives and elements of planning for project Health, Safety and the Environmen.
  • Ability to: identify the basic objectives and elements of a information management plan
  • Ability to: identify the basic elements and objectives of project risk management and risk analysis
  • Ability to: describe the key aspects of interface and stakeholder management
  • Ability to: describe the project quality policy and major project quality activities required for a successful outcome
  • Ability to: identify the scope control process, including a project's objectives, scope elements and constraints
  • Ability to: identify the tools used and basic objectives and elements of a project schedule, including the use of work breakdown structure (WBS) to ensure consistency
  • Ability to: identify the basic objectives and elements of project cost planning
  • Ability to: describe key activities that must be completed to ensure funding is available when needed throughout the project lifecycle
  • Ability to: monitor operations and situations to ensure compliance with safety policies and procedures.

  • Ability to: read and interpret construction specifications, engineering plans, regulatory documents, job orders, permits, contracts/bid summaries, legal documents, survey reports, maps, safety manuals, industry publications

description:
Now Hiring: Reservation Agent & Group Rooms Coordinator at the Coeur d’Alene Resort
Be the first friendly voice guests hear as you help them plan their perfect stay

About Coeur d’Alene Resort:
Our resort offers luxury accommodations and unforgettable experiences. We are looking for a detail-oriented Reservation Agent & Group Rooms Coordinator to join our front desk team and assist guests in booking their stays with ease and professionalism.

The Role:

The Reservation Sales & Group Rooms Coordinator is responsible for providing exceptional reservation sales and guest service while coordinating group guestroom reservations for conferences, weddings, corporate retreats, and special events.

This position manages both individual and group reservations from initial inquiry through arrival, including determining room and package availability, processing payments, maintaining room blocks, processing rooming lists, coordinating VIP and special requests, and communicating with guests and meeting planners.

The position plays an important role in supporting resort revenue through effective reservation sales, upselling and cross-selling, while also ensuring group room blocks are accurately managed and aligned with contracts, deadlines, inventory, and resort policies.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-volume environment, and able to navigate multiple computer systems simultaneously. This position requires strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with guests, meeting planners, Sales, Conference Services, Events, Front Office, Housekeeping, and other resort departments.

Key Responsibilities:

· Handle inbound and outbound reservation calls, online reservations, inquiries, and follow-ups.

· Sell and promote rooms, packages, activities, and resort experiences through upselling and cross-selling.

· Provide accurate information regarding rates, availability, policies, amenities, and resort offerings.

· Enter and maintain accurate individual and group reservations in Opera Cloud, Revinate, Delphi, and other applicable systems.

· Manage group room blocks, rooming lists, pickup, deadlines, billing instructions, and special requests from booking through arrival.

· Communicate with guests, meeting planners, Sales, Conference Services, Events, Front Office, Housekeeping, and other departments to ensure successful group arrivals.

· Monitor group pickup, inventory, occupancy, and availability; assist with forecasting and reporting.

· Process payments, deposits, guarantees, and reservation confirmations accurately.

· Create and manage group booking links and communicate reservation procedures and deadlines.

· Maintain accurate documentation and ensure compliance with resort and departmental policies.

· Manage multiple priorities and deadlines while maintaining a high level of organization and attention to detail.

· Provide professional, courteous service and maintain a positive, "can do" attitude at all times.

· Perform general correspondence, reporting, filing, and other duties as assigned.

What We’re Looking For:

    · Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

title: Director, Project & Portfolio Management Office
description:
The Project and Portfolio Management Office Director provides strategic and operational leadership for Dana-Farber’s project and portfolio management function within a complex healthcare, research, and administrative environment. This role establishes and advances enterprise standards for project intake, prioritization, governance, execution, reporting, and continuous improvement to support institutional strategy and effective use of resources. The Director leads a team of project management professionals, oversees portfolio performance, and partners with leaders across Information Services and other departments to ensure initiatives are aligned, appropriately resourced, and delivered with quality, transparency, and accountability. The role requires balancing long-range portfolio planning with day-to-day operational oversight, while strengthening project management capability across the Institute.

Located in Boston and the surrounding communities, Dana-Farber Cancer Institute is a leader in life changing breakthroughs in cancer research and patient care. We are united in our mission of conquering cancer, HIV/AIDS, and related diseases. We strive to create an inclusive, diverse, and equitable environment where we provide compassionate and comprehensive care to patients of all backgrounds, and design programs to promote public health particularly among high-risk and underserved populations. We conduct groundbreaking research that advances treatment, we educate tomorrow's physician/researchers, and we work with amazing partners, including other Harvard Medical School-affiliated hospitals.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities

  • Provides strategic leadership for the Project and Portfolio Management Office, defining and advancing portfolio governance, project management standards, intake processes, prioritization approaches, and performance expectations that support Dana-Farber’s institutional and departmental goals.
  • Directs the evaluation, intake, and prioritization of new initiatives in partnership with Information Services and business leaders, ensuring proposed work is supported by clear business cases, defined scope, resource requirements, budget considerations, measurable outcomes, and alignment with strategic priorities.
  • Oversees the Institute’s project and portfolio management methodology and related tools, establishing consistent practices for project initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, issue escalation, risk management, change control, status reporting, and project closeout, while driving adoption and continuous refinement of these practices.
  • Leads portfolio oversight activities, including project assignment, capacity planning, workload balancing, dashboard reporting, portfolio reviews, and compliance checks, to promote delivery discipline, transparent decision-making, effective resource utilization, and timely identification of risks, dependencies, and barriers.
  • Partners with senior leaders, operational stakeholders, and technical teams to ensure projects are sequenced appropriately, interdependencies are understood, governance decisions are documented, and portfolio recommendations reflect organizational strategy, operational realities, and available capabilities.
  • Builds organizational project and portfolio management capability through coaching, training, mentoring, and communication, including the development of educational resources, lessons learned repositories, and practical guidance that strengthen project management maturity across Information Services and the broader Institute. Training responsibilities include teaching project management core classes as well as related soft skills and tools through DFCI Project University.
  • Manages relationships with vendors and external partners related to project delivery and project management tools, while also leading staff performance, development, engagement, and accountability to support high-quality service, strong collaboration, and a culture of continuous improvement.
  • Supervises staff. Hires, develops, and manages staff to achieve organizational goals. Sets clear expectations, delivers feedback, and monitors performance for quality, efficiency, and compliance with policies and procedures. Mentors staff, fosters career growth, and cultivates a positive and productive work environment.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Deep knowledge of project, program, and portfolio management reporting tools/ platforms, principles, methodologies, governance models, and best practices, with the ability to apply them effectively in a complex, matrixed environment.
  • Strong understanding of the full project lifecycle, including business case development, scope definition, scheduling, budgeting, risk and issue management, dependency tracking, change control, benefits realization, and project closeout.
  • Demonstrated ability to establish, lead, and continuously improve PMO or PPMO functions, including intake processes, governance forums, prioritization frameworks, portfolio reporting, and methodology adoption.
  • Ability to align portfolios and projects with strategic objectives, operational priorities, and resource constraints, and to recommend appropriate tradeoffs based on institutional needs, capacity, and available capabilities.
  • Strong leadership skills with demonstrated success managing, coaching, mentoring, and developing project managers and other professionals with varied levels of experience, while promoting accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Excellent judgment and decision-making skills, including the ability to assess complex situations, identify and mitigate risks, evaluate competing priorities, and escalate issues appropriately.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret project and portfolio data, define performance measures, identify trends, and translate findings into actionable recommendations for leadership.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex information clearly and effectively to executives, managers, technical teams, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority, build consensus, foster collaboration across departments and leadership levels, and facilitate governance and stakeholder discussions to drive clarity and informed decision-making in ambiguous situations.

Minimum Job Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Information Systems, Project Management, Public Health, Operations Management, or a related field required. Master's degree preferred.
  • 8 years of progressively responsible experience in project management, portfolio management, PMO leadership, or related operational leadership in a complex organization required.
  • 5 years of people management experience required.
  • Experience leading enterprise or department-level project intake, prioritization, governance, resource planning, and portfolio reporting required.
  • Experience in healthcare, academic medicine, research, or other highly matrixed and regulated environments preferred.
  • Experience managing technology-enabled, operational, and cross-functional strategic initiatives preferred.

License/Certification/Registration Required:

  • PMP, PgMP, PfMP, PMI-ACP, Lean, Six Sigma, or comparable project/program/portfolio management certification.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • Supervises team of Technical Project Management staff (10+).

At Dana-Farber Cancer Institute, we work every day to create an innovative, caring, and inclusive environment where every patient, family, and staff member feels they belong. As relentless as we are in our mission to reduce the burden of cancer for all, we are committed to having faculty and staff who offer multifaceted experiences. Cancer knows no boundaries and when it comes to hiring the most dedicated and compassionate professionals, neither do we. If working in this kind of organization inspires you, we encourage you to apply.

We are seeking a License Hearing Care Professional who is ready to join an organization that combines passion and performance to shape a better world. As a Global Top Employer 2026, Miracle-Ear is a place where your expertise improves lives and accelerates your career.

In this role, you will lead the customer journey by administering comprehensive hearing evaluations and providing personalized consultations to help people rediscover the emotions of sound. Reporting to the Area Manager, you will drive office revenue and community engagement through clinical excellence and dedicated customer service.

Compensation: $100,000 + earning potential including base salary and an industry-leading uncapped commission structure.

Schedule: This position offers standard business hours, Monday-Friday 8:30am - 5:00pm.

Benefits Offered:

  • Health & Financial: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k) with company match, Health Savings Account, life insurance, family hearing aid benefits.
  • Work-life Balance: Paid Time Off (PTO), Paid Holidays, volunteer time off and parental leave.
  • Well-being: Access to our Wellness Hub and Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
  • Career Development: Continuous training, development, and support through the Ampli-Academy and other specialized learning platforms.

Responsibilities:

Clinical Excellence & Customer Journey

  • Administer comprehensive hearing evaluations and educate customers on the effects of hearing loss.
  • Guide customers through device fittings and demonstrations while educating them on the importance of hearing health.
  • Provide quality after-care services and offer personalized consultations to fit unique customer needs and lifestyles.

Business & Sales Operations

  • Lead the sale of hearing aids and accessories to contribute to individual and office revenue goals.
  • Partner with the Front Office Associate to ensure a high-quality customer experience, effective schedule management, and smooth store operations.
  • Maintain data accuracy and privacy by managing customer records in compliance with all protected healthcare data regulations.

Professional Expertise & Community Engagement

  • Drive local engagement by supporting marketing initiatives and managing special events to promote hearing health awareness.
  • Stay current on industry trends and maintain professional credentials through continuous education.

Must-Have Qualifications:

  • Licensure: Actively licensed as a Hearing Instrument Specialist or Dispensing Audiologist.
  • Experience: 1+ year of training or related experience as a Hearing Instrument Specialist.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Windows, CRM, and POS systems.
  • Product Knowledge: Current knowledge of hearing aid devices and technology.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in a customer-facing role with a strong dedication to high-quality service.
  • Confident, attentive, empathetic, and solution-oriented approach to customer care.
  • Motivated by a purpose-driven environment and a desire to help others improve their quality of life.

Miracle-Ear has been in business for over 75 years, providing leading innovative hearing solutions that improve lives, relationships, and communities. With over 1,500 franchised and corporate-owned retail clinics across the U.S., we’re committed to connecting customers to the world of sound around them. Through the Miracle-Ear Foundation, we give back to the local communities we serve, with a portion of every hearing aid sold helping someone in need.

Amplifon is the global leader in the hearing care retail market, empowering people to rediscover all the emotions of sound. With a presence in 25 countries and 20,300 employees worldwide, we are a team of diverse, innovative talent dedicated to improving lives through customer experience.

Amplifon Americas, headquartered in Minneapolis, MN, supports Amplifon Canada, Amplifon Hearing Health Care, GAES, and Miracle-Ear bridging retail and insurance industries to provide comprehensive hearing well-being across Canada, LATAM, and the United States.
