title: Supervisor, Product Engineering
description:
Job Description:

The Supervisor, Product Engineering Support is responsible for leading a team that provides technical support and engineering coordination services to internal departments across manufacturing, supply chain, warranty, operations, and engineering functions. This role ensures accurate and timely resolution of technical requests, maintains product-related information, and supports operational objectives through effective cross-functional collaboration. The position provides day-to-day leadership, employee development, workload management, and performance oversight while promoting continuous improvement in responsiveness, accuracy, and customer support. The Supervisor, Product Engineering Support serves as a key link between engineering and operational teams to support production efficiency, product quality, and organizational goals.

Primary Duties:

  • Supervise and coordinate the daily activities of the Product Engineering Support team to ensure timely and accurate completion of assigned work.
  • Assign priorities, monitor workload distribution, and manage resources to support departmental objectives and internal customer requirements.
  • Partner with manufacturing, supply chain, quality, warranty, and engineering teams to resolve technical issues and support operational needs.
  • Provide leadership, coaching, and guidance to employees while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Monitor team performance metrics and implement process improvements to enhance response times, service quality, and operational effectiveness.
  • Support product-related activities by coordinating technical information, clarifying requirements, and facilitating communication among stakeholders.
  • Maintain the integrity and accuracy of product documentation, technical specifications, and engineering-related data.
  • Assist with project execution, issue resolution, product changes, and operational initiatives affecting manufacturing and product support activities.
  • Support departmental goals through data analysis, reporting, and identification of opportunities for process improvement and operational efficiency.
  • Hires, trains, coaches, counsels, and evaluates performance of direct reports.

Primary duties may include, but are not limited to:

  • Coordinate responses to technical inquiries from internal departments and ensure timely resolution of support requests.
  • Monitor workloads, track open requests, and escalate issues requiring additional resources or leadership support.
  • Support onboarding, training, and development activities for new and existing team members.
  • Participate in employee performance discussions, goal setting, and corrective action processes in partnership with management and Human Resources.
  • Maintain product-related documentation, specifications, bills of materials, and technical records.
  • Develop reports and analyze trends related to support activities, product information, and team performance.
  • Collaborate with suppliers and external partners regarding product-related technical information and component requirements.
  • Assist with product evaluations, testing activities, and field support efforts as required.
  • Promote continuous improvement initiatives that enhance team effectiveness and customer service.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Job Requirements

Education and Experience Requirements:

  • Requires a Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Applied Sciences, or a related technical discipline;
  • 2+ years of experience in engineering, product support, manufacturing, technical operations, or a related environment; or any combination of education and experience, which would provide an equivalent background.
  • Prior experience leading, supervising, coaching, mentoring, or directing technical employees is preferred.
  • Experience supporting manufacturing operations, product engineering, or HVAC-related products is preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Knowledge of engineering principles, manufacturing processes, and product support functions.
  • Ability to interpret technical drawings, specifications, bills of materials, and engineering documentation.
  • Strong leadership, coaching, and employee development skills.
  • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple assignments and manage competing deadlines.
  • Proficiency in data analysis, reporting, and documentation management.
  • Ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

Essential and Physical Functions:

  • Ability to analyze technical information and make sound business decisions.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with employees, customers, suppliers, and stakeholders at all organizational levels.

title: R&D Senior Scientist - Spectroscopy
description:
At DuPont, our purpose is to empower the world with essential innovations to thrive. We work on things that matter. Whether it’s providing clean water to more than a billion people on the planet, producing materials that are essential in everyday technology devices from smartphones to electric vehicles, or protecting workers around the world. Discover the many reasons the world’s most talented people are choosing to work at DuPont. Why Join Us | DuPont Careers

DuPont is seeking a motivated Senior Scientist to join our Analytical & Decision Sciences (ADS) organization with a primary focus on spectroscopy and analytical problem solving. ADS solves complex scientific, manufacturing, and customer challenges through measurement science, analytical insight, and collaboration.

The successful candidate will partner with multidisciplinary teams to address technical challenges through the application of advanced analytical technologies and data-driven decision making. In addition to developing deep expertise in spectroscopy, this scientist will have opportunities to expand into complementary analytical disciplines and contribute to the digital transformation of laboratory workflows. By connecting analytical data, historical knowledge, and measurement science with modern digital platforms, this individual will help improve products, applications, manufacturing processes, and scientific productivity.

We are seeking candidates with strong scientific fundamentals, exceptional learning agility, effective communication skills, and a collaborative mindset who are energized by solving challenging problems, continuously developing new capabilities, and delivering meaningful business impact.

Key Responsibilities

  • Apply spectroscopic techniques to characterize materials, investigate structure-property relationships, support product development, and resolve technical challenges.
  • Design and execute scientifically rigorous experiments; analyze and interpret complex data; and communicate findings, limitations, and recommendations to technical teams and business partners.
  • Collaborate with scientists, engineers, manufacturing personnel, customer-facing teams, and business stakeholders to support R&D, commercialization, manufacturing, and customer success initiatives.
  • Develop a strong understanding of business and customer needs and translate those needs into effective analytical strategies that generate actionable insights.
  • Maintain high standards of scientific rigor, data integrity, technical documentation, and laboratory safety.
  • Contribute to the development, optimization, and advancement of analytical methods, workflows, and laboratory capabilities.
  • Continuously build expertise in spectroscopy while expanding knowledge in complementary analytical techniques, materials science, and emerging technologies.
  • Share technical knowledge, mentor colleagues, and contribute to a collaborative and inclusive scientific community.
  • Support the integration of laboratory measurements from ADS and business laboratories into connected digital systems that enhance data accessibility, knowledge capture, and scientific productivity.
  • Contribute to the development of digital workflows that improve method development, data acquisition, analysis, visualization, interpretation, and reporting.
  • Apply chemometrics, machine learning, data science, and emerging digital technologies to extract value from scientific data and enable data-driven decision making.
  • Foster a culture of safety, innovation, inclusion, and continuous improvement.

Required Qualifications

  • Ph.D. in Analytical Chemistry, Chemistry, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Physics, Polymer Science, or a related discipline.
  • Up to 3 years of relevant industrial or postdoctoral experience.
  • Strong foundation in vibrational spectroscopy, including infrared (IR) and Raman spectroscopy.
  • Demonstrated ability to design experiments, analyze and interpret data, and solve complex technical problems.
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical information to diverse audiences.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary teams.
  • Demonstrated learning agility and enthusiasm for developing expertise in new scientific and technical areas.
  • Commitment to safety, scientific integrity, and delivering high-quality work.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in one or more of the following areas is desirable:

  • UV-Visible-NIR spectroscopy
  • Fluorescence spectroscopy
  • Hyphenated spectroscopic techniques (TGA-FTIR, LC-IR, GC-IR, etc.)
  • Chemical imaging approaches involving infrared or Raman spectroscopy/microscopy, including Raman chemical imaging, infrared microscopy, AFM-IR, and O-PTIR
  • Hyperspectral data processing, visualization, and interpretation
  • Polymer characterization, materials science, and analysis of complex organic or multicomponent materials
  • Programming experience with data science tools such as Python, MATLAB, or R
  • Experience applying chemometric and machine learning techniques such as PCA, PLS, MCR, clustering methods, and SVM to research or industrial challenges

title: Fleet Coordinator
description:
As a Mobility Coordinator, you are the backbone of daily vehicle readiness and shift coordination for Fleet Mobility Solutions, LLC. You’ll ensure that every vehicle is safe, clean and fully prepared for use at the start of each driver’s shift.

A Day in the Life:

As a Fleet Coordinator, you'll help keep our fleet moving by coordinating vehicle readiness, managing inventory, supporting daily operations, and working with team members to ensure vehicles are safe, clean, and available when needed. This is a fast-paced, hands-on role where organization, communication, and problem-solving are key to success.

The hourly wage for this position is $20.00/hr + quarterly incentives

  • Conduct and verify pre- and post-shift vehicle inspections to ensure safety and compliance

  • Prepare and organize key tags and documentation so drivers can begin their shifts without delay

  • Able to communicate effectively and follow directions from our FMS management team
  • Able to lift and carry up to 50 pounds occasionally.
  • Able to sit and stand for extended periods.
